About MoonTech
MoonTech is an agentic AI company for creator commerce built for guaranteed conversions, not promises Operating as an autonomous closed-loop system, MoonTech replaces legacy platform tools and superficial metrics (like reach and impressions) with a crew of 7 specialized AI agents (Moon AI) that manage the full campaign lifecycle from client brief and creator matching to live execution, real-time ad optimization, and verified sales attribution .
Role Overview
Interested in influencer marketing, curious about AI, and quick to notice when something doesn’t add up? As an Influencer Marketing Intern at MoonTech, you’ll get hands-on experience across campaign operations, performance reporting, influencer coordination, and AI-driven workflows, working closely with our Influencer, CSM, and Tech teams. This isn’t an observe-only internship: you’ll help run real campaigns, work with data, solve issues, and share ideas that improve how the team works.
Responsibilities
Campaign Management

• Coordinate campaign deliverables: work with the CSM team to receive deliverables and communicate campaign updates.

• Manage posting timelines: schedule influencer ads and monitor posting schedules.

• Follow up with influencers: make sure content goes live on time.

• Support onboarding: help onboard newly acquired influencers.

• Resolve issues: help solve influencer-related issues that come up during campaigns.

Quality & Data Assurance

• Cross-check deliverables: review campaign data, influencer recordings, and assets to confirm agreed targets and deliverables are met.

• Spot inconsistencies: identify errors or gaps in campaign data.

• Escalate issues: report problems found in the data or the Influencer app to the right internal teams.

• Keep data reliable: help maintain accurate campaign information across workflows.

Reporting

• Track results: monitor campaign performance and share relevant updates with internal teams.

• Ensure visibility: help teams stay clear on campaign progress and performance.

AI & Innovation

• Learn how AI is used: understand how AI works across MoonTech, especially within the Influencer team.

• Explore AI tools: look into how AI-powered tools and agents can support campaign operations and team workflows.

• Suggest improvements: bring ideas to make existing processes faster, smarter, and more scalable.

Cross-Team Collaboration

• Join team meetings: take part in meetings with the CSM, Influencer, and Tech teams when needed.

• Solve problems together: work across teams to identify and resolve campaign challenges.

• Keep communication clear: keep updates organized as campaigns move through each stage.

Qualifications:

• Recent graduate or final-year student in Marketing, Business, Mass Communication, or a related field.

• Confident, hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT, with curiosity about AI agents and automation in marketing workflows.

• Strong communication skills in English and Arabic.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, and campaign trackers.

• Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot.

• Genuine interest in influencer marketing and social media; previous exposure is a plus.

• Able to stay organized while supporting multiple campaigns and deadlines.

• A proactive mindset: you notice problems, follow through, and suggest better ways of doing things.

• Quick to learn and comfortable collaborating with different teams.

### About the Role

We are seeking a **Security Operations & Monitoring Engineer** to provide continuous monitoring and security-event analysis across encryption, KMS, HSM, database security, and related infrastructure.

The successful candidate will work closely with the SOC/SIEM and technical teams to identify suspicious activities, triage security events, support incident response, and ensure timely escalation and reporting.

### Key Responsibilities

* Perform continuous monitoring of cybersecurity systems and infrastructure.
* Monitor encryption, KMS, HSM, database security, and other security-related events.
* Review and analyze system, security, audit, and application logs.
* Monitor security alerts through SIEM/SOC platforms.
* Perform first-level investigation and triage of cybersecurity events.
* Correlate alerts from multiple security technologies to identify potential incidents.
* Escalate critical or suspicious activities according to established procedures.
* Support incident-response investigations and evidence collection.
* Coordinate with engineering teams during security incidents and service-impacting events.
* Support the tuning of monitoring rules and alert thresholds.
* Prepare operational, security, and incident reports.
* Maintain incident records, monitoring procedures, and operational documentation.
* Participate in shift, maintenance, and on-call activities when required.

**Requirements**

### Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in **Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering**, or related field.
* **4+ years of experience** in SOC, SIEM, security monitoring, incident triage, or cybersecurity operations.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM and security monitoring platforms.
* Good understanding of security events, logs, alerts, incident handling, and escalation procedures.
* Experience integrating security solutions with central SOC/SIEM platforms.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Must be available **full-time onsite in Dammam**.

### Required Certification

* **CompTIA Security+**.

### Preferred Certifications

* CompTIA **CySA+**.
* Splunk Core Certified Power User.
* Splunk Certified Cybersecurity Defense Analyst.
* Equivalent recognized SIEM/SOC certification.

### Core Competencies

**SOC | SIEM | Security Monitoring | Incident Triage | Log Analysis | Incident Response | Alert Management | Threat Detection | Reporting**

Candidates should include the SIEM/SOC platforms they have used, the type of monitoring environments they supported, and their relevant certifications.

**Job Description –  (KSA)**

**Role Purpose**

The **Export Specialist** is responsible for managing end‑to‑end export operations, ensuring full compliance with Saudi and international regulations, accurate documentation, timely shipment execution, and smooth coordination with internal teams, freight forwarders, and government authorities. The role supports both **land and sea exports**, including re‑export activities, and ensures accurate reporting and insurance compliance.

**🔹 Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Export Documentation & Compliance**

* Prepare and issue **Proforma Invoices** for export orders.
* Manage **Export Insurance Declarations** and ensure all shipments are covered as per company policy.
* Handle **SFDA notifications**, **Health Certificates**, and all required regulatory documents.
* Ensure full compliance with Saudi Customs, SFDA, Chamber of Commerce, and country‑specific export requirements.

**2\. Shipment Execution (Land & Sea)**

* Prepare **loading plans** and coordinate with warehouse, transporters, and freight forwarders.
* Arrange bookings for land and sea shipments and ensure timely dispatch.
* Follow up on container movements, transit updates, and delivery confirmations.
* Coordinate with transporters for cross‑border, and GCC re‑export shipments.

**3\. Export Legalization & Government Processing**

* Manage **Export Invoice Legalization**, **Certificate of Origin (COO)**, and **Health Certificate (HC)** issuance.
* Coordinate with Chamber of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce, and other authorities for document stamping and approvals.

**4\. Claims & Issue Resolution**

* Handle **export claims**, including shortages, damages, insurance claims, and documentation discrepancies.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, insurance providers, and internal teams to close claims efficiently.

**5\. Reporting & Systems**

* Update and maintain the **Export Tracker** with shipment status, documentation, and delivery timelines.
* Process and verify **supplier/transporter invoices** (freight forwarders, express couriers, land transporters).
* Maintain and update **Smartsheet** for export operations, ensuring accuracy and visibility.
* Support monthly reporting for export KPIs, cost tracking, and performance dashboards.

**6\. Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Sales Operations, Warehouse, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to ensure smooth export flow.
* Support customers and distributors with shipment visibility, documentation, and regulatory requirements.

We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and ambitious Database Administrator Trainee to join our Data Platform team through the Tamheer Program.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, analyzing system behavior, working with data, and understanding how critical technology platforms operate behind the scenes.

As a DBA Trainee, you will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale database environments and learn how databases are designed, monitored, optimized, secured, backed up, and recovered.

Database administration requires precision and responsibility. A small configuration or query mistake can sometimes have a significant impact. Therefore, we are looking for someone who approaches tasks carefully, validates their work, asks the right questions, and remains calm when investigating technical problems.

This will be a challenging learning journey filled with technical exploration, troubleshooting, benchmarking, automation, and real-world engineering experience.

### Key Responsibilities

You will work closely with experienced Database Administrators, Data Engineers, and Platform Engineers to:

* Write, review, and optimize SQL queries.
* Analyze database performance and identify slow or inefficient queries.
* Support database monitoring, health checks, and capacity analysis.
* Assist with database backup, recovery, replication, and high-availability activities.
* Investigate database incidents and help identify root causes.
* Perform benchmarking and compare database configurations, queries, and technologies.
* Develop Python scripts to automate repetitive database and operational tasks.
* Validate data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
* Prepare technical reports, performance findings, and recommendations.
* Support documentation of database standards, operational procedures, and best practices.
* Learn how database changes are safely tested before being applied to critical environments.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives across the Data Platform.

**Requirements**

The ideal candidate should have:

* Good foundational knowledge of SQL.
* The ability to write queries using joins, aggregations, filtering, and subqueries.
* Basic Python programming skills.
* Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* An analytical mindset and close attention to detail.
* The ability to compare results, benchmark solutions, and validate assumptions.
* A willingness to investigate problems instead of accepting results at face value.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* A strong desire to learn database technologies and production engineering practices.

### Preferred Knowledge

The following experience is beneficial but not mandatory:

* Familiarity with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar database technologies.
* Basic knowledge of Linux and command-line tools.
* Understanding of database indexes, transactions, schemas, and data types.
* Exposure to Git, APIs, cloud platforms, or container technologies.
* Experience working on academic, personal, or graduation projects involving data or automation.

### What You Will Learn

During the program, you will have the opportunity to learn:

* How enterprise databases operate at scale.
* Database performance tuning and query optimization.
* Backup, recovery, replication, and disaster-recovery concepts.
* Database security and access-management practices.
* Monitoring, alerting, and incident investigation.
* Python-based database automation.
* Safe change-management practices for production environments.
* How to think and operate like a Database Reliability Engineer.

### Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You will enjoy this role if you:

* Are curious about how systems work internally.
* Enjoy investigating difficult technical problems.
* Pay attention to small details that others may overlook.
* Are comfortable asking questions and learning from feedback.
* Take ownership of your work and verify your results.
* See challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.
* Want to build a career in databases, cloud data platforms, or reliability engineering.

### Our Commitment to You

### About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand their customers and take action across the entire customer lifecycle.

Our platform brings together products including Social Listening, OmniServe, Survey, and AI Agent, helping enterprise organizations across the region turn customer data into better experiences and measurable business outcomes.

As Lucidya continues to scale, our products are becoming more sophisticated and our customers more demanding. Design has an increasingly important role to play in making sure that complexity doesn't become the customer's problem.

### Why this role matters

At this level, we're looking for someone who can move beyond simply executing designs and **own problems from beginning to end**.

You'll take ambiguous customer and business problems, work with Product and Engineering to understand what we're trying to achieve, explore different approaches, and drive the design through to implementation and iteration.

You'll be working on products that can involve significant amounts of data, complex workflows, AI-powered functionality, and bilingual experiences. The challenge isn't simply making these products look good — it's making them **easy to understand, efficient to use, and genuinely useful for enterprise customers**.

You'll have meaningful independence, but you're not expected to operate alone. You'll work alongside senior designers, Product Managers, Engineers, UX researchers, and UX writers. The strongest person in this role will know when to push their own thinking, when to ask for input, and when to challenge an assumption.

### What You'll Do

* **Own design problems end-to-end.** You'll take ownership from understanding the problem and defining the user experience through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity UI, handoff, implementation, and post-launch iteration.
* **Turn ambiguity into clarity.** Requirements won't always arrive perfectly defined. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Research, and stakeholders to understand the underlying problem and determine what we actually need to solve.
* **Design for outcomes, not outputs.** You'll challenge solutions that don't clearly improve the customer's experience and use research, data, and customer feedback to understand whether your designs are actually working.
* **Partner closely with Product and Engineering.** You'll be involved early rather than receiving requirements at the end of the process. You'll help shape what gets built and work through technical and product constraints without losing sight of the customer.
* **Raise the quality of our products.** You'll contribute to Lucidya's design system and help create consistency across our products while knowing when a problem requires something different.
* **Bring customer evidence into design decisions.** You'll conduct or support usability testing and lightweight research, using what you learn to validate assumptions rather than relying solely on personal opinion.
* **Make complex products feel simple.** Whether you're designing analytics, workflows, AI functionality, or customer-facing experiences, you'll look for ways to reduce cognitive load and help users get to the outcome they need faster.
* **Design thoughtfully for our market.** You'll account for Arabic and English experiences, RTL considerations, and the needs of enterprise customers across the region.
* **Communicate your thinking clearly.** You'll present work to Product, Engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders, explaining not only *what* you designed but *why* you made those decisions.
* **Make the team better.** You'll actively participate in critiques, give thoughtful feedback to other designers, and share what you've learned rather than keeping your knowledge within your own product area.

**Requirements**

### Who You Are

* **You can own a problem without needing someone to tell you every step.** You know how to take an ambiguous brief, ask the right questions, break it down, and move it forward.
* **You think like a product designer, not just a UI designer.** You're interested in the customer, the business problem, the constraints, and the outcome — not simply whether the final interface looks polished.
* **You're comfortable challenging the status quo.** If you think a requirement doesn't make sense or there's a better way to solve a problem, you're willing to say so and can back your thinking with evidence.
* **You know when to push and when to compromise.** You can defend an important design decision while understanding that product development involves technical, commercial, and time constraints.
* **You're highly collaborative.** You don't throw designs over the wall to Engineering or wait for Product to tell you what to do. You work with people throughout the process.
* **You're comfortable with ambiguity and change.** Priorities may shift, requirements may evolve, and not every decision will be made for you. You stay focused on the outcome rather than becoming frustrated by the process.
* **You're genuinely curious about users.** You want to understand why customers behave the way they do and are willing to change your design when the evidence tells you that your original assumption was wrong.
* **You communicate with clarity.** You can explain complex design decisions to people who aren't designers and can adapt how you communicate depending on whether you're speaking with an Engineer, Product Manager, customer, or executive.
* **You care about quality.** You have high standards for interaction, usability, accessibility, and visual design, but you also understand when “good enough to learn” is better than spending weeks perfecting something nobody has validated.
* **You have 3–5 years of product design or UX/UI experience**, ideally in B2B or SaaS environments, with a portfolio demonstrating genuine end-to-end product thinking.
* **You're proficient in Figma and comfortable with prototyping, design systems, and modern product design practices.**
* **You're a Saudi national**, as this position is designated for Saudi nationals.

### Nice to Have

* Experience designing data-heavy or analytics-driven B2B products.
* Experience with AI-powered products, conversational interfaces, or AI agents.
* Experience designing Arabic/English or RTL experiences.
* Familiarity with tools such as FigJam, Maze, LogRocket, or similar research and testing tools.

### What the hiring process will look like

1.  **Recruiter screening** — An initial conversation about your experience, motivations, and what you're looking for next.
2.  **Design interview** — A deeper discussion with the Design team around your product thinking, design process, and approach to solving complex problems.
3.  **Portfolio / case study presentation** — You'll take us through selected projects, focusing on the problem, your role, decisions, trade-offs, collaboration, and measurable or observable outcomes.
4.  **Team / culture interview** — A conversation focused on how you work, give and receive feedback, handle disagreement, and contribute to a high-performing team.
5.  **Final interview** — Final conversation with the relevant leadership team.

Aviagen is establishing a new world-class operation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), comprising farms, a hatchery, a feed mill, a laboratory, and a decontamination facility across multiple locations.

To support the successful delivery of this ambitious project, Aviagen has partnered with GPP, a specialist consulting firm with extensive expertise in the design, management, and supervision of poultry industry construction projects.

We are seeking an experienced **Project Supervisor** to join the project team and work closely with both GPP and Aviagen stakeholders throughout the construction phase.

## Position Summary

Reporting to the Project Manager and Project Director, the Project Supervisor will be responsible for the day-to-day on-site supervision of construction activities. Acting as the eyes and ears of the project management team, this role ensures that contractors execute works in accordance with approved designs, technical specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and project schedules.

This is a predominantly field-based role requiring a proactive individual with strong construction oversight experience and the ability to identify and resolve issues before they impact project delivery.

## Key Responsibilities

* Supervise and monitor the daily activities of contractors and subcontractors, ensuring compliance with approved designs, technical specifications, contractual requirements, and project standards.
    
* Conduct routine site inspections and quality audits, documenting findings and following up on corrective actions where required.
    
* Serve as the primary on-site liaison between contractors, suppliers, consultants, and the wider project management team.
    
* Track construction progress against project schedules and promptly escalate any delays, risks, or deviations.

* Maintain accurate site documentation, including daily reports, inspection records, photographic evidence, and progress updates.
    
* Ensure compliance with all applicable local regulations, building codes, permit requirements, and safety standards.
    
* Participate in site coordination meetings, safety briefings, audits, and project reviews.
    
* Provide accurate field information to support weekly and monthly project reporting.
    
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure contractors adhere to established HSE requirements at all times.

## What We Offer

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in the development of a flagship poultry operation in Saudi Arabia and contribute to one of the most significant investments in the region. You will work alongside international experts and gain exposure to large-scale, technically complex agricultural and industrial construction projects.

  

We play a leading role in feeding the world's future generations.

## About The PAC Group

At The PAC Group (PAC), we specialize in engineering consulting, program management, and operational excellence, delivering high-impact solutions in more than 20 countries. For more than 41 years, we have partnered with leading companies across the automotive, aerospace, industrial, and technology sectors, providing strategic guidance and hands-on execution that drive innovation and efficiency.

Whether launching advanced manufacturing systems, deploying digital simulation tools, or scaling global operations, PAC thrives at the intersection of technology, engineering, and problem-solving.

Joining PAC means joining a dynamic, fast-paced, global team that values curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

## Role Purpose

PAC is supporting a client launching an electric drive unit manufacturing line in Saudi Arabia involving the e-motor and inverter through integrated e-drive assembly and end-of-line testing. The line will supply a vehicle assembly plant.

The role covers equipment installation and commissioning, process qualification, run-at-rate, PPAP, Start of Production (SOP), and ramp-up to full-volume production.

We are recruiting several Process Engineers. Depending on your background, you will take deep ownership of one process area—stator, rotor, motor assembly and test, gearbox, or inverter and power electronics—or work as a cross-process generalist owning an end-to-end value stream.

Candidates should identify which profile best aligns with their experience so the project scope can be matched accordingly.

## Key Responsibilities

* Own the process definition for your assigned perimeter, including process flow, cycle-time allocation, parameter windows, control plans, PFMEA, work instructions, and change control from installation through stable-rate production.
* Lead equipment commissioning, SAT, process capability studies, and qualification runs; define and execute DOE activities to establish initial parameter windows.
* Deliver APQP and PPAP requirements for your assigned area.
* Engineer to takt by balancing stations and eliminating bottlenecks and micro-stops.
* Drive the production ramp curve by converting scrap, rework, first-pass yield, and downtime data into a prioritized improvement backlog and closing gaps to full-rate production.
* Act as the first-line technical escalation point for production, leading structured problem-solving methodologies including 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa, and Shainin.
* Make containment decisions in partnership with Production and Quality.
* Design and validate error-proofing, including poka-yoke, in-line verification, torque and force-displacement monitoring, and part traceability.
* Build the process data foundation through SPC on critical characteristics, MES and traceability systems, and statistical monitoring.
* Support customer and supplier interfaces, including sequenced JIT/JIS delivery requirements, customer-specific requirements, supplier PPAP for incoming components, and problem-solving with equipment and component suppliers.
* Contribute to safety and compliance activities involving high-voltage work practices, permanent magnet handling, press and laser safety, chemical and adhesive handling, ergonomics, and EHS risk assessments.
* Train and coach production technicians and operators on process fundamentals, critical parameters, troubleshooting, and reaction plans.

## Required Qualifications

* MSc or equivalent engineering degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronic, Manufacturing, Materials, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of **5–10 years of process engineering experience** in high-volume manufacturing, ideally within automotive powertrain/components, electric motors, electronics, or comparable takt-driven assembly environments.
* Hands-on production-floor experience with direct ownership of a manufacturing process at rate—not solely process design or engineering experience.
* Strong working knowledge of takt-based manufacturing, including cycle-time analysis, line balancing, OEE, bottleneck analysis, and downtime reduction.
* Practical experience using statistical tools including SPC, DOE, MSA/Gage R&R, and capability analysis with tools such as Minitab, JMP, Python, or R.
* Strong command of automotive quality methodologies, including PFMEA, control plans, 8D, root-cause analysis, APQP, and PPAP.
* Ability to work effectively with manufacturing data from MES, SCADA, historians, traceability systems, and test databases.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to confidently defend technical positions with management, customers, and suppliers.
* **Ability and willingness to relocate to Saudi Arabia and reside in KSA for the full project duration, anticipated from September 2026 through December 2027.**
* **Ability to work 100% onsite at the client’s manufacturing facility throughout the assignment.**

## Preferred Qualifications

* Direct experience with electric motor, e-axle, or power electronics manufacturing.
* Experience supporting a greenfield launch or major capacity ramp, including commissioning, qualification, run-at-rate, SOP, and ramp to full production.
* IATF 16949 experience and exposure to customer-specific requirements and customer audits.
* Experience supplying a vehicle assembly plant under JIT or JIS sequenced delivery requirements.
* Joining-process expertise relevant to e-drives, including laser welding, ultrasonic or wire bonding, sintering, press-fit, and interference joining.
* Technical cleanliness experience under ISO 16232 / VDA 19 and ESD control.
* High-voltage certification or qualification to work on HV systems.
* Lean or Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt).
* Experience with automation, robotics, and vision systems.
* Previous experience working internationally or within the Middle East is beneficial but not required.

## How You Work

* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and incomplete data—a production ramp does not wait for perfect information.
* Strong bias toward the production floor: you go and see, measure, investigate, and build conclusions from evidence.
* Rigorous about documentation and change control because a process that is not documented cannot effectively be transferred or scaled.
* Collaborative across functions and cultures and able to maintain and defend a technical position under pressure.
* Comfortable working as part of an international, multicultural team while embedded onsite with the client.

## What Success Looks Like

* Your process area is qualified, run-at-rate is passed, and PPAP is submitted and approved according to customer timing.
* Stations within your perimeter maintain net cycle time within takt allocation, with OEE meeting or exceeding the ramp plan.
* First-pass yield follows the planned ramp curve, with top scrap and rework drivers ranked, understood, and actively addressed.
* Zero customer line stoppages attributable to your process area; any escape has a verified root cause and permanent countermeasure rather than containment alone.
* Process documentation—including control plans, PFMEA, work instructions, parameter windows, and reaction plans—is complete, current, and actively used by production.
* Production technicians within your area are capable of operating and troubleshooting the process independently.

## Working Conditions & International Assignment Requirements

* This position requires **relocation to and residence in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for the duration of the project, currently anticipated from September 2026 through December 2027.**
* The position requires **full-time, 100% onsite presence** at the client’s manufacturing facility in Saudi Arabia.
* This is **not a remote, hybrid, fly-in/fly-out, or rotational assignment**.
* Candidates must be prepared to establish temporary residence in Saudi Arabia for the project period.
* Regular to full-time work will occur within production areas, dry rooms, and cleanrooms with associated PPE and gowning requirements.
* During commissioning, qualification, SOP, and ramp phases, flexibility in working hours and periodic shift or weekend support will be expected.
* No routine travel to equipment suppliers, partner plants, or R&D sites is currently anticipated.
* International assignment and work authorization requirements will apply based on candidate eligibility and project requirements.

## What We Offer

* Competitive salary/package plus completion bonus.
* The opportunity to play a key role in a major international greenfield manufacturing launch.
* A launch you can point to throughout your career: taking a manufacturing operation from installation and commissioning through SOP and full-rate production.
* Structured training on technology and process methods, with exposure to the full manufacturing value stream.
* The opportunity to work directly with an international client and cross-functional engineering teams on a high-profile project in Saudi Arabia.

description:
Aljomaih Energy and Water Company (AEW) develops, invests in, owns and operates conventional power generation, renewable power and water desalination assets in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the wider region largely through project-specific special purpose vehicles (SPVs) and joint ventures with domestic and international partners.

The Internal Audit & Risk Management function provides independent and objective assurance and advisory services designed to add value and improve AEW's operations. The function reports functionally to the Board Audit Committee and administratively to the Chief Executive Officer.

This role supports the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management across corporate functions, project companies and joint venture entities and is expected to operate credibly with senior management, external auditors, regulators, lenders and shareholder representatives.

**Overview**

The Manager, Internal Audit & Risk Management plays a critical role in upholding AEW's ethical, governance and operational integrity. The role plans and executes risk-based internal audits, supports the design and operation of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework, and advises management on effective risk mitigation and control improvement.

The role requires a proactive mindset, strong analytical and report-writing skills, sound judgement in sensitive situations and a working understanding of the utilities development industry - in particular conventional power, renewable power and water projects and the contractual and financing structures through which they are delivered.

**Your Job Functions (Duties & Responsibilities)**

**Internal Audit**

1.  Plan & Execute: Support the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management in developing the annual risk-based internal audit plan and independently manage and execute internal audits engagement within your assigned area of responsibility.
2.  Evaluate & Improve: Conduct comprehensive audits of various business functions, processes and controls, evaluating their effectiveness and identifying areas for improvement.
3.  Compliance & Reporting: Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations and company policies, and prepare clear and concise audit reports that communicate findings, recommendations and remediation plans to senior management and the Board Audit Committee.
4.  Follow-up & Monitoring: Monitor and track the implementation of agreed-upon audit recommendations, ensuring timely and effective resolution of identified issues.
5.   Policies and Procedures Review: Assist in the review and improvement of company-wide policies, procedures, and management practices.

**Project, Contract and Capital Expenditure Audits**

1.  Audit the project development lifecycle from origination and bid through to financial close, construction, commissioning and handover to operations.
2.   Contract Assurance: Review compliance with EPC, O&M, PPA/WPA, shareholder and financing agreements, including obligations, milestones, liquidated damages, warranties, insurance and reporting covenants.
3.  Capex & Claims: Verify progress payments, variation orders, claims, change management and contingency utilization against contractual entitlement and approved budgets.
4.  SPV & JV Governance: Assess governance, delegation of authority and control arrangements at project companies and joint ventures, including access rights available to AEW under shareholder agreements.

Risk Management

1.  Plan & Execute: Support the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management in developing the annual plan to support, manage and execute risk management engagements within your assigned area of responsibility
2.  ERM Framework: Collaborate with the Head of Internal Audit & Risk Management and senior management to develop, implement & maintain the company's ERM framework, encompassing risk identification, assessment, mitigation and monitoring processes.
3.  Risk Assessment & Mitigation: Conduct regular risk assessments to identify and evaluate potential risks facing the company, considering likelihood, impact and cascading effects. Develop and implement effective risk mitigation plans aligned with the overall ERM strategy and internal controls framework.
4.  Risk Communication & Monitoring: Maintain an updated risk register and ensure consistent communication of risks to relevant stakeholders. Integrate risk management activities with internal audit processes.
5.  Emerging Risks: Analyze emerging risks and trends, proactively adapt the ERM framework and annual plans to address them.

**Advisory and Ad hoc Engagement**

* Ensure the smooth and effective execution of all Ad hoc or advisory engagements once assigned within expected turnaround time and quality of deliverables.

This is a required management position under GACAR Part 121.45. • Qualified through training, experience and expertise in aviation safety management.

A competitive package with relocation support where applicable, and the opportunity to build a premium airline certificate from the ground up as part of a fast-growing multi-AOC group.

job_title: Housekeeping Manager, Four Seasons Red Sea Resort
description:
**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.           
  
At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**

Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs.

**About the Role:**  
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Housekeeping Manager to join our team at Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts – Red Sea. This role is responsible for leading the housekeeping operations, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, presentation, and guest satisfaction across the resort.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage all housekeeping operations, including guest rooms, public areas, and laundry
* Ensure exceptional cleanliness and presentation standards are consistently maintained
* Conduct regular inspections of rooms and public areas
* Train, coach, and develop the housekeeping team to deliver outstanding service
* Manage schedules, staffing levels, and departmental budgets
* Coordinate with Engineering and Front Office to ensure seamless operations
* Monitor inventory, control costs, and manage supplies effectively
* Handle guest feedback and resolve concerns in a timely and professional manner

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Minimum 2 years’ experience as a Housekeeping Manager
* Resort experience is highly preferred
* Previous experience in a luxury hotel environment is an advantage
* Strong leadership and team management skills
* Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-standard environment

**What We Offer:**

* Accommodation and transportation provided by the hotel.
* Medical insurance.
* Schooling allowance.
* Opportunity to be part of a prestigious pre-opening team at the Red Sea
* Career growth within Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts
* Competitive salary and benefits
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment

  

Dedicated to perfecting the travel experience through continual innovation and the highest standards of hospitality, Four Seasons can offer what many hospitality professionals dream of -the opportunity to build a life-long career with global potential and a real sense of pride in work well done.

- Action Planning: Propose strategic recommendations and a phased DevSecOps Implementation

- Resource Manager (ARM) to ensure consistency and scalability.

We are looking for a motivated Mechanical Sales Engineer based in Jeddah to join our Industrial Reliability & NDT Inspection Solutions Division.

As a Mechanical Sales Engineer, you will be responsible for promoting and selling Reliability Maintenance and NDT Inspection solutions within the industrial sector, based on customer requirements and in line with current market standards and the latest technologies.
The role will involve identifying and developing new business opportunities, establishing new customer relationships, maintaining existing client satisfaction, and supporting pre-sales activities, including product and solution presentations. • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Reliability Maintenance and/or Welding Inspection.

• Previous experience in Technical Sales, Industrial Products, Engineering Solutions, or B2B Sales is preferred.

• Experience in Customer Relationship Management and Business Development is an advantage.

• Experience in selling or supporting Reliability, NDT Inspection, or industrial engineering solutions is highly desirable.

Skills & Competencies Required

• Familiarity with key industrial sectors, including Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals, Energy, Power Generation, Water Desalination, Mining, and Infrastructure.

• Good understanding of industrial asset safety, integrity, reliability, and operational efficiency.

• Ability to identify prospective customers, generate and convert sales leads, understand customer requirements, and achieve sales targets.

• Strong business development, prospecting, and account qualification skills.

• Client-oriented with strong negotiation, persuasion, objection-handling, and customer relationship management skills.

• Ability to understand customer requirements and propose appropriate technical and commercial solutions.

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to demonstrate and present products and solutions to customers.

• Ability to develop and maintain long-term customer relationships and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.

• Willingness to stay up to date with product knowledge, sales processes, business flows, market standards, and the latest technologies.

• Advanced proficiency in English, including reading, writing, and speaking.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, with good knowledge of data analysis, sales metrics, and reporting.

• Strong planning, organization, follow-up, and reporting skills.

• Professional appearance and demeanor.

• Valid Saudi driving license and willingness to travel according to business requirements.

Over 100,000 merchants run their businesses on Salla, and every one of them moves through a journey: discovering us, onboarding, publishing a first product, making a first sale, growing or stalling. This role owns that journey end to end, strategy and execution in one person.

It is the rare lifecycle seat where you inherit the raw material most lifecycle marketers spend years wishing for: tens of thousands of merchants, rich behavioral data from signup to sale, direct channels into every one of them, and a mandate to build the system your way rather than optimize someone else's. You will own the stages, cohorts, and triggers that define the merchant journey, and the campaigns across email, WhatsApp, push, and in-app that move merchants from one stage to the next. The mandate is clear: turn merchant data into personalized, high-converting journeys that activate, retain, and grow every store on the platform.

You will drive impact across three major domains:

* **Lifecycle Strategy and Architecture** (stage definitions, segmentation, behavioral triggers, the consolidated journey map)
* **Hands-On Execution and Experimentation** (campaigns you build and ship yourself in the tooling, disciplined testing, outcomes tied to activation, retention, and customer lifetime value)
* **AI-Forward Personalization at Scale** (AI-assisted content and workflow systems that keep the operation lean)

### Responsibilities:

* Design and own the full merchant lifecycle: acquisition, onboarding, activation, growth, retention, win-back.
* Define segmentation, build cohorts, and set the behavioral triggers that move merchants forward and reduce drop-off.
* Build and ship campaigns hands-on across email, WhatsApp, push, and in-app.
* Run a rigorous experimentation roadmap: controlled tests, holdout groups, and success metrics tied to activation, retention, and customer lifetime value, not vanity opens and clicks.
* Design dynamic, personalized content and connect it across tools and data sources so the right message reaches the right merchant at the right moment.
* Scale content and personalization through AI-assisted workflows with low operational dependency.
* Keep the whole system consolidated, coherent, and continuously optimized: you own the journey map, not just campaigns.

The IT Change Manager is accountable for governing and facilitating the Change Management process across the organization, ensuring that all IT changes — from standard to emergency — are assessed, authorized, implemented, and reviewed in a controlled and risk-managed manner.

YOU WILL  

»       Own and operate the end-to-end Change Management process in alignment with ITIL best practices and organizational policy.  

»       Chair and facilitate the Change Advisory Board (CAB) and Emergency CAB (ECAB) meetings, ensuring effective risk assessment and authorization of changes.  

»       Review, evaluate, and approve or reject Request for Change (RFC) submissions based on risk, impact, and resource availability.  

»       Maintain the Change Schedule (Forward Schedule of Change — FSC) and coordinate change windows with operational teams.  

»       Assess the risk and business impact of proposed changes, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies and rollback plans are in place.  

»       Identify conflicts, dependencies, and potential clashes between concurrent changes across infrastructure, applications, and services.  

»       Ensure changes align with organizational risk appetite and regulatory obligations.  

»       Communicate approved changes and their impact to all relevant stakeholders in a timely and clear manner.  

»       Act as the primary liaison between technical teams and business units during planned changes, upgrades, and service windows.  

»       Produce clear, concise Change Management reports and post-implementation reviews (PIRs) for leadership.  

»       Define, maintain, and continuously improve Change Management policies, processes, procedures, and templates.  

»       Ensure all change activities are properly documented, auditable, and compliant with governance and regulatory requirements.  

»       Identify and remediate unauthorized changes (change without authorization — CWA) and enforce process adherence.  

»       Collaborate with Incident and Problem Management to identify change-related incidents and prevent recurrence.  

»       Administer and optimize the Change Management module within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira SM, BMC Remedy).  

»       Produce KPI dashboards, trend analysis, and SLA performance reports for senior management.  

»       Drive automation and adoption of pre-approved and standard change models to increase operational agility

»       Proven experience chairing CAB meetings and managing complex, high-risk change processes.  

»       Strong proficiency with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or BMC Remedy.  

»       Solid understanding of enterprise IT environments, including infrastructure, cloud, networking, and applications.  

»       Demonstrated ability to balance governance rigor with business agility in a fast-moving environment.

»       Experience implementing Change Enablement in DevOps or CI/CD-driven environments.  

»       Familiarity with release management, deployment pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.  

»       Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as ISO 20000, SOX, ISO 27001, or COBIT.  

»       Project Management certification (PMP, PRINCE2) is a plus.

**Role Overview:**

RLB is seeking a highly capable and proactive Contracts Manager to support the commercial delivery of a major project (Post Contract). The role is responsible ensuring the effective implementation of contractual obligations, protection of the client's commercial interests, and successful delivery of contractual and commercial outcomes.

Acting as a trusted advisor, the Contract Manager provides strategic contractual guidance throughout project execution, managing variations, claims, Extension of Time (EOT) requests, commercial risks, dispute resolution, and contract close-out activities. The role requires strong client-facing capabilities and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and project teams.

The successful candidate will demonstrate initiative, accountability, and urgency, with the ability to independently drive commercial activities through to completion.

**Key Responsibilities:**  

1.  **Procurement**
    
    1.  Collaborate with the Procurement team to manage the tender process from invitation through to tender clarification and submission
        
    2.  Evaluate technical and commercial tender submissions and prepare tender evaluation reports
        
    3.  Manage the tender evaluation of future contracts through to contract award
        
    4.  Coordinate contract execution and contract deliverables following award.
        

2.  **Contract Administration**
    
    1.  Administer and manage contracts throughout the project lifecycle from contract award to final account.
        
    2.  Interpret contract provisions and advise clients project delivery team on contractual rights, obligations, risks, and entitlements.
        
    3.  Ensure compliance with contract requirements, governance procedures, and contractual obligations.
        
    4.  Monitor contractor and consultant performance against contractual commitments.
        
    5.  Maintain comprehensive contract records, notices, correspondence, and contractual documentation.
        
    6.  Identify contractual issues and recommend appropriate mitigation and resolution strategies.
        

3.  **Change Management and Variations**
    
    1.  Lead the administration and management of variations, change orders, compensation events, and contract amendments.
        
    2.  Assess contractual entitlement relating to changes in scope, time, cost, and risk.
        
    3.  Review and prepare variation submissions and supporting documentation.
        
    4.  Negotiate variations and commercial agreements with contractors and consultants.
        
    5.  Maintain variation registers and monitor approval status and financial impacts.
        
    6.  Ensure all contractual notification requirements are satisfied within prescribed timelines.
        

4.  **Claims and Extension of Time (EOT) Management**
    
    1.  Manage the preparation, evaluation, and negotiation of contractual claims.
        
    2.  Assess contractor and consultant claims for contractual entitlement, substantiation, and compliance.
        
    3.  Review Extension of Time (EOT) submissions and associated delay analyses.
        
    4.  Evaluate claims relating to prolongation costs, disruption, acceleration, and additional payment entitlement.
        
    5.  Develop strategies to protect the client's commercial position
        
    6.  Maintain accurate claims records and supporting evidence.
        

5.  **Payment and Commercial Administration**
    
    1.  Support the administration of interim and final payment processes in accordance with contract provisions.
        
    2.  Review payment applications, assessments, certifications, and commercial entitlements.
        
    3.  Ensure contractual payment obligations and timelines are properly managed.
        
    4.  Support final account negotiations and commercial settlements.
        
    5.  Monitor the commercial implications of project decisions, changes, and risks.
        

6.  **Contractual Correspondence and Notices**
    
    1.  Draft, review, and issue contractual notices, responses, instructions, and formal correspondence.
        
    2.  Ensure contractual communications comply with contract requirements and applicable regulations.
        
    3.  Monitor contractual deadlines, notice requirements, and critical milestones.
        
    4.  Maintain effective document control and contractual correspondence records.
        
    5.  Advise project teams on contractual communication strategies to preserve contractual rights and entitlements.
        

7.  **Commercial Risk Management**
    
    1.  Identify, assess, and manage contractual and commercial risks throughout project execution.
        
    2.  Establish and maintain contractual risk registers.
        
    3.  Advise clients and project teams on risk allocation and contractual exposure.
        
    4.  Develop mitigation strategies to minimise commercial and contractual risk.
        
    5.  Promote proactive dispute avoidance through timely identification and management of potential issues.
        

8.  **Client and Stakeholder Management**
    
    1.  Act as a key client-facing representative and trusted advisor on contractual and commercial matters.
        
    2.  Establish, develop, and maintain strong working relationships with clients and key project stakeholders.
        
    3.  Provide strategic contractual advice to senior client representatives and project leadership teams.
        
    4.  Lead contractual discussions, commercial negotiations, and stakeholder meetings.
        
    5.  Collaborate effectively with project managers, commercial teams, planners, legal advisors, engineers, and consultants.
        
    6.  Represent the organisation professionally during client engagements and contractual negotiations.
        

9.  **Dispute Avoidance and Resolution**
    
    1.  Support dispute avoidance initiatives through proactive contract management and early issue resolution.
        
    2.  Lead initial preparation of contractual positions, supporting documentation, and commercial assessments.
        
    3.  Assist in mediation, adjudication, dispute board proceedings, arbitration, and litigation where required.
        
    4.  Maintain robust records to support dispute resolution processes.
        

10.  **Contract Close-Out**
    
    1.  Manage contractual close-out activities through project completion.
        
    2.  Support the administration of completion, taking-over, and final acceptance processes.
        
    3.  Oversee contractual obligations during defects liability and warranty periods.
        
    4.  Facilitate final account agreement and resolution of outstanding commercial matters.
        
    5.  Ensure all contractual obligations are fully discharged and documented.
        
    6.  Prepare contract close-out reports and lessons learned documentation.
        

11.  **Reporting**
    
    1.  Prepare regular reports on contractual status, commercial performance, claims, variations, disputes, and risks.
        
    2.  Provide recommendations and advice to clients and project leadership teams.
        
    3.  Monitor contract management KPIs and project commercial performance.
        
    4.  Support governance reviews and executive reporting requirements.
        

**Person Specification:**

The ideal candidate will demonstrate a positive proactive approach to the role, and will be committed to delivering customer service excellence, with good commercial results.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Construction Management, Engineering, Law, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience managing multiple stakeholders across multidisciplinary project teams.
    
* Flexibility and adaptability in responding to changing business requirements.

* Sound professional judgement and decision-making capabilities.

* High level of commercial awareness and attention to detail.
    
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and conflict-resolution capabilities.

* Experience in pre-clinical research or animal imaging business in the region.

description:
At H&P, our people are our strength.

### Key Responsibilities

* Monitor live drilling rig operations remotely via CCTV during 12-hour day or night shifts.
* Observe critical and high-risk activities, including casing runs, rig moves, lifting operations, well control, and maintenance work.
* Identify unsafe acts, hazardous conditions, procedural deviations, and equipment positioning issues in real time.
* Initiate immediate interventions and communicate safety concerns directly to rig leadership.
* Escalate unaddressed risks through established reporting channels.
* Identify, track, and report Serious Injury & Fatality (SIF) potential events and near misses.
* Prepare CCTV observation reports with supporting photographic/video evidence.
* Maintain accurate monitoring logs and conduct detailed shift handovers.
* Analyze safety trends and provide recommendations to support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support HSE Assurance teams through weekly reporting, trend analysis, and proactive risk management.

### Required Qualifications & Experience

* Former Rig Manager, Night Rig Manager, or senior drilling operations leader.
* Minimum 5-8 years of land drilling industry experience.
* Strong track record in HSE leadership, incident prevention, and safety culture development.
* In-depth knowledge of drilling rig operations, equipment, and high-risk activities.
* Strong understanding of Safe Systems of Work (SSOW), including:
    * Permit to Work (PTW)
    * Job Safety Analysis (JSA) and Risk Assessment
    * LOTOTO / Isolation Procedures
    * DROPS Prevention
    * Work at Height
    * Confined Space Entry
    * Safe Lifting Operations
    * Hazardous Area Controls
    * PPE Requirements
* Ability to recognize line-of-fire, red-zone, lifting, pressure testing, and well control hazards.
* Experience monitoring critical operations such as tripping, casing running, cementing, rig-up/down, pressure testing, and heavy lifting.
* Proficient in CCTV monitoring systems, MS Office applications, and digital reporting tools.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to provide clear, timely, and professional safety notifications.

Thank you for your interest in joining our team!

  

For more than 100 years, Helmerich & Payne (H&P) has expanded drilling operations to meet the increasing demands of a complex and globalized industry. But our industry is changing, with software, algorithms and automation playing a more important role than ever before.

  
We are committed to being a partner to our customers in their operations by providing custom drilling solutions and technologies that don’t just meet, but exceed, their evolving goals and expectations.  
It’s this commitment that drives us to invest in the brightest people and the most advanced technologies, to support our customers’ operations every step of the way.

​The HYCO Shift Supervisor is accountable for managing and supervising the operations staff which include Boardman, Lead Operators and Field Operators for the facility having two HYCO Steam Methane Reformer, one Off-Gas PSA facility & Hydrogen Import Pipeline Facility. The HYCO Shift Supervisor will manage the day-to-day shift operations which include daily customer production meetings, insuring daily operational targets are achieved, interfacing with the Maintenance and Engineering teams to ensure the safe and reliable operation of the site. The HYCO Shift Supervisor will be responsible to ensure the Operations staff is properly trained to support the operations in addition to the incumbent execute daily tasks which include preparing and implementing safety work permits, LOTO, complete operations preventative maintenance activities, and assist the maintenance and engineering teams in preparing and executing corrective maintenance activities. This position is an extension of the operating team and is expected to engage in all plant operations and ensure tasks performed safely.

**PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

**Safety:**

* Provide & maintain a safe work environment.  Demonstrate leadership with all company & industry safe work processes to prevent injuries.

**Technical:**

* Provide direction to the staff of the HYCO Steam Methane Reformer unit and ancillary equipment as prescribed by the Work Instruction Procedures. Operate the unit when required.
    
* Provide direction & guidance based on technical feedback from Assistant Site Manager, Site Manager, Engineering and Maintenance for troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and test activities.
    
* Provide Operations support, guidance & lead the team during the startups, shutdowns and emergencies of the plants.  Maintain accurate document control and monitor quality assurance initiatives.
    
* Provide Operations guidance to ensure safety, reliability and maintainability of equipment, processes, utilities, facilities, controls, and safety/security systems.
    
* Provide Operations input for scheduled outages to ensure contractual requirements are achieved
    
* Manage plant production efficiently based on data driven decisions to ensure safety and reliability targets are met to achieve maximum profitable.
    
* Work closely with Shift Team, Assistant Site Manager, Site Manager, Maintenance Team and Engineering team to ensure production targets are achieved in his shift, plant running at optimum energy efficiency and safely.
    

**Operations:**

* Ensure the safety of all operations personnel by utilizing the APQ Basic Safety Practice program, which includes Safety Work Permits, LOTO, Confined Space, etc.  The position facilitates planning, organizing, auditing, and follow-up, to build the Air Products safety culture into the APQ.
    
* Ensure all Environmental Regulatory requirements are met.
    
* Ensure compliance to all CM, PM tasks.
    
* Support and prepare for Shutdown Planning and Turnaround Planning.
    
* Ensure Air Products and APQ standards, and global best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality, and overall customer services are met
    
* Meet the customer’s satisfaction on safety, reliability, product quality, and flexibility on product supply.
    
* Build the plant technical capability through support coordination from Assistant Site Manager, Site Manager, Maintenance Team and Engineering team.
    
* Provide coaching and motivation to the operations team to achieve operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
    
* Develop, train, and promote top performing personnel who achieve success through teams, customer and employee focused, foster open communication, performance driven, and results oriented.
    
* Establish & maintain close working relationships with engineering and maintenance personnel to continuously monitor & evaluate plant systems & equipment through a Plant Process Advisory Model.
    
* Provide operations support and participate / lead incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis.  Identify & implement sustainable corrective action(s).
    
* Act as the Single Point of Contact when dealing with internal issues of the HYCO units, representing APQ and coordinating internal resources.  Provide timely progress updates to the customer.
    
* Facilitate attainment of operations excellence and customer satisfaction via operations productivity, reliability, quality, cost reduction, services, continuous improvements, and meeting of budgets.
    
* Maintain a relationship with the customer’s counterparts from other Refinery Units where from APQ either receiving Feedstock, Utilities & Power or supplying Hydrogen and Steam to different Refinery Units on a regular basis through Refinery Shift Superintendent to ensure alignment of expectations for APQ and the customers current and future product demand.
    

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemical, Mechanical, or Chemical Process Operations preferred.  An associate technical degree (2 year certificate) will be considered based on years of experience and competence.
    
* Experience in gas, petrochemical, or related industries in operations, engineering, and/or a maintenance function. Demonstrated HYCO knowledge a plus, with a minimum of 10 years’ experience with 4 + years in line supervision of process operations roles.
    
* Expectation based on level of experience for the operations team to achieve a ‘Level 1 / Board Level’ status within 2 – 4 years.  Operators will be evaluated during the training period and placed at the level of competence accordingly. All the operations team are considered field and board operators when Level 1 is achieved.  Leadership positions are expected to follow the progression process.
    
* The HYCO Operations Supervisor is an extension of the operating team and is expected to engage in plant operations when required.
    
* Proven coordination experience in a multi team environment which includes operations, engineering, and maintenance.
    
* Good leadership, interpersonal and teamwork skills with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively throughout all levels within the organization and externally.
    
* Promotes a ‘one team’ environment.
    
* Ability to communicate and manage customer interactions on a daily basis.
    
* Wide technical knowledge in operations, engineering, and maintenance activities.
    
* Proficiency in English speaking and writing.
    
* Knowledge and understanding of local environmental and health and safety requirements.

We are seeking a Director of Waste to join JASARA PMC. The **Director – Waste Management** provides strategic asset management leadership for City’s integrated waste management portfolio, ensuring waste assets, infrastructure, systems, service models, and commercial arrangements are planned, governed, optimised, and assured across the full asset lifecycle. The role defines the long-term strategy, value framework, lifecycle standards, investment requirements, regulatory assurance model, and performance management approach required to enable safe, sustainable, cost-effective, and future-ready waste management services at city scale.

The Director is accountable for developing and governing a circular, digitally enabled, and commercially robust waste asset management system covering municipal solid waste, recyclables, organics, construction and demolition waste, event waste, hazardous waste, special waste streams, transfer stations, treatment facilities, recycling infrastructure, digital platforms, and final disposal interfaces.

The role sets the strategic direction for waste asset planning, lifecycle investment, asset information, service procurement strategy, operational readiness assurance, risk management, stakeholder alignment, resource recovery, and continuous improvement, ensuring alignment with asset management framework, sustainability ambitions, Saudi regulatory requirements, Vision 2030 priorities, and international best practice.

### Key Responsibilities

**1\. Strategic Leadership, Governance & Operating Model**

· Set the long-term waste management vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model for City.

· Own waste governance frameworks, policies, technical standards, procedures, assurance controls, and performance reporting.

· Translate sustainability, ESG, circular economy, and smart city ambitions into practical waste management programmes.

· Provide executive-level recommendations, decision papers, business cases, risk reports, and performance dashboards.

· Ensure waste management requirements are embedded into master planning, design reviews, asset handover, operations readiness, and event planning.

 **2\. Waste Asset Strategy, Planning & Service Model**

· Develop and maintain the waste asset management strategy, including asset vision, service outcomes, asset hierarchy, criticality framework, lifecycle objectives, demand forecasts, and future capacity requirements.

· Translate city masterplan growth, visitor volumes, resident populations, event profiles, tenant requirements, and precinct phasing into long-term waste infrastructure, service, and investment requirements.

· Define target levels of service for waste assets and service interfaces, including availability, resilience, capacity, customer experience, environmental performance, accessibility, scalability, and cost-to-serve.

· Lead strategic options analysis for future service models, including in-house capability, outsourced providers, framework contracts, concessions, public-private partnerships, and integrated city-wide service platforms.

· Establish waste asset planning requirements for new developments, precincts, venues, events, hospitality zones, retail areas, public realm, residential communities, and back-of-house logistics corridors.

· Set standards for asset design, maintainability, operability, safe access, storage capacity, segregation infrastructure, collection interfaces, transfer facilities, treatment interfaces, and digital connectivity.

· Develop lifecycle investment plans covering renewal, replacement, upgrade, expansion, obsolescence, risk mitigation, technology refresh, and resilience improvements across the waste asset portfolio.

· Ensure waste asset strategies are integrated with facilities management, utilities, transport, logistics, real estate, sustainability, development delivery, HSE, security, events, and commercial planning functions.

· Provide strategic assurance that proposed assets, systems, contracts, and service models remain fit for purpose across phased opening, growth, peak demand periods, and long-term operating horizon.

**3\. Sustainability, Circular Economy & Resource Value Strategy**

· Define waste hierarchy strategy, circular economy roadmap, and resource value framework, prioritising prevention, reduction, reuse, segregation, recycling, recovery, and responsible disposal.

· Develop material flow strategies for municipal solid waste, recyclables, organics, food waste, construction and demolition waste, hazardous waste, event waste, landscape waste, and special waste streams.

· Set long-term diversion, recovery, contamination reduction, reuse, carbon reduction, and circularity targets aligned with ESG commitments, Vision 2030 priorities, Saudi regulations, and international best practice.

· Identify strategic resource recovery opportunities, including recycling markets, organics processing, composting, anaerobic digestion, waste-to-energy, material recovery facilities, reverse logistics, and producer responsibility partnerships.

· Lead business case development for circular economy infrastructure, assessing whole-life cost, environmental benefits, commercial returns, regulatory implications, technology maturity, land requirements, and operational interfaces.

· Establish policies, standards, and performance requirements for segregation at source, tenant waste management, public realm recycling, event waste planning, construction waste recovery, and contractor reporting.

· Create mechanisms to track resource value, including recovered material volumes, avoided disposal cost, revenue potential, carbon impact, contamination levels, market demand, and contribution to sustainability reporting.

· Partner with development, procurement, commercial, design, tenant management, events, hospitality, and sustainability teams to embed circular economy principles into assets, leases, vendor requirements, and operating standards.

· Provide strategic advice on emerging waste technologies, policy changes, circular economy partnerships, innovation pilots, and investment opportunities that improve long-term resource productivity and environmental outcomes.

**4\. Asset Information, Smart Systems & Digital Strategy**

· Define the waste asset information strategy, ensuring all assets, systems, facilities, equipment, digital devices, service interfaces, and treatment/disposal links are captured within a structured asset register and aligned to the enterprise asset management framework.

· Establish data standards for asset hierarchy, location, ownership, condition, criticality, lifecycle status, capacity, performance, maintenance strategy, warranty, risk, cost, and compliance attributes.

· Develop requirements for GIS mapping, spatial asset data, precinct-level waste infrastructure mapping, collection point visibility, transfer station interfaces, treatment facility data, and integration with city-wide planning systems.

· Set the strategic roadmap for smart waste technologies, including IoT-enabled bins and compactors, fill-level sensors, weighbridge systems, RFID tagging, route optimisation, fleet telematics, smart collection points, and automated reporting tools.

· Define integration requirements between waste systems, enterprise asset management platforms, CAFM/CMMS systems, ERP, command centre platforms, digital twin environments, sustainability dashboards, and regulatory reporting systems.

· Create dashboards and performance intelligence requirements covering asset availability, utilisation, condition, lifecycle risk, service demand, waste generation, diversion, contamination, contractor performance, cost-to-serve, and carbon impact.

· Use data analytics to support strategic decisions on asset renewal, service model optimisation, investment prioritisation, demand forecasting, capacity planning, technology deployment, risk mitigation, and circular economy performance.

· Establish data governance controls, including data ownership, quality assurance, validation routines, change control, audit trails, reporting cadence, cybersecurity considerations, and minimum data requirements for contractors and developers.

· Ensure digital requirements are embedded in design briefs, procurement specifications, contracts, handover packages, commissioning plans, operating procedures, and lifecycle information requirements.

· Promote insight-led asset management by converting operational data, service trends, technology outputs, customer feedback, regulatory requirements, and sustainability metrics into strategic improvement plans and investment recommendations.

**5\. Authority & Regulatory Compliance**

· Ensure compliance with Saudi environmental regulations and waste management laws.

· Act as senior interface with regulators, competent authorities, developers, operators, contractors, and strategic partners including:

Ø  National Center for Waste Management (MWAN)

Ø  Ministry of Environment, Water & Agriculture (MEWA)

Ø  Local municipalities and regulatory authorities

· Oversee compliance assurance for:

Ø  Permits and licensing

Ø  Environmental audits and reporting

Ø  Hazardous waste handling compliance

**6\. Asset Lifecycle Management & Infrastructure Strategy**

· Develop and govern strategic asset management plans for waste infrastructure, including transfer stations, recycling facilities, treatment assets, storage areas, compactors, collection points, hazardous waste facilities, fleet interfaces, digital systems, and disposal/treatment partnerships.

· Define lifecycle strategies for each major waste asset class, covering planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, mobilisation, operation, maintenance, renewal, upgrade, repurposing, decommissioning, and end-of-life transition.

Residential Apartment Feasibility Leadership

Financial Modeling & Unit Economics

* Build, review, and manage detailed financial models for apartment projects, incorporating:

* Unit level revenues and sales phasing

* Construction and development costs

* Cashflow timing, IRR, NPV, and sensitivity analysis

Cross‑Functional Coordination

* Act as the primary financial interface for apartment projects through internal stage gate approvals

* Clearly articulate risks, sensitivities, and mitigation strategies related to apartment developments

* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams
