Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Temporary Works Manager** **(Saudi National)** to join our Team!

The Temporary Works Manager will provide technical and managerial leadership for all temporary works activities across the Airport / Infrastructure / Airfield project. The role will be responsible for the planning, coordination, design review, approval, implementation, inspection, and control of temporary works to ensure they are safe, structurally adequate, constructible, and compliant with project requirements.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Lead and manage all temporary works activities across the project.
    
* Establish and maintain the project Temporary Works Management System and procedures.
    
* Develop temporary works strategies, design requirements, approval processes, and control procedures.
    
* Identify temporary works requirements during planning, design, construction, and sequencing stages.
    
* Review and coordinate temporary works design briefs and ensure appropriate design responsibility is established.
    
* Manage the temporary works register and maintain accurate records of all temporary works.
    
* Review and coordinate temporary works designs prepared by internal teams, consultants, and specialist contractors.
    
* Ensure temporary works designs are independently checked and approved in accordance with project procedures.
    
* Provide technical oversight for temporary structures, excavation support, access systems, temporary platforms, scaffolding, formwork, falsework, shoring, propping, temporary bridges, and other construction support systems.
    
* Review design calculations, drawings, specifications, assumptions, loading conditions, and construction methodologies for temporary works.
    
* Ensure temporary works designs consider construction loads, environmental conditions, wind, vibration, equipment loads, and other applicable forces.
    
* Coordinate temporary works requirements with permanent works design to avoid clashes and ensure compatibility.
    
* Review temporary works proposals for constructability, practicality, safety, and ease of installation and removal.
    
* Coordinate with Construction teams to ensure temporary works are installed in accordance with approved designs.
    
* Establish inspection and hold-point requirements for critical temporary works.
    
* Ensure temporary works are inspected before loading, use, modification, or removal.
    
* Monitor temporary works throughout their service period and ensure they remain safe and fit for purpose.
    
* Manage modifications, changes, and deviations from approved temporary works designs.
    
* Ensure revised temporary works are properly assessed, reviewed, and approved before implementation.
    
* Coordinate with HSE teams to identify and manage temporary works-related risks.
    
* Support risk assessments, method statements, and safe systems of work associated with temporary works.
    
* Investigate temporary works failures, defects, movement, instability, or unexpected site conditions and coordinate corrective actions.
    
* Provide technical support during complex construction activities and high-risk temporary works operations.
    
* Coordinate temporary works requirements for major lifting, excavation, structural construction, and access activities.
    
* Review temporary works interfaces with cranes, lifting equipment, heavy plant, access roads, and construction logistics.
    
* Ensure appropriate temporary works are provided for construction sequencing and phased project delivery.
    
* Monitor temporary works activities against project schedule and identify potential impacts on construction progress.
    
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Temporary Works Engineers, Coordinators, and site teams.
    
* Review and approve temporary works documentation in accordance with delegated authority.
    
* Coordinate with Client, Consultant, Contractors, and specialist temporary works designers.
    
* Participate in design reviews, constructability workshops, technical meetings, and construction planning sessions.
    
* Maintain complete temporary works records for project quality, safety, and handover requirements.
    

**Temporary Works Scope**

* Excavation Support & Shoring
    
* Temporary Retaining Systems
    
* Temporary Access Roads
    
* Temporary Bridges
    
* Temporary Platforms
    
* Scaffolding Systems
    
* Formwork & Falsework
    
* Temporary Propping & Bracing
    
* Structural Steel Temporary Works
    
* Temporary Foundations
    
* Crane Bases & Working Platforms
    
* Temporary Equipment Supports
    
* Temporary Protection Systems
    
* Cofferdams / Temporary Water Control
    
* Temporary Drainage
    
* Construction Access Systems
    
* Temporary Works Associated with Heavy Lifting
    
* Temporary Works for Structural Erection
    
* Temporary Works for Underground & Utility Construction
    

**Airport / Infrastructure & Airfield Responsibilities**

* Manage temporary works associated with airport terminals, airfield infrastructure, roads, utilities, drainage, structures, and external works.
    
* Review temporary works requirements for runway, taxiway, apron, and airfield construction activities.
    
* Ensure temporary access, working platforms, excavation support, and construction staging arrangements are suitable for heavy construction equipment.
    
* Coordinate temporary works around existing operational facilities and live infrastructure.
    
* Assess temporary works requirements where construction activities interface with existing utilities, roads, structures, and airport systems.
    
* Support phased construction and complex work sequencing in constrained airport environments.
    
* Review temporary works associated with district cooling plants, utility corridors, underground services, and major infrastructure installations.
    
* Coordinate temporary works requirements for heavy lifting and installation of major MEP and structural equipment.
    

**Temporary Works Management & Assurance**

* Maintain the Temporary Works Register and identify temporary works by risk and criticality.
    
* Establish appropriate design review and approval categories based on temporary works risk.
    
* Ensure competent designers and independent checkers are appointed for critical temporary works.
    
* Establish inspection, monitoring, and permit requirements for high-risk temporary works.
    
* Ensure temporary works are clearly identified, controlled, and communicated to site teams.
    
* Monitor temporary works condition throughout construction and establish inspection frequencies.
    
* Ensure safe dismantling and removal procedures are developed and approved.
    
* Maintain records of temporary works inspections, approvals, modifications, and closeout.
    
* Ensure lessons learned and recurring temporary works issues are captured and incorporated into project procedures.
    

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
    
* Minimum **15 years of relevant experience**, with significant experience in temporary works engineering and construction.
    
* Proven experience managing temporary works on major infrastructure, airport, industrial, commercial, or complex construction projects.
    
* Strong knowledge of temporary works design, construction methodology, structural engineering, excavation support, formwork, falsework, and temporary structures.
    
* Experience managing temporary works design processes, independent checking, approvals, and site implementation.
    
* Strong understanding of structural behavior, construction loads, stability, temporary conditions, and construction sequencing.
    
* Experience coordinating with specialist temporary works designers, contractors, consultants, and Client representatives.
    
* Strong knowledge of relevant international codes, standards, and temporary works best practices.
    
* Professional engineering registration or equivalent certification is preferred.
    
* Strong leadership and project management experience.

**Title:**

Electrical technician III

**ELECTRICAL TECHNICIAN III**

**CELE04 - Electrician, Helper IV**

KBR is a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers and we all share one goal of improving the World and Beyond: responsibly, and safely. We attract a diverse workforce and the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration.

KBR is looking for Electrical Technician who can Execute activities of maintenance focused in compliance with the preventive and predictive maintenance plan and an efficient and effective development of breakdown maintenance on electrical systems, equipment and facilities within his area of influence, applying the best and safe maintenance practices.

**Responsibilities:**

* Execute day to-day electrical maintenance activities on all electrical systems plant, equipment and facilities within the designated area of responsibility.
* Ensure, complies and applied SATORP's Safety and Quality procedures, during the execution of electrical maintenance activities.
* Ensure a proper execution of work and check on the activities engaged in routine maintenance activities.
* Carryout repairing and troubleshooting activities on electrical assets are carried out in timely and quality manner that helps increase the availability and reliability of these systems.
* Receive work directions from the respective Electrical Supervisor, in relation to electrical systems maintenance orders/requests.
* Follow-up on electrical maintenance work progress and submit regular progress reports to the respective Electrical Supervisor. Keep a record of daily maintenance works against planned maintenance programs and prepare work completion reports, where applicable.
* Enforce SATORP’s policies, procedures and regulations and ensure that all safety measures and precautions are strictly considered and taken care of during conducting maintenance works.
* Perform Preventive maintenance in HV and LV switchgear and control gears including testing of electronic protection relay, power circuit breaker, bus, bar contactors, motor starters, ATS.
* Perform the readings of partial discharge capacitor in HV motor.
* Perform on line analysis of current signature of motors.
* Perform testing on all kinds of transformers
* Support the switchgear operations in electrical substation when are request to do so
* Perform other related duties as assigned by his respective Electrical Leader.
* Proactive Safety aptitude and behavior.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Electrical systems.
* Good knowledge in Electrical equipment design, installation and maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining and repairing Mechanical and electro hydraulic systems
* Good knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance principles and working procedures.
* Strong knowledge of standards, procedures and regulation to develop activities taking care of Health, Safety and Environmental preservation
* Strong communication and people skills.
* Ability to perform work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Synergic and Capable of handling multiple tasks.
* Good commands oral and written English.  
    

**Qualifications:**

* Diploma holder in Engineering or equivalent
    
* Minimum 4 years’ experience in Oil & Gas maintenance – High School.
    
* Minimum 2 years’ experience in Oil & Gas maintenance – Diploma.
    
* Hold a valid certification issued by a recognized third-party certification body or an accredited Saudi institute, attesting to the individual’s qualifications and competency to perform the works.
    
* Strong technical understanding of maintenance management of Oil & Gas Facilities
    
* Well organized and proactive with excellent communication skills

Heavy Truck Driver

**Heavy Truck Driver**

**GTRN06 - Heavy Truck Driver**

KBR is looking for an **Heavy Truck Driver**\-  A truck driver works either for a company or under independent contracts who transports different types of merchandise from one place to another in a truck, van or any vehicle capable of carrying large loads. He may have to transport supplies, hazardous chemicals, manufacturing equipment.

  
**Responsibilities:**

* The primary responsibility of a truck driver is to haul cargo from one point   
    to another so that they can be distributed, bought or sold 
* inspect trucks for safety and follow the safety instructions, especially   
    when carrying hazardous materials or chemicals 
* He is also responsible for the condition of his vehicle and look for any   
    malfunctioning part 
* He must inspect the cargo to check whether it has been loaded correctly
* He must also review all the necessary shipping documents
* Some truck drivers get an extra driver who works under him and drives in   
    shifts to take off the pressure from one driver.
* Make sure for compliances of all safety procedures.
* Encourage reporting of unsafe acts and conditions
* Comply with all SHE procedures prior to commencement and during work.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 3 years’ experience in his field
    
* drivers need to be in good physical condition as they sometimes need to be on the road for days without rest 
    
* They should have knowledge of how to maintain the truck, in case it breaks down in the middle of nowhere
    
* They must be punctual and follow the schedule in order to transport the merchandise on time 
    
* They must also be very careful and follow the precautionary measures when carrying hazardous or fragile materials

description:

**Job Description:**

Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey.

The **Director for Roads and Car Parks** is the senior technical and operational leader responsible for the long-term performance, safety, and sustainability of the city’s horizontal transport infrastructure. As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for roads, car parks, and tunnels, this role oversees the operations, preventative maintenance, safety compliance, and asset lifecycle management of extensive road networks, structured and surface parking, and underground tunnel systems once construction is complete.

Operating within the giga-project environment, the Director ensures that transportation and parking infrastructure functions reliably, safely, and efficiently, supporting the broader mobility, community, and commercial needs of the development.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Oversee daily operations of the road network, including thousands of lane-kilometers of urban and arterial roads, ramps, bridges, and intersections.
* Manage the operational performance of underground tunnel networks (vehicular and service tunnels) and multi-story/surface car parks.
* Ensure high levels of availability, safety, and user experience across all transport and parking assets.
* Develop and implement long-term asset management plans for road pavements, tunnel structures, and parking facilities.
* Define lifecycle strategies for resurfacing, structural renewal, waterproofing, and rehabilitation to maximize asset lifespan.
* Use data from inspections, condition assessments, and performance monitoring to prioritize investments and interventions.
* Implement data-driven, preventive maintenance programs for roads (resurfacing, marking, drainage), tunnels (structural checks, systems testing), and car parks (structural health, equipment maintenance).
* Minimize emergency repairs by establishing predictive maintenance regimes based on asset condition, usage, and environmental factors.
* Coordinate with Facilities Management and maintenance vendors to ensure timely and effective execution of maintenance schedules.
* Serve as the technical authority for tunnel safety and systems, including mechanical ventilation, fire detection and suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation systems, and structural monitoring.
* Establish and enforce tunnel operating procedures, safety protocols, and inspection regimes in accordance with international standards.
* Coordinate with HSE and Civil Defense / Fire Authorities on compliance, drills, and emergency preparedness.
* Define and drive the strategy for smart car parks, including: Parking Guidance Systems (PGSPGS), Digital ticketing and integrated payment platforms, Electric Vehicle (EVEV) charging infrastructure
* License Plate Recognition (LPRLPR) and access control systems
* Oversee operational policies for parking allocation, pricing (if applicable), and circulation to maximize efficiency and user convenience.
* Review and provide input on civil and traffic engineering designs, upgrades, and modifications to optimize traffic flow and reduce congestion.
* Ensure design changes consider pedestrian safety, public transport interfaces, emergency access, and multimodal connectivity.
* Collaborate with planning and transport authorities on speed control, junction design, signage strategy, and traffic-calming measures.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering or related discipline
* A master’s degree is highly recommended
* Professional Engineering license/registration
* Additional certifications in asset management, tunnel engineering, or transportation systems (e.g., CEng, PMP, IAM) are an advantage.
* Minimum 20 years of progressive experience in road and transport infrastructure operations, asset management, or large-scale urban mobility projects.
* Significant hands-on experience with tunnel operations and safety systems, multi-story car parks, and large road networks in complex urban or mega-development environments.
* Proven track record in managing major OPEX/CAPEX budgets, specialized contractors, and technology-intensive transport assets.
* Demonstrated experience in traffic engineering, safety compliance, and emergency response planning.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are looking for a highly experienced **Design Manager** to join their team!

Within the Planning & Design Management stream and reporting to the Director of Infrastructure Planning & Design, the Design Manager will manage & coordinate the delivery of multi-disciplinary design across assigned projects, packages or asset scopes in accordance with brief, standards, budgets and delivery programs.

* Review and monitor design submissions for quality, completeness, coordination, and alignment with project requirements prior to approvals.
* Support the resolution of design clashes, technical queries, constructability issues, and cross-disciplinary coordination matters.
* Maintain design trackers, action logs, registers, approval workflows, and technical records to support effective governance and reporting.
* Apply standardized design management templates, tools, methodologies, and reporting procedures across assigned projects and monitor design progress against agreed milestones, schedules, and stage gate deliverables.•Coordinate interfaces between disciplines, infrastructure systems, assets, consultants, stakeholders, and delivery teams to ensure integrated outcomes.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* 10 years’ experience in design coordination or design management roles.
* Experience working with multi-di design consultants.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for a talented **Rolling Stock Engineer** to join our team. The Rolling Stock Engineer will be part of a team responsible for the technical integrity of the rolling stock, providing technical guidance on rolling stock design, development, and safety. The project includes at-grade, elevated, and underground tunnel rail sections, with passenger rolling stock operating under automatic operation. Reporting to the Lead Rolling Stock Engineer, the Rolling Stock Engineer will perform design reviews, facilitate the resolution of any construction or design issues, ensure contractual compliance, and ensure smooth integration with other systems such as signalling, platform screen doors, communications, and civil infrastructure. The chosen candidate will be an expert in the delivery of rolling stock and the acceptance of its assets.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Supporting the Lead Rolling Stock Engineer in project delivery by providing expert technical advice and support with regards to rolling stock to the wider project team
    
* Defining and developing interface specifications to support the supplier design
    
* Liaising with the project controls team to determine schedules and monitor design progress
    
* Establishing and maintaining adherence to project deliverables with respect to safety, quality, cost and schedule
    
* Analysing the  rolling stock related RAMS performance against the client’s design specifications
    
* Analysing the rolling stock related operation and maintenance.
    
* Reviewing and approving the Design Build contractor’s rolling stock system and sub-system designs to ensure compliance with the client’s requirements
    
* Reviewing and monitoring the rolling stock design specifications and standards for all subsystems such as  HVAC, door control, propulsion and control, auxiliary power, wiring, automatic train control (ATS),  carbody, brakes, couplers ,gangway and bogies
    
* Overseeing the assessment of differing train configurations, passenger capacity, interface problems and performance quantifications
    
* Coordinating and monitoring the rolling stock related interfaces and integration with other disciplines such as platform screen doors, signaling, telecoms and power  supply
    
* Conducting technical investigations or fault analyses
    
* Conducting site visit and inspections to verify and monitor rolling stock works quality and progress
    
* Ensuring all reporting requirements, are met and maintain accurate records concerning rolling stock related data
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Mechanical / Electrical Engineering degree, diploma or professional qualification
    
* Minimum 12 years mechanical engineering work experience
    
* Experience of working on large, complex and multidisciplinary projects
    
* Current or recent broad knowledge of the rail industry
    
* Significant technical experience relevant to the design delivery of the mechanical aspects of rolling stock
    
* Demonstrable experience in the design of rolling stock
    
* Strong understanding of railway approvals, practices and standards including EN 50126, EN 50129, IEC 61133, IEC1287 and NFPA 130
    
* Strong understanding of railway approvals, practices and standards including UIC- 615, UIC-515, IEC 61133 and NFPA 130,  EN12663,EN15827
    
* Railway interiors and paneling experience
    
* Working experience with Bombardier’s/Siemens rolling stock
    
* Chartered Engineer status
    
* Knowledge of rail communication concepts and principles
    
* Knowledge of overhead traction power reticulation systems
    
* Strong client-facing skills
    
* Excellent English language skills (written and verbal)

The **Senior Manager – City Operations AM Platform PMO** is the strategic program leader responsible for directing the Project Management Office (PMO) dedicated to the rollout, enhancement, and optimization of the city's centralized digital asset management ecosystem.

Instead of managing physical infrastructure assets or writing code, this role drives the governance, timelines, resources, and vendor performance required to deliver enterprise software solutions. This position ensures that all software system modules, engineering mobile apps, and smart city data integrations are deployed on time, within budget, and in perfect alignment with live city operations.

**What You'll Be Doing;**

* Formulate, maintain, and execute the master deployment schedule for all software features, system modules, and integration projects across the Asset Management (AM) platform ecosystem.
* Establish and enforce standardized project management frameworks, agile/waterfall methodologies, and status reporting templates for all internal tech teams and external consultants.
* Manage multi-million-dollar technology budgets, balancing software licensing, infrastructure hosting costs, and consulting resources to prevent timeline delays.
* Serve as the primary operational link between technical software developers, system architects, and live physical asset operators (e.g., Roads, Public Realms, Facilities Management).
* Coordinate data stream integrations to ensure the core AM platform seamlessly communicates with financial engines, service charge recovery systems, and smart city IoT hubs.
* Design and champion robust user-adoption programs, field-staff training curricula, and feedback loops to ensure a smooth transition from legacy processes to the new platform tools.
* Proactively track, log, and mitigate critical platform deployment risks, such as data migration discrepancies, system downtime, security vulnerabilities, and configuration delays.
* Build and maintain high-level executive dashboards, presenting transparent project health reports, budget variance data, and milestone readiness updates to steering committees and C-suite leadership.
* Drive post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned, eliminate project delivery friction, and boost future deployment speeds.
* Direct and manage the performance of master system integrators, software vendors, and tier-1 IT consultants.
* Audit external tech vendor deliverables against strict contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and milestones, initiating penalty or escalation protocols if delivery quality dips.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring;**

* **Bachelor’s Degree** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a closely related professional discipline.
* **Master’s Degree** or MBA with a focus on Technology Management or Project Portfolio Management is highly preferred.
* **Professional Certifications:** Mandatory possession of a Project Management Professional (**PMP**) or Program Management Professional (**PgMP**) credential. Active Agile/Scrum or **PRINCE2** certifications are highly desirable.
* Minimum of15+ years of progressive, hands-on experience leading technology-focused PMOs, large-scale enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, or enterprise asset management system (EAMS) rollouts.
* Proven track record of managing complex multi-vendor technology portfolios within mega-projects, major public utilities, transport authorities, or master-planned smart cities.
* Deep experience navigating change management challenges when transitioning traditional operations teams onto modern, automated digital platforms.
* Strong functional knowledge of major enterprise asset management platforms (e.g., SAP PM/MM, IBM Maximo, or equivalent integrated smart city software ecosystems).
* High proficiency in project portfolio management (PPM) software, resource scheduling programs, and advanced PMO dashboard tracking tools.
* Exceptional communication skills with a proven capability to translate deep technical IT jargon into clear, actionable business strategies for non-technical operations directors.
* Excellent negotiation skills with a history of holding premium international technology consultants accountable to aggressive delivery deadlines.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for a talented **Landscape Manager** to join our team. In this role, you will manage horticultural, softscape, forestry, planting, and landscape establishment works across a major development program, with specific responsibility for protecting and enhancing heritage assets and cultural landscapes, and integrating landscape information within the project’s BIM environment.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

**Horticulture, Softscape and Landscape Establishment**

* Manage horticultural, softscape, forestry, planting and landscape establishment activities across the project.
    
* Provide technical oversight on plant selection, tree species, nursery stock, soil preparation, planting methodology, irrigation requirements, fertilization, pruning, pest control and plant health.
    
* Review planting plans, landscape specifications, method statements, material submittals, inspection requests and contractor technical documentation.
    
* Monitor site works to ensure planting, tree works, soil works, irrigation interfaces and horticultural activities are delivered in line with approved designs, contract requirements and project quality standards.
    
* Inspect nursery stock, trees, palms, shrubs, groundcovers, turf and other plant materials to confirm quality, suitability and compliance before installation.
    
* Support tree management activities, including tree protection, relocation, replacement, establishment and long‑term maintenance planning.
    

**Heritage and Cultural Landscape Management**

* Conserve the topography and open spaces within heritage zones and associated cultural landscapes so that their character, identity and image are preserved for future generations.
    
* Safeguard architectural heritage interrelated with the cultural landscape by ensuring that landscape and open‑space works respect and foster the special character and heritage of the region.
    
* Ensure that heritage‑related landscape works comply with the Client sustainability program, Saudi heritage legislation and applicable UNESCO and ICOMOS conservation guidelines.
    
* Enhance the relationship between people and heritage places by creating landscape connections that respect and support heritage buildings, cultural landscapes and their settings.
    
* In heritage zones, review and support the design of new landscape and open‑space developments so they are located, designed and scaled to avoid any detrimental impact on existing heritage, cultural landscapes or their visual setting.
    
* Complement the existing heritage and cultural landscape through the design and implementation of new landscape works.
    
* Reinforce the historic urban fabric, settlement typologies and open‑space network through landscape design and development.
    
* Respect and plan for the inclusion of heritage sites in future phases of the overall development when coordinating landscape works.
    
* Support Client and the design consultants and contractors in preparing and implementing the project Design Brief for heritage‑related landscape works, ensuring that conservation principles and criteria are clearly defined and followed.
    
* Apply the project’s conservation principles to landscape interventions, ensuring that:
    
    * Conservation is approached cautiously when changing existing buildings and related landscapes.
        
    * Traditional setting, aesthetic and historic value are preserved.
        
    * Modern techniques are only used when necessary and are compatible with traditional materials, with interventions designed to be reversible where practicable.
        
    * Additions do not detract from significant parts of the heritage asset or unbalance the overall composition.
        
    * Each intervention is based on a clear understanding of the causes of damage and decay.
        
    * An incremental approach is followed, starting with a minimum level of intervention and allowing for subsequent supplementary measures if required.
        
    * Interventions are easily removable without damaging original structures or landscapes, reducing the risk of uncontrolled disorder following intervention.
        
    * Materials used in restoration and landscape works are as similar as possible to original materials from structural, functional and aesthetic points of view.
        
    * Authenticity and integrity of heritage landscapes are maintained to ensure long‑term access to cultural heritage richness.
        

**BIM Management and Digital Coordination (Landscape)**

* Represent the landscape discipline within the project BIM process to ensure that landscape information is fully included in BIM models used for coordination of geographical, architectural, civil, structural, infrastructure, utility services, landscape and specialist constructions.
    
* Coordinate with the PMC BIM team, design consultants and contractors so that landscape BIM models are developed, indexed and maintained in accordance with the approved WBS codification, required LOD and the BIM Execution Plan.
    
* Support the development and upkeep of landscape BIM models throughout the design process, and the transfer of the resulting models for use during procurement and construction.
    
* Contribute to QA/QC of modelled landscape information to ensure data integrity, correct codification and alignment with project documentation.
    
* Participate in BIM coordination meetings, using BIM tools to identify and help resolve clashes and interfaces involving landscape works.
    
* Support sustainability evaluation and other project analyses that depend on coordinated landscape BIM data.
    

**Coordination, Reporting and Compliance**

* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, supervision teams, BIM coordinators, heritage specialists, client representatives and relevant authorities to resolve horticultural, forestry, heritage‑landscape and BIM‑related issues.
    
* Prepare technical reports, conservation and heritage‑landscape inputs, progress updates, site observations and recommendations for senior project leadership.
    
* Support the development and implementation of project procedures, guidelines and method statements for landscape works in heritage‑sensitive environments, including tree protection, heritage buffers and visual‑impact controls.
    
* Contribute landscape‑related input to project risk assessments, constraints identification and design/constructability reviews, particularly where works may affect heritage assets or cultural landscapes.
    
* Monitor contractor compliance with project quality, HSE, sustainability and heritage requirements in relation to landscape works, and follow up on corrective and preventive actions as required.
    

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Horticulture, Forestry, Agriculture, Arboriculture, Landscape Architecture, Environmental Science or a related discipline.
    
* Minimum of 18 years of relevant experience in horticulture, forestry, softscape, planting, landscape establishment or landscape maintenance.
    
* Strong technical knowledge of plant health, tree management, soil science, irrigation requirements, nursery stock, pest control, fertilization, pruning and landscape establishment.
    
* Experience managing horticultural or forestry works on large‑scale public realm, parks, infrastructure, mixed‑use, urban development or open‑space projects.
    
* Ability to review planting plans, landscape drawings, specifications, method statements, material submittals and inspection requests.
    
* Understanding of heritage‑sensitive environments and the need to conserve topography, open spaces and cultural landscapes in line with defined conservation principles.
    
* Familiarity with BIM‑enabled project delivery and coordination of landscape information with other disciplines (awareness of LOD concepts, data integrity and codification).
    

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Experience working in the GCC or Middle East region.
    
* Knowledge of arid climate planting, native and adaptive species, water‑efficient landscaping and sustainable horticultural practices.
    
* Experience with tree surveys, tree relocation, tree protection, forestry management or arboricultural assessments.
    
* Experience with nursery management, plant procurement and plant material inspections.
    
* Experience working on projects involving heritage assets, cultural landscapes or historic environments.
    
* Experience contributing landscape information to BIM models and participating in BIM coordination activities.
    
* Professional certification or membership in horticulture, forestry, arboriculture, agriculture, irrigation or a related discipline.
    
* Previous experience in a PMC, supervision consultant, contractor or client representative environment.

**Title:**

**Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!**

**Program Summary**

These services ensure mission-critical Installation Engineering, Asset Management and Visibility, and Real Property support to the 378 AEW. In addition to Engineering Support Services at Prince Sultan Air Base, KBR also provides food services and other quality-of-life support to sustain base operations.

**Job Summary**

The Structures Technician supports Sub-Activity Management and Asset Visibility Services by providing system-level expertise and field support for facility condition assessments, inventory accuracy, and sustainment requirements development. This role contributes directly to the BIAT function and supports SMS BUILDER data quality, assessment completeness/currency targets, and maintenance strategy development.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior FM Services Specialist – Saudi National** to join our team! In this role you will get to provide on-site technical oversight and operational governance of Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) services across large-scale workforce accommodation and community assets. You will monitor hard and soft FM services, contractor performance, asset condition, worker welfare, hygiene, maintenance, and service quality to ensure facilities operate safely, reliably, and in accordance with contractual requirements, SLAs, KPIs, and applicable standards.  


## What You'll Be Doing

* Provide day-to-day on-site oversight of Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) activities across workforce accommodation, residential blocks, common areas, dining facilities, and supporting infrastructure.
* Lead routine field inspections to assess facility condition, operational performance, cleanliness, safety, and service quality.
* Monitor FM contractors and service providers to ensure compliance with contractual requirements, approved procedures, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Review contractor response times, work quality, preventive maintenance performance, and closure of service requests.
* Identify operational deficiencies, engineering defects, maintenance issues, and service failures and initiate appropriate corrective actions.
* Track corrective actions and follow up with contractors to ensure deficiencies are resolved within required timeframes.
* Monitor contractor manpower, deployment, supervision, and service delivery across assigned facilities.
* Conduct quality inspections of soft FM services, including cleaning, janitorial services, catering, waste management, pest control, and associated community services.
* Audit mass-catering kitchens, food preparation and storage areas, dining facilities, and related operations for compliance with applicable food safety and hygiene requirements.
* Inspect residential accommodation, washrooms, sanitation facilities, and common areas to ensure appropriate standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and worker welfare.
* Monitor waste collection, recycling, disposal, and pest management activities across the asset.
* Provide technical oversight of hard FM services and basic Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) infrastructure.
* Monitor planned preventive maintenance and corrective maintenance activities for HVAC, electrical, plumbing, water distribution, lighting, and other building systems.
* Review maintenance schedules and verify completion of planned maintenance activities against approved requirements.
* Monitor critical equipment condition, reliability, availability, and recurring maintenance issues.
* Review asset registers and verify that asset information, maintenance status, and lifecycle records are maintained accurately.
* Represent City Operations and Asset Management during joint inspections, snagging, commissioning, and handover of new residential blocks and facilities.
* Identify outstanding defects and operational readiness issues during handover and track them through resolution and closure.
* Verify that new assets are maintainable, accessible, documented, and operationally ready before acceptance.
* Review O&M documentation, asset information, warranties, maintenance requirements, and other handover information as required.
* Track resident maintenance requests, complaints, grievances, and service issues and coordinate with contractors to achieve timely resolution.
* Escalate recurring or high-risk service failures to senior Asset Management and City Operations leadership.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, incidents, service failures, corrective actions, contractor performance, and operational issues.
* Prepare daily and weekly FM reports, contractor performance assessments, incident logs, KPI/SLA updates, and management summaries.
* Analyze recurring maintenance and service trends and recommend practical improvements to asset performance and service delivery.
* Coordinate with Asset Management, City Operations, HSE, Security, Community Management, contractors, residents, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Support emergency response, business continuity, and incident management activities affecting facilities and residential communities.
* Promote safe working practices, high service standards, worker welfare, and continuous improvement across FM operations.
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate.

## What Required Skills You'll Bring

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Facilities Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Building Services, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **10+ years of facilities management experience**, including significant hands-on site supervision and contractor management experience.
* Strong experience supporting **large-scale workforce accommodation, workers' villages, remote camps, high-density residential compounds, or similar operational facilities**.
* Demonstrated experience managing or overseeing Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) service providers.
* Strong working knowledge of both **hard and soft FM services**, including:
* HVAC and mechanical systems
* Electrical systems
* Plumbing and water distribution
* Planned and corrective maintenance
* Cleaning and janitorial services
* Catering and food services
* Waste management
* Pest control
* Hygiene and sanitation
* Experience monitoring contractor performance against contractual SLAs and KPIs.
* Strong understanding of planned preventive maintenance (PPM), corrective maintenance, work orders, and service request management.
* Experience conducting facility inspections, identifying defects, and tracking corrective actions through closure.
* Knowledge of asset management, asset registers, equipment condition monitoring, and lifecycle maintenance principles.
* Experience supporting facility handover, snagging, commissioning, and operational readiness activities.
* Understanding of worker welfare, accommodation quality, hygiene, and facility safety requirements.
* Ability to interpret FM contracts, scopes of work, performance requirements, and service specifications.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to resolve operational issues in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to direct and influence contractor workforce teams without direct administrative reporting authority.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify recurring operational and service quality issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prepare clear operational reports, inspection findings, incident logs, and contractor performance assessments.
* Ability to work independently and make appropriate operational decisions within assigned authority.
* Strong stakeholder management and multidisciplinary coordination capabilities.

## What Desired Skills You'll Bring

* Experience supporting **Saudi Arabian giga-projects, major master-planned developments, workforce villages, or large residential communities**.
* Experience within City Operations, Asset Management, Facilities Management, Community Operations, or Property Management environments.
* Professional Facilities Management certification such as **CFM, FMP, IWFM, or equivalent** is preferred.
* NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent HSE qualification is an advantage.
* Experience using **CAFM, CMMS, asset management, or digital inspection platforms**.
* Experience developing and monitoring FM dashboards, SLA/KPI scorecards, contractor performance reports, and service improvement plans.
* Knowledge of food safety, catering hygiene, sanitation, and high-volume food service operations.
* Experience managing outsourced hard and soft service providers within complex operational environments.
* Familiarity with lifecycle planning, asset condition assessments, preventive maintenance optimization, and reliability improvement.
* Experience reviewing O&M manuals, warranties, asset data, maintenance plans, and handover documentation.
* Knowledge of emergency response, incident management, and business continuity requirements within residential communities.
* Experience working within Delivery Partner, PMC, client-side, or major program environments.
* Strong contractor management, negotiation, and performance improvement capabilities.
* Ability to analyze operational trends and recommend practical improvements to service quality, asset reliability, and resident experience.
* Strong commitment to worker welfare, safety, operational excellence, service quality, and continuous improvement.

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Interior Design (ID) Manager to join our team. The (ID) Manager will lead the interior design efforts for high-end luxury construction projects, ensuring the highest standards of design, quality, and craftsmanship. The role requires an experienced professional with a strong background in managing luxury interior design projects internationally. The ID Manager will oversee all interior design phases, from concept development through to project completion, ensuring alignment with the client’s vision, luxury standards, and project objectives. This position demands a blend of creativity, leadership, and technical expertise to manage large-scale luxury projects, working closely with clients, consultants, and project teams across global markets.

**Interior Design Leadership & Oversight:**  
• Lead the development of interior design concepts for luxury residential, commercial, and hospitality projects.  
• Ensure that all design elements, including layouts, materials, finishes, and furnishings, meet luxury standards and reflect the client’s vision.  
• Provide strategic leadership to the interior design team, ensuring the seamless delivery of all design phases from concept through construction.

**Project Coordination & Collaboration:**  
• Collaborate with architects, MEP teams, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that interior design elements integrate smoothly with the overall project design.  
• Lead coordination meetings with internal teams and external consultants to resolve design challenges and ensure alignment with luxury standards.  
• Manage the interface between interior design and other disciplines, ensuring consistency and cohesion across all project elements.  


**Luxury Interior Execution:**  
• Oversee the selection and specification of high-end materials, finishes, fixtures, and custom furnishings, ensuring they align with the luxury project’s design narrative.  
• Ensure that all interior spaces reflect the unique luxury aesthetics required for each project, balancing functionality and elegance.  
• Review detailed interior design documentation, drawings, and specifications, ensuring precision and adherence to luxury standards.  


**Quality Control & Design Integrity:**  
• Implement robust quality control processes to ensure that all interior design elements meet the highest luxury and craftsmanship standards.  
• Regularly review design deliverables, ensuring they comply with the client’s vision, international building codes, and local regulations.  
• Ensure design integrity is maintained throughout construction and fit-out, coordinating closely with contractors and on-site teams to resolve any design-related issues.  


**Client Engagement & Relationship Management:**  
• Serve as the primary point of contact for clients on all interior design matters, understanding their expectations and ensuring the design exceeds them.  
• Present interior design concepts, mood boards, material selections, and progress updates to clients, incorporating their feedback while maintaining the integrity of the luxury design vision.  
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring ongoing collaboration and satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.  


**Budget & Schedule Management:**  
• Work closely with the project management team to ensure that the interior design aligns with the overall project budget and schedule, without compromising luxury quality.  
• Prepare and review cost estimates for interior design elements, ensuring selections align with project budgets and financial objectives.  
• Monitor procurement and delivery of materials, furniture, and finishes to ensure timely completion in line with project milestones.  


**Sustainability & Innovation:**  
• Integrate sustainable and innovative design practices into luxury interiors, ensuring environmentally responsible solutions without sacrificing aesthetics.  
• Stay updated with global trends in luxury interior design, ensuring the latest innovations and technologies are incorporated into project designs.  
  
**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**  


• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.

• A minimum of 15-18 years of experience in interior design management, with at least 10 years focused on luxury projects.

• Extensive international experience managing large-scale, high-end luxury residential, commercial, or hospitality projects.  
• Strong background working with high-profile clients and delivering interior designs of the highest standards in international markets.  
• Technical Skills:  
• Proficiency in interior design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, and other visualization tools.  
• Strong knowledge of luxury materials, finishes, and bespoke furnishings, including international sourcing and procurement.  
• Deep understanding of local and international building codes, sustainability practices, and luxury design standards.  
• Soft Skills:  
• Excellent leadership, team management, and mentoring abilities, with experience leading multidisciplinary design teams.  
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage with high-profile clients and senior stakeholders effectively.  
• A keen eye for detail, with a deep understanding of luxury design aesthetics, craftsmanship, and quality.  
• Professional certification or licensure in Interior Design (e.g., NCIDQ, ASID).  
• Experience working in a PMC or consultancy environment.  
• Familiarity with global luxury brands and working with high-end residential, hospitality, or commercial clients.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Road Network Engineer (ITS) – City Operations & Maintenance (Saudi National)** to join our team! In this role you will get to oversee the operational performance, safety, asset condition, and continuous traffic flow of a city-wide road network within a landmark giga-project. You will support Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), traffic operations, road asset maintenance, event mobility, and smart-city integration to ensure highways, urban streets, and transit corridors operate safely and efficiently during daily operations and major events.  


## What You'll Be Doing

* Oversee the day-to-day operational performance and condition of highways, urban roads, intersections, transit corridors, and associated road infrastructure.
    
* Monitor real-time traffic conditions using Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), traffic management platforms, roadside sensors, CCTV, and traffic data feeds.
    
* Analyze traffic speeds, volumes, congestion levels, travel times, incidents, and network performance to identify operational issues.
    
* Monitor and optimize intelligent traffic signal operations and timing plans to improve traffic flow and reduce congestion.
    
* Coordinate with Traffic Management Centers (TMC), City Operations, Security, emergency services, and other stakeholders during incidents and network disruptions.
    
* Support rapid response to road accidents, vehicle breakdowns, obstructions, and other incidents affecting network availability.
    
* Develop and implement traffic management measures to maintain safe and efficient movement during planned and unplanned disruptions.
    
* Conduct regular technical inspections and condition assessments of roads, pavements, intersections, and associated infrastructure.
    
* Identify pavement defects including cracking, potholes, rutting, settlement, surface deterioration, and other asset condition issues.
    
* Develop and coordinate preventive and corrective road maintenance programs based on asset condition, operational priority, and lifecycle requirements.
    
* Support planning and delivery of pavement rehabilitation, resurfacing, road marking, and associated maintenance activities.
    
* Monitor the condition and maintenance of road barriers, guardrails, street lighting, stormwater drainage, road markings, signage, and associated roadside assets.
    
* Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize disruption to traffic and maintain safe access throughout the network.
    
* Monitor contractors performing road, ITS, and associated infrastructure maintenance and verify compliance with approved SLAs, KPIs, specifications, and safety requirements.
    
* Develop and review Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) plans for construction activities, maintenance works, concerts, sporting events, festivals, and other major events.
    
* Plan safe diversions, detours, temporary lane closures, traffic control arrangements, and alternative access routes.
    
* Coordinate event traffic strategies with parking, public transport, security, emergency response, venue operations, and mobility teams.
    
* Assess road network capacity against anticipated event demand and identify potential congestion points before major events.
    
* Coordinate road network operations with parking arrival and departure strategies to reduce queuing and congestion around major destinations.
    
* Analyze historical and real-time traffic telemetry to identify recurring congestion zones, network bottlenecks, and operational improvement opportunities.
    
* Support integration of roadside ITS devices, traffic signals, CCTV, Variable Message Signs (VMS), traffic detectors, and other smart mobility technologies.
    
* Coordinate integration of road and ITS systems with the central City Operations or Traffic Management platform.
    
* Support planning and operational readiness for connected, autonomous, and emerging mobility technologies where applicable.
    
* Develop and monitor network performance indicators covering traffic flow, congestion, incidents, asset condition, system availability, and maintenance performance.
    
* Maintain accurate road asset records, inspection findings, maintenance histories, incident logs, and operational data using GIS, CMMS, or asset management systems.
    
* Prepare technical reports, traffic assessments, dashboards, maintenance recommendations, and management presentations.

Acting as the design authority for operability and maintainability, the Design Director provides independent review, challenge, assurance and recommendations across all assets that will require future operations, maintenance, management or service delivery. The position develops and maintains operational design requirements, coordinates stakeholder alignment, supports district and development teams, and manages specialist consultant activities relating to operational design assurance.

The role works closely with Development, Delivery, City Operations, Community Management, Asset Management, Utilities, Mobility, Security, Digital and other operational stakeholders to ensure assets are designed for safe, efficient and sustainable operation throughout their lifecycle. * Catering and food services

* Experience monitoring contractor performance against contractual SLAs and KPIs.

* Experience conducting facility inspections, identifying defects, and tracking corrective actions through closure.

* Lead MEP due diligence, technical assessments, and concept-level planning to support time-sensitive facility and investment decisions.
* Plan and coordinate existing-condition assessments of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, life safety, controls, and Building Management Systems (BMS).

* Develop concept-level MEP solutions for system upgrades, replacement, resiliency, redundancy, hardening, and utility service strategies.

* Define and coordinate shutdowns, outage windows, system tie-ins, temporary services, bypass arrangements, and operational continuity requirements.
* Develop MEP phasing strategies that allow construction activities to proceed while maintaining critical facility operations.
* Identify MEP long-lead equipment and establish realistic procurement requirements and durations for major equipment, including:
* Generators
* UPS systems
* Switchgear
* Transformers
* Chillers and CRAC units
* Air Handling Units (AHUs)
* Pumps and associated mechanical plant
* Controls and BMS equipment
* Support Construction Manager-led procurement and trade packaging strategies for MEP systems.
* Review MEP procurement sequencing and ensure equipment delivery requirements are aligned with construction and commissioning milestones.
* Develop and review constructible MEP fit-out sequencing, including first-fix and second-fix activities, equipment installation, containment, access requirements, testing, and commissioning.
* Coordinate MEP requirements associated with ceiling spaces, raised floors, plant rooms, equipment access, maintenance zones, and service routes.
* Support commissioning-driven planning, including pre-functional testing, functional testing, Integrated Systems Testing (IST), system turnover, cutover, and operational readiness.
* Provide technical MEP inputs and narratives to support conceptual estimating, cost planning, and reconciliation with independent cost consultants.
* Review MEP cost assumptions and identify technical scope items that could create significant cost or schedule exposure.
* Lead MEP risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and technical risk reporting.
* Develop “what-if” scenarios to evaluate alternative phasing, shutdown, outage, procurement, and implementation strategies.
* Assess the potential schedule, cost, operational, and technical impacts of alternative MEP solutions.
* Prepare technical assessments, executive-level reports, presentations, recommendations, and decision briefs for senior stakeholders.
* Translate complex MEP issues into clear recommendations that support timely project decision-making.
* Support quality assurance and quality control of MEP studies, assessments, design documentation, and technical deliverables.
* Review technical documentation for consistency, completeness, constructability, and alignment with project requirements.
* Support the development of MEP requirements for future Construction Management Information System (CMIS) workflows.

* Support lessons learned, technical knowledge transfer, and continuous improvement throughout project development.
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate.

* Generators and UPS systems
* Switchgear and transformers
* Chilled water and cooling systems
* CRAC and mission-critical cooling systems
* Plumbing and utility systems
* Fire and life safety systems
* Controls and BMS
* Experience developing resiliency, redundancy, hardening, and system reliability strategies.
* Experience planning operational shutdowns, outages, system tie-ins, temporary services, and cutovers within operational facilities.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Transportation Guidelines & Frameworks Lead** to join our team! In this role, you will lead the end-to-end development of the guidelines, procedures, frameworks, and operational SOPs that underpin a key transportation agency’s program. You will translate the agency’s strategic vision into clear, practical, and implementable documentation that guides internal teams and aligns consultants, contractors, O&M providers, and partner agencies around a consistent way of working.

You will be the central point of ownership for the “documentation backbone” of the program — ensuring that standards are technically sound, operationally realistic, and kept current as systems, processes, and policies evolve.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead the overall strategy, roadmap, and workplan for developing, harmonizing, and maintaining transportation standards, guidelines, operating procedures, and reference frameworks across the project scope.
    
* Coordinate the preparation of core guidelines and manuals covering traffic management, traffic signal systems, Traffic Control Center (TCC) operations, incident management, ITS systems, congestion and parking management, construction/work zones, freight/heavy vehicles, enforcement support, and multimodal operations.
    
* Translate high-level policy, concept of operations, and system requirements into clear, practical documents (standards, SOPs, playbooks, checklists, templates) that can be readily used by planners, designers, operators, inspectors, and field crews.
    
* Establish and manage a structured documentation architecture, including document hierarchy, version control, naming conventions, and cross-references so that users can easily locate the applicable requirements and procedures.
    
* Facilitate working sessions and technical workshops with various departments of the agency, other government agencies, and external service providers to capture business needs, reconcile conflicting practices, and build consensus on common standards and operating frameworks.
    
* Define and document interfaces between client organization and external entities (consultants, contractors, O&M providers, neighboring agencies), including roles and responsibilities, submittal requirements, approval workflows, coordination procedures, and performance expectations.
    
* Ensure that standards and SOPs align with international best practices, local regulations, and project-specific requirements for safety, resilience, sustainability, and customer experience, while remaining realistic for project’s operational context.
    
* Work closely with ITS, traffic engineering, safety, multimodal, data/analytics, and TCC operations specialists to embed their technical requirements into coherent, integrated guidelines and frameworks.
    
* Develop operational SOPs and playbooks for regular operations, planned events, construction and maintenance activities, emergencies, and severe weather conditions, ensuring clarity of triggers, roles, decision logic, and communication flows.
    
* Establish a formal review and update process for all standards and procedures, including triggers for revision, approval mechanisms, and a controlled change log to keep documentation current as systems and policies evolve.
    
* Define documentation deliverables, outlines, and authoring expectations for subconsultants, and review their submissions for consistency with the overarching agency standards and frameworks.
    
* Support the development of training materials, job aids, and knowledge transfer sessions that help client staff and external partners understand and apply the standards and SOPs in day-to-day operations.
    
* Provide expert input to project plans, risk registers, and performance frameworks to ensure that documentation-related activities, dependencies, and acceptance criteria are clearly captured and managed.
    
* Contribute to monthly, quarterly, and final reports by summarizing documentation progress, key decisions, risks, and upcoming milestones related to standards and frameworks.
    
* Act as a visible champion for structured, documented ways of working, promoting adoption and
    
* reinforcing the importance of consistent application across all participating organizations.
    

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Urban/Transport Planning, Systems Engineering, or a closely related field.
    
* **15–20+ years** of progressive experience working with transportation agencies or major transport owners/operators, with a strong focus on the development and maintenance of technical standards, guidelines, procedures, and operational SOPs.
    
* Demonstrated track record leading multi-disciplinary efforts to author, update, and implement agency documentation that governs planning, design, construction, operations, and maintenance of surface transportation systems.
    
* Deep understanding of how effective standards, frameworks, and SOPs are structured (hierarchy, content, level of detail) to support both internal users (planning, design, construction, operations, IT/ITS, asset management) and external stakeholders (consultants, contractors, O&M service providers, emergency services, adjacent agencies).
    
* Strong familiarity with traffic management, ITS, traffic control centers, and roadway/arterial operations, and how these domains are typically reflected in agency manuals, guidelines, and operational playbooks.
    
* Proven ability to translate complex technical and operational requirements into clear, concise, and user-friendly documentation, with consistent terminology and formatting.
    
* Experience setting up and managing documentation control, including versioning, approvals, and integration with quality management systems.
    
* Excellent facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, with experience leading working groups and resolving differing viewpoints across multiple departments and partner organizations.
    
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to produce high-quality narrative text, structured outlines, diagrams, and process flows.
    
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-project environment, managing multiple documentation streams and deadlines while maintaining quality and consistency.
    

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring:**

* Prior experience supporting Gulf region transportation agencies or large metropolitan transport authorities on standards, guidelines, or operating frameworks.
    
* Familiarity with international best practices and reference standards in traffic management, ITS, road safety, and TMC operations (e.g., AASHTO, MUTCD-style guidance, PIARC, ITS standards), and how they can be contextualized for local application.
    
* Demonstrated experience leading similar standards, guidelines, and SOPs development programs for major metropolitan or national transportation agencies, with proven adoption across internal departments and external partners.
    
* Experience with organizational development, change management, or training related to the rollout of new standards and procedures.
    
* Professional registration/certification (e.g., PE, CEng, PTOE, PMP, or similar) is an advantage.
    
* Arabic language skills are desirable but not required.

**Job Description:**

* EXCELLENCE DIRECTOR  
      
    Provides senior-level management, strategic, and supervisory responsibilities for excellence activities including quality, continuous improvement, risk, training, and knowledge transfer activities for a major program, to ensure that products or services provided are in accordance with customer and Parsons' excellence  requirements. This position offers strategic leadership in the development and implementation of Quality systems, procedures, and related excellence activities. Regularly interacts with executive and senior-level representatives from across the business, including leadership, program/project management, safety, design/engineering, contracts, procurement, construction, and other personnel.  
      
    Specific Responsibilities
    
    \- Participates in the interview and selection process (including hiring recommendations), and makes staffing assignments in accordance with department requirements.  
    \- Conducts performance evaluations and makes appropriate recommendations for required actions, including recommendations for advancement, changes in status, or disciplinary action.  
    \- Manages the salary administration process, including preparing the annual salary plan and recommending salary actions for merit increases and/or promotions.  
    \- Provides Quality Systems leadership using the Parsons Quality Management System as the basis for process development and optimization, procedure development, data collection and reporting, and Quality Systems training.  
    \- Directs and facilitates efforts to maintain Parsons Excellence-related certifications.  
    \- Interfaces at senior and executive levels with regards to performance improvement.  
    \- Collaborates with Excellence representatives in each business unit, in facilitating Quality and Risk training programs, achieving present current objectives, setting future objectives and providing input and coordinating output from Management Reviews.  
    \- Directs and facilitates the continued improvement of the program Quality Management System and culture of Quality at Parsons.  
    \- Provides leadership, guidance and training to both Parsons and Client personnel; monitors performance, and identifies skills, training, and capabilities needed for business activities for each discipline.  
    \- Acts as a liaison with programs/projects, customers, contractors and/or internal departments on quality related matters and staffing.  
    \- Guides and advances the overall performance of quality at Parsons.  
    \- Identifies and reports to executive management excellence issues or trends based on data from a variety of sources.  
    \- Provides input to management on organization performance metrics, and processes or procedural system improvements.  
    \- Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.  
      
    Skills and Competencies  
      
    \- Requires expert management ability and extensive knowledge of Quality Management practices, processes and current technology  
    \- Requires thorough experience in directing and implementing quality management systems and standards specified by ISO 9000, ASME, ANSI, ASTM and similar organizations  
    \- Clear communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Confidence to interface with executive management, clients, customers, etc.  
    \- Ability to analyze business situations (ROI, cost per unit)  
    \- Effective written, verbal, analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment skills. Ability to make public presentations  
    \- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)  
    \- Attention to detail  
    \- Expert working knowledge of ISO Quality Management Systems Standards  
    \- Ability to direct and manage team members with day to day quality activities as well as special projects to assure timely completion  
    \- Possesses working knowledge of more than one area of industry such as infrastructure, government, aviation, process, or transportation  
      
      
    Education and Typical Experience  
      
    \- Bachelor's Degree in Bachelor of sciences in engineering from accredited university.  
    \- Minimum 20 years’ experience of direct professional oversight of the following functional areas: project controls (cost, schedule, scope, trends); environment, safety & health; risk management; contracts, procurement; financial management; quality assurance and quality control. experience gained on large projects.  
    • Expert knowledge of project process improvement, change management, leadership initiatives and managing change in the infrastructure industry environment with major government and/or semi-government projects (preference for Middle East and in KSA experience).  
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  
    • Demonstrated ability to prepare and present effective oral and written reports.  
    International experience: experience of working internationally (preference KSA experience).
    
    \- 10+ years experience in a supervisory or management capacity  
    \- Requires proven experience in directing and implementing quality management systems and standards specified by ISO 9000, ASME, ANSI, ASTM and similar organizations.  
      
    Licenses and Certifications  
      
    \- Quality-related certification(s) (e.g. CMQ/OE, CQA, or CQE) or ability to obtain within 6-months of hire.  
    \- (Preferred) Active membership in a nationally-recognized Quality organization.  
    \- (Preferred) Professional Engineer registration or Chartered Engineer.  
      
    Key Relationships:  
      
    \- Supervision Received - Vice President, Quality; Executive Management  
    \- Supervision Given - Quality, Risk, and Training Personnel  
    \- Internal Contacts - All employees on projects or within Corporate functions  
    \- External Contacts - Customers Personnel
