**Job Description:**

\*\*Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia\*\*

Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey.

The **Director – Waste Management** is the ultimate technical, financial, and lifecycle authority responsible for the strategic governance of a massive, next-generation solid waste infrastructure portfolio spanning a multi-district smart city footprint.

With a mandate requiring over 20 years of distinguished experience, this executive leader ensures that advanced waste assets—including city-wide automated vacuum waste collection (AVAC) pneumatic networks, smart sorting hubs, material recovery facilities (MRFs), and automated bin systems—are managed as a sustainable, data-driven capital portfolio. Operating at the intersection of urban asset management and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, this role focuses on maximizing Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), driving automated cross-charge cost recovery models, enforcing data integrity inside the central asset registry, and managing the multi-decade capital replacement lifecycle in an extreme desert climate.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Capital Planning & Asset Lifecycle Strategy (LCP)**

* Formulate and continuously update the 10-to-30-year **Capital Asset Replacement Plan (CARP)** for all solid waste and municipal cleansing infrastructure city-wide.
* Drive advanced asset degradation modeling and predictive performance matrices tailored to the intense heat, dust, pneumatic wear, and heavy-use profiles of the region's waste assets.
* Conduct rigorous Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and financial trade-off analyses to optimize capital expenditure versus operational maintenance (CAPEX vs. OPEX) for large-scale waste machinery and automated networks.
* Partner directly with the Service Charge Director to establish accurate, audited long-term infrastructure sinking funds paid for by commercial entities, mega-entertainment districts, and residential neighborhoods.

**2\. Digital System Integration & Smart Grid Governance**

* Establish and enforce the master asset data hierarchy, naming conventions, and structural classifications for all solid waste infrastructure within the enterprise framework.
* Partner with the SAP-EAMS Director to ensure that automated flow telemetry, mechanical runtime metrics, sensor data, and maintenance histories are flawlessly captured in the central **SAP Enterprise Asset Management** database.
* Oversee the deployment and configuration of smart-city infrastructure technology, including IoT-enabled bin sensor networks, pneumatic pressure tracking arrays, and integrated fleet telemetry systems inside the unified asset management platform.

**3\. Financial Cross-Charging & Vendor Performance Governance**

* Translate raw automated waste-volume and weight-tracking database metrics into equitable cost-allocation and financial cross-charging models for corporate finance teams.
* Deliver audited waste-generation data frameworks to the Service Charge Director to enable automated utility billing and cost recovery across international commercial partners, theme parks, hospitality hubs, and distinct sub-developments.
* Design and enforce strict technical Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and data-logging compliance protocols for Tier-1 external Operations & Maintenance (O&M) contractors and specialized waste management vendors.
* Lead independent operational and technical audits on waste infrastructure to verify that contract partners are completing preventative maintenance according to **ISO 55001 standards**.

**4\. Stage-Gate Assurance & Asset "Vesting" Handover**

* Act as the final technical sign-off authority on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee for all solid waste capital projects transitioning from construction contractors into live operations.
* Oversee the "Digital Vesting" process for waste networks, verifying that all technical manuals, structural as-built documentation, pneumatic safety certifications, and warranty tracking sheets are successfully integrated into the asset platform before formal operational sign-off.

**Job Requirements & Qualifications**

**Education & Professional Credentials**

* **Bachelor’s Degree** in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical asset management discipline from an accredited institution.
* **Master’s Degree** in Engineering Management, Asset Management, Sustainable Infrastructure, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred.
* **Professional Certifications:** Mandatory possession of senior professional credentials, such as Certified Asset Management Assessor (**CAMA**), Institute of Asset Management (**IAM**) Diploma, Chartered Waste Manager, or Chartered/Professional Engineer (**CEng / PE**).

**Experience**

* **Minimum of 20+ years** of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in infrastructure asset management, municipal engineering finance, or large-scale utility operations.
* At least **8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity**, directly managing multi-disciplinary asset portfolios and multi-million-dollar infrastructure operating and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX).
* Proven track record of spearheading the operational handover, technical integration, and lifecycle modeling of giga-scale automated vacuum waste systems, regional recycling hubs, or city-wide smart utility networks.
* Extensive experience aligning physical utility performance metrics with corporate financial structures, enterprise ERP engines, and **ISO 55001 asset governance frameworks**.
* Deep familiarity with Saudi Arabia’s national environmental regulations, localized municipal waste compliance laws, and circular economy targets.

**Technical & Soft Skills**

* Deep technical command over reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), predictive degradation analytics, and advanced fluid/pneumatic mechanical logistics under extreme climate conditions.
* Executive-level fluency in enterprise technology platforms, specifically **SAP (PM and MM modules)**, GIS mapping systems, and IoT smart-city network integrations.
* Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex mechanical and data engineering concepts into clear, high-level business cases for financial executives and executive steering committees.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking an experienced Document Controller to support the Program Management Office (PMO) on a major, multi‑disciplinary infrastructure program in Riyadh. This is a hands‑on, client‑side PMO role, responsible for controlling, tracking, and governing project documentation across PMCMs, designers, contractors, and internal PMO teams. The role ensures that project information is accurate, traceable, compliant, and audit‑ready, enabling reliable reporting and decision‑making.

### **What You'll Be Doing:**

* Register, track, control, and distribute all project documentation including drawings, submittals, correspondence, RFIs, and reports.
* Ensure compliance with approved document control procedures, naming conventions, and distribution matrices.
* Maintain strict revision, version, and status control across all project documentation.
* Support daily operation of the EDMS (e.g. Aconex, Unifier, SharePoint, Primavera PCM).
* Monitor submission timelines, review cycles, and approval workflows in line with PMO governance.
* Track overdue documents and coordinate follow-ups and escalations where required.
* Perform periodic checks and audits to ensure document completeness, accuracy, and audit readiness.
* Support archiving, handover, and close-out processes in accordance with contractual requirements.
* Act as a primary document control interface between the PMO, PMCMs, designers, and contractors.
* Coordinate with planning, cost, commercial, and technical teams to ensure alignment between documents, schedules, and baselines.
* Support system inductions and procedural briefings for PMCMs and contractors.
* Maintain document registers, logs, and trackers.
* Prepare regular document status reports and compliance metrics for PMO management.
* Support ad-hoc client and PMO requests related to document traceability and records.

### **What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in document control or information management on large infrastructure or construction programs.
* Experience in PMC / PMCM / PMO or client-side environments.
* Strong working knowledge of EDMS platforms (Aconex, Primavera PCM / Unifier, SharePoint, or equivalent).
* Experience working in KSA / GCC project environments.

### **What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Strong attention to detail and document integrity.
* Clear understanding of document control as a PMO governance function, not clerical support.
* Proactive, hands-on, and delivery-focused.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to work under pressure.
* Good English communication skills.
* Confident interfacing with PMCMs and contractors; strong team player.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Interface Lead - Saudi National** to join our team!

The Interface Lead will be responsible for managing and coordinating technical, organizational, contractual, and physical interfaces between project disciplines, contractors, consultants, authorities, stakeholders, and operational entities.

The role will ensure that interfaces are clearly identified, assigned, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner to prevent design conflicts, construction delays, scope gaps, rework, and impacts to project milestones.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Lead the day-to-day interface management activities across assigned project areas and packages.
* Establish and maintain the project Interface Management Plan, procedures, workflows, and governance requirements.
* Develop and maintain the Interface Register / Interface Control Document (ICD).
* Identify, document, classify, and monitor technical and non-technical interfaces across the project.
* Coordinate interfaces between Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Commissioning, Quality, HSE, Planning, Commercial, and Operations.
* Manage interfaces between different engineering disciplines including Civil, Structural, MEP, ICT, ELV, Utilities, Roads, Airfield, FLS, and specialist systems.
* Coordinate interfaces between multiple contractors, consultants, subcontractors, and project packages.
* Identify interfaces between new works and existing infrastructure / operational facilities.
* Coordinate airport airside / landside and operational interfaces where applicable.
* Identify interface requirements at an early stage and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned to the relevant parties.
* Develop and maintain Interface Responsibility Matrices (IRM) and interface ownership structures.
* Define interface inputs, outputs, deliverables, responsibilities, dates, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate technical information exchange between interfacing parties.
* Facilitate interface workshops and coordination meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, interface action trackers, and follow-up reports.
* Monitor interface actions and ensure timely closure of outstanding issues.
* Escalate critical or overdue interface issues to Project Management.
* Coordinate resolution of design clashes, scope gaps, technical discrepancies, and construction interface issues.
* Review interface requirements within drawings, specifications, contracts, technical submissions, and project documents.
* Coordinate with BIM / Digital Engineering teams to identify and resolve spatial and technical clashes.
* Support multidisciplinary design coordination and constructability reviews.
* Review interface requirements associated with temporary works, construction sequencing, access, logistics, and work fronts.
* Coordinate interfaces between permanent works and temporary facilities where applicable.
* Manage interfaces between construction activities and testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover.
* Coordinate system interfaces and integration requirements during commissioning.
* Ensure interface requirements are incorporated into project schedules and key milestones.
* Coordinate with Planning and Project Controls to monitor interface-related activities and constraints.
* Identify interface dependencies that may affect the critical path or project milestones.
* Support development of mitigation and recovery strategies for interface-related delays.
* Coordinate with Commercial and Contracts teams regarding interface-related scope boundaries, responsibilities, variations, and claims.
* Identify potential scope gaps, overlaps, and responsibility conflicts between contracts and packages.
* Support resolution of contractual interface issues in coordination with Commercial and Contracts teams.
* Maintain records of interface decisions, agreements, approvals, and technical resolutions.
* Ensure interface agreements are formally documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor implementation of agreed interface requirements in design and construction.
* Conduct interface inspections and site walks where required to verify physical interface conditions.
* Coordinate with Quality teams regarding interface-related inspections, NCRs, and corrective actions.
* Support resolution of interface-related RFIs, Technical Queries, NCRs, and site issues.
* Coordinate with HSE teams regarding interfaces that may create safety or operational risks.
* Coordinate with authorities, utility providers, airport operators, and external stakeholders where required.
* Monitor interface risks and maintain an Interface Risk Register where applicable.
* Provide regular interface status reports and dashboards to Project Management.
* Identify trends and recurring interface issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Support project governance meetings by providing interface status, key risks, and outstanding actions.
* Ensure interface information is properly documented and controlled.
* Support project handover by ensuring all outstanding interfaces are closed before completion.
* Capture interface-related lessons learned and best practices for future project phases.
* Provide guidance and support to engineers and coordinators involved in interface management.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in interface management, engineering coordination, construction management, or project delivery.
* Proven experience on major airport, infrastructure, transportation, or large-scale construction projects.
* Strong multidisciplinary coordination experience.
* Experience managing interfaces between contractors, consultants, design teams, and project stakeholders.
* Airport / aviation interface management experience is highly preferred.

* PMP / CAPM certification is an advantage.
* Interface Management / Systems Engineering training is preferred.
* PMI / AACE project controls training is an advantage.
* BIM / Digital Engineering coordination training is beneficial.
* Relevant HSE certification is an advantage.

* Interface Management
* Interface Registers
* Interface Control Documents (ICDs)
* Interface Responsibility Matrix (IRM)
* Technical Interface Management
* Design Coordination
* Multidisciplinary Coordination
* Contractor / Consultant Interface Management
* Package-to-Package Coordination
* Scope Boundary Management
* Scope Gap & Overlap Identification
* Design Clash Management
* BIM / 3D Coordination
* Construction Interface Management
* Existing / New Infrastructure Interfaces
* Airside / Landside Interfaces
* Utility Interfaces
* MEP / ICT / ELV Interfaces
* Commissioning & Systems Integration
* Operational Readiness Interfaces
* Interface Risk Management
* RFI / Technical Query Coordination
* NCR Interface Resolution
* Interface Action Tracking
* Schedule & Milestone Interface Management
* Contractual Interface Awareness
* Technical Reporting & Dashboards
* AutoCAD / BIM Awareness
* MS Office / Advanced Excel

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand complex multidisciplinary interfaces.
* Proactive approach to identifying interface risks before they impact the project.
* Strong follow-up and action management capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and technical teams.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple interfaces and priorities simultaneously.
* Professional and diplomatic approach to resolving conflicts between stakeholders.
* Strong decision-making and escalation judgment.
* Ability to work effectively under demanding project schedules.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a **Senior Structural Engineer** to join our team in Tabuk, KSA. In this role, you will be responsible for the structural design development, comprehensive technical review, and structural analysis of complex buildings and infrastructure components. Your expertise will ensure the successful delivery of massive giga-projects transforming the region, providing vital technical guidance and contributing to the overall success of our multidisciplinary engineering team.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead the design, development, and modification of complex concrete and steel structures utilizing advanced structural analysis and design software.
    
* Review and validate structural design submittals, contractor shop drawings, technical specifications, and calculations to ensure complete alignment with project guidelines and international standards.
    
* Perform technical, over-the-shoulder structural reviews to evaluate project constructability, value engineering options, and component maintainability.
    
* Conduct routine site observations and field inspections to verify construction compliance with approved design drawings, method statements, and strict quality control procedures.
    
* Provide clear technical input, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers, designers, and CAD/BIM modelers working within the project team.
    
* Coordinate extensively with cross-functional discipline leads (Architecture, MEP, Geotechnical, and Infrastructure) to resolve complex design interfaces and track progress milestones.
    

**What Required Skills You'll Bring**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Structural Engineering or related field in Engineering.
    
* **Experience:** Minimum of 10 years of progressive structural engineering and design experience, with a proven track record on large-scale infrastructure, high-rise, or complex multi-use master-planned developments. Middle East project experience is a significant advantage.
    

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

* **Technical Tools:** High proficiency in industry-standard structural analysis software (e.g., STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, ETABS, SAFE) and a strong working knowledge of CAD/BIM integration.
    
* **Codes & Standards:** Comprehensive knowledge of international structural building codes (AISC, ACI, Eurocodes) and familiarity with the Saudi Building Code (SBC).
    
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to write detailed engineering reports and clearly present technical solutions to clients and senior management.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking a highly talented **Senior Contract Administration** professional to support a major rail project. In this role, you will provide expert advice on construction claims, including forensic planning, schedule delay analysis, acceleration, disruption and productivity analysis, as well as general claims assessment and defense support. Reporting to the Senior Claims Manager, you will be a senior member of a team of Contract Administrators and Claims Specialists responsible for assessing and defending contractors’ claims. The ideal candidate will have strong stakeholder management skills, a proven track record of successfully resolving delay and disruption claims on major civil projects, and a technical background in engineering, quantity surveying, or a related field.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Undertake delay analysis on complex claims and disputes.
    
* Analyze extension-of-time claims and prepare recommendations on entitlement.
    
* Assess delay and disruption damages.
    
* Support major claims and contribute to dispute resolution strategies.
    
* Pre-qualify claims received from contractors by:
    
    * Checking that claims are submitted within contractual timescales.
        
    * Confirming that initial substantiation provided by contractors is reasonable.
        
    * Advising whether claims are administratively compliant with the contract.
        
* Conduct forensic analysis of claims and potential claims by:
    
    * Reviewing contractors’ claims and potential claims.
        
    * Liaising with the project team to obtain relevant background information and documentation.
        
    * Investigating technical construction issues in detail.
        
    * Undertaking delay analysis of the program’s critical path.
        
    * Identifying any contractor-caused concurrent delay.
        
    * Formulating the client’s defense and/or counterclaim, as appropriate.
        
* Ascertain contractor entitlement, if any, in relation to:
    
    * Change in scope.
        
    * Extension of time.
        
    * Financial quantum.
        
* Provide expert forensic planning input into reports by:
    
    * Writing clear and comprehensive claims reports.
        
    * Confirming the results of forensic analysis of claims and potential claims.
        
    * Preparing documents for review, analysis, and approval by Contract Administration peers.
        
    * Supporting submissions to the Engineer for formal consideration.
        
    * Developing summary presentations for key internal stakeholders.
        

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Degree in civil engineering is essential, or in a construction-related discipline (e.g., engineering, quantity surveying, or equivalent).
    
* At least 10 years of relevant post-qualification experience on heavy civils projects.
    
* Rail/Metro sector construction experience is essential.
    
* Full membership of a technical professional institution (e.g., MICE, MRICS, IEAust, or equivalent).
    
* Knowledge of FIDIC contracts (or equivalent).
    
* Strong planning and programming background on multi-billion-dollar construction projects.
    
* Strong background in major contract claims and dispute resolution, with a proven ability to:
    
    * Conduct forensic investigations of technical construction issues.
        
    * Undertake program delay analysis.
        
    * Assess financial quantum.
        
* Sound knowledge of SCL Protocols and AACE Recommended Practices for extension-of-time claims.
    
* Experience in building programmes for extension of time using Primavera is preferred, or the ability to do so.
    
* Good working knowledge of Primavera.
    
* Fair knowledge or familiarity with TILOS.
    
* Strong oral, written, and presentation skills.
    
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
    
* Presentable and articulate.

The B2 Avionics Technician will be responsible to ensure optimal service support for maintenance and flight line activities to achieve the excellent fleet availability with highest quality and safety standards. The B2 Avionics Technician will also be responsible to perform detailed inspection, assembly, installation, repair or replacement of aircraft components and systems, maintenance (both scheduled and unscheduled) or refurbishing of aircraft and function check of components. The B2 Avionics Technician will perform OJT on location as required.

and unscheduled maintenance of the helicopter fleet, within a customer environment

Al Khobar, KSA / Hybrid | Full-time | Principal individual contributor | Reports to VP Engineering

About the company:

The company is a construction-technology company headquartered in Al Khobar, KSA. We build a connected-worker platform for large construction and industrial sites. Smart helmets, anchors, and gateways feed a real-time SaaS platform that supports worker location, safety compliance, automated mustering, and productivity analytics across major GCC projects.

About the role:

As Principal Platform Engineer, you will be the senior individual contributor accountable for the platform's technical integrity. You will set architecture, make critical implementation contributions, and lead across boundaries through design quality and earned technical trust.

This is not an engineering-management role. You will not own hiring, performance cycles, or sprint administration. You will mentor engineers, establish contribution standards, unblock hard technical work, and partner with engineering management and Product on sequencing and team health.

What success looks like - first 6 months:

You understand architecture, ownership boundaries, open decisions, and production risks deeply enough to lead a walkthrough of any core platform area.

The most consequential platform decisions are captured in clear architecture decision records, with explicit trade-offs and evidence.

The AIP layer - including agent runtime, MCP surface, and AI-powered product capabilities - has a coherent technical direction and at least one production-shaped vertical slice.

The contribution standard is operational: scoped issues, reviewable changes, clear component boundaries, reliable tests, and links between implementation and architecture.

You have delivered a material platform capability or de-risked a major architectural uncertainty through working software and measurable validation.

Engineering, Product, Hardware, Field Engineering, and leadership trust your technical judgment and understand the platform direction.

What you will own:

Architecture across ontology and semantics, governed pipelines and lineage, streaming and data sources, SDK and API surfaces, authorization and governance, application services, and release infrastructure.

Architecture decision records for consequential platform choices, revisiting old decisions when evidence or implementation pressure indicates a better path.

The technical direction of WC3's AI-native capabilities, including agent runtime design, MCP interfaces, retrieval, tool use, output evaluation, and responsible-AI controls.

Engineering standards that allow multiple contributors and teams to change the platform safely.

What you will do:

Design and implement production capabilities across the stack, spending substantial time in code, prototypes, reviews, debugging, and system validation.

Define and evolve domain models and ontology patterns that connect workers, devices, sites, events, rules, and customer workflows.

Design governed data pipelines with clear contracts, lineage, replay behavior, quality checks, and operational ownership.

Build secure, stable API and SDK surfaces for internal teams, partners, customers, and AI agents.

Make pragmatic data-store choices across relational, time-series, streaming, search, and vector workloads.

Drive the current C#/.NET backend while reasoning credibly across Go, Python, Java, Node.js, and TypeScript when the product requires a different trade-off.

Raise engineering maturity through automated testing, CI gates, release safety, observability, service-level objectives, incident learning, and migration discipline.

Embed security and compliance into design and implementation, including data residency, encryption, audit logging, access control, tenant isolation, and responsible-AI guardrails.

Mentor senior engineers, review designs and code, create reference implementations, and help contributors earn ownership of platform areas.

Collaborate with Product, Hardware, Field Engineering, customers, and partners to connect architecture choices to real site outcomes.

What you will bring:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including sustained impact at Staff, Principal, Lead Architect, or equivalent senior individual-contributor scope.

A track record of designing and delivering scalable, multi-tenant SaaS platforms or large distributed systems in production, including incidents, migrations, and scaling failures.

Experience owning a platform across its lifecycle from architecture and implementation through deployment, operation, and evolution.

Deep backend and distributed-systems judgment, with strong hands-on ability in at least one of C#/.NET, Go, Python, Java, or Node.js and credible range across others.

Strong API design skills across REST and/or GraphQL, OpenAPI or SDK code generation, and secure identity patterns such as OAuth 2.0, JWT, and SSO.

Cloud and delivery experience with GCP and/or AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.

Experience with ontology-driven or governed platforms such as Palantir Foundry/AIP, Databricks Unity Catalog, or equivalent first-principles work with ontologies, pipelines, lineage, governed SDKs, and applications.

Hands-on experience with LLM integration patterns such as prompting, retrieval, tool or function calling, MCP, agent runtime design, and output evaluation.

Principal-level influence through technical writing, architecture facilitation, mentorship, and alignment without direct authority.

Exceptional written and spoken English, including precise issues, ADRs, design documents, reviews, and stakeholder communication.

Nice to have:

Direct, hands-on Palantir Foundry and/or AIP experience on a live production surface.

Agentic frameworks, multi-agent orchestration, or durable workflow systems.

IoT or connected-device ingestion, device-to-cloud communication, and high-volume event processing.

Enterprise integrations including identity providers, ERP systems, project-management platforms, Oracle, or Procore.

What we offer:

The role manages inventory across Retail, F&B, and Spare Parts, and oversees the fixed asset lifecycle, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reporting. It supports financial integrity, audit readiness, and effective asset management across projects and operating entities.

Key Accountability Areas:

**Fixed Assets Lifecycle Management**

* Manage the full fixed asset lifecycle (creation, capitalization, transfers, depreciation, impairments, disposals) in line with accounting standards
* Monitor AUC/CWIP and ensure timely and accurate capitalization upon project completion
* Maintain and reconcile the Fixed Asset Register with the General Ledger and Trial Balance
* Ensure accurate asset classification, tagging, and useful life assignment
* Review CAPEX transactions and validate CAPEX vs OPEX classification**.**

**Inventory Management:**

* Monitor and validate inventory movements across ERP and warehouse systems.
* Perform stock counts, cycle counts, and reconciliations, including variance analysis.
* Support inventory valuation, including provisions, obsolescence, and write-offs (IAS 2).
* Ensure accurate recording of inventory balances and consumption flows.

**Accounting, Reporting & Reconciliation:**

* Prepare and post depreciation, inventory, and related journal entries.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities.
* Perform sub-ledger to GL reconciliations (inventory and fixed assets).
* Prepare reports and schedules for management reporting and finance leadership.

**Controls, Compliance & Audit:**

* Ensure compliance with IFRS, internal policies, capitalization thresholds, and DoA.
* Support internal and external audits through documentation, reconciliations, and explanations.
* Participate in physical asset verification and inventory counts; resolve discrepancies.

**Stakeholder Coordination & Process Improvement:**

* Coordinate with Procurement, Projects, Operations, and Finance on asset and inventory transactions
* Review PRs, POs, and invoices to ensure correct accounting treatment.
* Identify and drive process improvements and system enhancements.
* Support data accuracy and utilization across ERP/sub-systems.

**Functional Accountabilities**

**Systems & Tools**

* ERP systems (e.g., SAP – FI/MM)
* Inventory / warehouse management systems
* Fixed asset sub-ledgers and project systems
* Reporting tools (Excel, BI)

**Requirements**

KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

**Minimum Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

**Professional Certifications**

Professional certificate in Finance or Accounting certification (i.e. E.g. CPA, SOCPA, CFA, CFP).

Required Experience

* 2 - 3 years of experience in Fixed Assets or Financial Accounting.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS, particularly IAS 16, IAS 36, and IAS 38.
* Working knowledge of IFRS inventory accounting (IAS 2) and internal controls.
* Experience working in ERP-driven environments (ERP systems e.g., SAP – FI).

# ******Job Description Summary******

Job Description Summary  
  
The Gas Turbine Assembler is responsible for the accurate and safe assembly,  
disassembly, and inspection of gas turbine components in accordance with  
engineering drawings, work instructions, and quality standards. This role  
requires strong mechanical aptitude, attention to detail, and strict adherence to  
safety and quality procedures. The assembler works collaboratively with  
engineering, quality, and operations teams to ensure products meet  
performance, reliability, and delivery requirements.

# **Job Description**

**Role Summary / Purpose:**

* Assemble gas turbine components and modules according to engineering drawings, work instructions, and quality standards
* Perform mechanical assembly of rotors, casings, combustors, blades, vanes, bearings, and auxiliary systems
* Use precision measuring tools (micrometers, dial indicators, torque wrenches, feeler gauges) to verify tolerances and clearances
* Interpret technical drawings, blueprints, bills of materials (BOMs), and assembly procedures
* Follow documented processes for bolting, torquing, alignment, and fit-up of components
* Perform component inspections and document results in accordance with quality and traceability requirements
* Identify, report, and help resolve non-conformances or assembly issues
* Adhere strictly to safety procedures, including lifting, rigging, and handling of heavy or sensitive components
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area in line with 5S or site standards
* Collaborate with engineers, quality inspectors, and other technicians to ensure correct assembly and schedule adherence
* Support disassembly, inspection, and reassembly activities during overhauls and repairs
* Complete required documentation, checklists, and electronic records accurately and on time
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to safety, quality, cost, and delivery
* Comply with all company policies, environmental regulations, and regulatory requirements

**Qualifications / Requirements:**

* Technical background in mechanical or electrical assembly
* Basic computer soft skills.
* Basic knowledge of English language.

**Desired Characteristics:**

* Knowledge of Lean manufacturing, 5S, or continuous improvement practices
* Exposure to rotor assembly, balancing, or casing alignment activities
* Familiarity with non‑destructive testing (NDT) basics and inspection processes
* Basic understanding of gas turbine operation and performance principles
* Certification in rigging, crane operation, or forklift handling

# ******Additional Information******

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an experienced and detail‑oriented **Document Controller** to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing all aspects of document control and project documentation, ensuring proper distribution, tracking and retrieval of project documents throughout all project phases, using Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS) such as **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)**.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Manage document control processes from project initiation through to close‑out, ensuring that all project documents are properly received, registered, tracked, updated and archived in accordance with project procedures and client requirements.
    
* Scan and electronically distribute documents as PDF digital copies to designated recipients, ensuring accurate indexing and metadata, and upload them to the client Contract Management System and **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)** as required.
    
* Maintain a hard‑copy reference library for all project documentation to ensure quick and easy retrieval of information and alignment between hard‑copy and electronic records.
    
* Utilize **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)** and other approved EDMS platforms to control and update the status of contract documents, including workflows, revisions, approvals and transmittals.
    
* Prepare, register and track documents such as correspondence, reports, payment requisitions, variation orders, site instructions, punch lists and NCRs within ACC or other EDMS, ensuring correct coding and referencing.
    
* Track and update the status of submittals, safety reports, RFCs, minutes of meetings, progress photographs, contract issues and drawings, ensuring that current approved versions are clearly identifiable and accessible to all authorized project stakeholders.
    
* Produce regular reports on outstanding actions and responses on correspondence, submittals and other controlled documents through ACC and other EDMS, providing timely information to project management and the client.
    
* Support project teams in the effective use of EDMS platforms (including ACC) by assisting with user setup, folder structures, permissions, workflows, document numbering and troubleshooting of document control issues.
    
* Ensure that document control practices comply with Parsons’ procedures, client requirements, contractual obligations and applicable quality management standards throughout the project lifecycle.
    
* Coordinate with internal project teams, external consultants, contractors and client representatives to manage document flows, resolve document discrepancies and maintain data integrity across all systems.
    
* Contribute to audits and quality reviews by providing accurate document registers, logs, histories and evidence of approvals, ensuring that records are complete and traceable for all project stages.
    

**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**

* Bachelors, Diploma or specialized training in document management systems or similar software.
    
* Minimum of 8 years’ experience in document control, with at least 4 years using EDMS on large‑scale projects.
    
* Proven **expert‑level experience in Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)**, including set‑up and administration of projects, configuration of folders and permissions, management of submittals and RFIs, and control of design and construction documentation.
    
* Extensive experience in document control throughout the project lifecycle, from initiation to close‑out, using integrated project services functions.
    
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, with strong technical writing and communication skills.
    
* Proficient computer skills with experience in managing electronic documentation systems and data management applications.
    
* Preferably at least 3 years of experience working in the Gulf region.
    
* Ability to manage concurrent projects and handle large volumes of documentation in a structured and organized manner.
    
* Experience in producing detailed reports and tracking documents to ensure compliance and timely responses to project deadlines.
    

**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast‑paced project environment.
    
* Ability to work under pressure while maintaining high standards of accuracy and attention to detail.
    
* Problem‑solving skills to address and resolve document management issues promptly, including issues related to EDMS and ACC workflows.
    
* Experience with project management software and document management systems for seamless project documentation integration, including cloud‑based platforms such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).

**Job Description:**

Parsons are seeking a highly experienced and motivated **Senior Manager: Rail Systems** to join their team! This is a senior, client‑facing role embedded within an integrated client–PMC office on a major transportation program with a strong focus on rail (metro, heavy rail, light rail, high‑speed). Sitting within the PUA function, the role provides leadership, governance, and integration of all rail systems activities across multiple projects and contracts.

This is a non‑operational position: the focus is on managing and assuring the design and build process on behalf of the client—not running day‑to‑day railway operations or maintenance. The role oversees signalling and train control, telecoms, SCADASCADA, platform systems, automatic fare collection, security and other line‑wide systems, ensuring that all solutions are safe, compliant, interoperable, and aligned with program objectives.

## What You'll Be Doing;

* Act as the program‑level lead for rail systems within PUA, setting direction and priorities for rail systems across all relevant projects.
* Develop and maintain rail systems strategies, standards, and technical principles aligned with the client’s vision, regulatory requirements, and interoperability objectives.
* Ensure employer’s requirements for rail systems are clear, consistent, and properly reflected in contracts, scopes of work, and design briefs.
* Provide independent, strategic advice to senior client leadership on rail systems issues, risks, opportunities, and long‑term implications.
* Oversee rail systems scope across multiple projects and packages (signalling, telecoms, SCADASCADA, platform systems, AFC, security, control centres, line‑wide systems).
* Coordinate and align project‑level rail systems managers and engineers to ensure consistent technical approaches, assumptions, and interfaces.
* Review and challenge project plans for rail systems design, procurement, installation, testing, and commissioning to ensure realism and alignment with program milestones.
* Drive resolution of cross‑project rail systems issues and conflicts, escalating to PUA and program leadership as required.
* Oversee the rail systems technical assurance framework at program level, ensuring adherence to:
    * Employer’s requirements and performance specifications
    * Local regulatory and authority requirements
    * International and industry
* Provide senior review and approval (on behalf of the client) of key rail systems design concepts, architectures, and key technical decisions.
* Ensure that requirements management, verification, and validation processes for rail systems are properly applied and evidenced.
* Support and, where necessary, chair high‑level technical and design review boards for critical rail systems decisions.
* Provide program‑level oversight of systems integration across:
    * Signalling/train control and rolling stock
    * Rail systems and civil/MEP/architectural works (rooms, routes, environmental conditions)
    * Central control centres and operational systems
    * External systems (utilities, communications providers, legacy or adjacent rail networks)
* Ensure that interface management processes and tools (interface registers, interface agreements) are consistently applied across all contracts.
* Drive resolution of major interface issues that cross project boundaries, ensuring integrated, end‑to‑end solutions that support operational concepts.
* Provide leadership on rail systems safety and RAMS at program level, in coordination with Engineering & Safety and PUA governance.
* Oversee rail systems safety cases, hazard logs, RAMS analyses, and related evidence, ensuring consistency and sufficiency for regulatory approvals.
* Coordinate with independent safety assessors, notified bodies, and regulators to plan and achieve rail systems safety approvals and certifications.
* Ensure cyber‑security requirements for critical rail systems are defined and properly integrated into contracts, designs, and assurance evidence.
* Provide program‑level oversight of rail systems testing & commissioning strategies and schedules.
* Ensure alignment of rail systems FAT, SAT, static and dynamic tests, integration tests, and trial operations across multiple projects.
* Review readiness for key program milestones (e.g., power‑on, system integration testing, trial operations, EIS) from a rail systems perspective.
* Support the client in defining and applying acceptance criteria for rail systems and in making go/no‑go recommendations for EIS.
* Work with program controls and risk teams to ensure that key rail systems activities, risks, and constraints are reflected in the integrated master schedule and risk registers.
* Identify and manage program‑level rail systems risks and opportunities, including technology, integration, safety, approvals, and supplier performance.
* Review and advise on major changes, variations, and value engineering proposals that affect rail systems scope, performance, and lifecycle costs.
* Provide concise, high‑quality reporting and briefings to program governance bodies on rail systems progress, risk, and decision needs.
* Coordinate with internal client stakeholders (Operations, Maintenance, Safety, IT, Commercial, Customer Experience) to ensure rail systems support operational concepts and service levels.
* Work closely with future operators/maintainers to incorporate operational requirements and maintenance strategies into rail systems design and acceptance.
* Engage with regulators, transport authorities, and adjacent infrastructure owners where rail systems interface with external networks or shared assets.
* Support communication with external stakeholders where rail systems technology, safety, or performance is a key concern.
* Lead and mentor rail systems managers and engineers within the integrated client–PMC environment; foster a high‑performance, collaborative culture.
* Build capability in rail systems and systems integration within the PUA and client teams, including training, knowledge sharing, and lessons learned.
* Promote best practice in rail systems engineering, integration, and assurance across all projects.
* Contribute to succession planning and long‑term capability development for rail systems disciplines.

## What You'll Bring;

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Control/Systems Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Master’s degree in Railway Systems, Transportation Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Project/Program Management is an advantage.
* Professional registration/chartership (e.g., CEng, PE, or equivalent) is highly desirable.
* Project/program management certification is an advantage.
* 15+ years’ experience in rail systems engineering on major rail/metro/light rail/high‑speed rail programs.
* Significant experience in a PMC, client organization, or major consultancy, including program‑ or portfolio‑level rail systems responsibility.
* Proven track record in systems integration, technical assurance, RAMS, and safety certification for rail systems.
* Demonstrated experience working within integrated client/PMC environments and leading multi‑disciplinary teams and multiple contractors/OEMs.
* Experience across multiple delivery phases (design, procurement, installation, testing & commissioning, EIS) is essential.
* Deep technical understanding of rail systems architectures and technologies (signalling/train control, telecoms, SCADA, platform systems, AFC, security, control centres).
* Strong knowledge of systems engineering, integration, and RAMS processes (including CENELEC norms for safety‑related systems).
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills at senior levels.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem‑solving abilities; able to balance technical, commercial, and program considerations.
* Highly effective communication and presentation skills; able to convey complex issues clearly to non‑technical decision‑makers.
* Solid understanding of program controls (time, cost, risk) and how rail systems activities impact them.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, and commitment to client outcomes.

Job Description – Security Manager Position: Security Manager Department: Security Reports To: Director of Security / General Manager Location: InterContinental The Red Sea Resort Position Summary The Security Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all security operations across the resort to ensure the safety and security of guests, colleagues, visitors, property, and assets. The role ensures that security procedures, emergency response protocols, loss prevention measures, and IHG standards are consistently implemented and maintained. Key Responsibilities Lead and supervise the daily operations of the Security Department. Ensure the safety and security of all guests, colleagues, visitors, and resort assets. Develop, implement, and regularly review security policies, procedures, and operational standards. Conduct regular security inspections and identify potential risks, hazards, and security vulnerabilities. Monitor and manage CCTV, access control, alarm systems, and other security systems. Coordinate emergency response procedures, including fire, medical emergencies, evacuation, and other incidents. Investigate security incidents, accidents, theft, loss, and other reported cases, ensuring accurate documentation and follow-up. Prepare and maintain detailed security reports, incident reports, daily logs, and investigation records. Coordinate with local authorities, emergency services, and relevant external agencies when required. Manage access control and ensure appropriate authorization for colleagues, contractors, suppliers, and visitors. Oversee the security of guest areas, back-of-house areas, staff facilities, parking areas, and other resort premises. Conduct regular patrols and ensure appropriate security coverage across the property. Lead security briefings, training sessions, drills, and emergency preparedness exercises. Ensure all Security colleagues are properly trained, briefed, and equipped to perform their duties. Monitor colleague performance, attendance, grooming, conduct, and compliance with resort standards. Support investigations related to colleague misconduct, property loss, or violations of security procedures. Work closely with Human Resources, Engineering, Rooms, F&B, and other departments on security-related matters. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive security information and investigation records. Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi laws, regulations, civil defense requirements, and resort policies. Support business continuity and crisis management planning. Review security risks associated with VIP guests, events, special functions, and high-profile visits. Ensure all security equipment and systems are maintained and operational. Identify opportunities to improve security procedures, reduce risks, and enhance overall resort safety. Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management. Leadership & People Management Supervise, coach, and develop Security team members. Prepare duty rosters and ensure adequate security coverage at all times. Conduct regular briefings and communicate operational updates effectively. Monitor team performance and provide feedback and corrective action where required. Promote a culture of safety, professionalism, confidentiality, and service excellence. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Law Enforcement, Hospitality Management, or a related field is preferred. Minimum 5 years of relevant security experience , with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial position . Previous experience in a luxury hotel, resort, hospitality, or large-scale property environment is highly preferred. Strong knowledge of security operations, risk management, emergency procedures, and incident investigation. Knowledge of Saudi security, safety, and Civil Defense requirements is an advantage. Experience managing CCTV, access control, and other security technologies. Strong leadership, communication, investigation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to remain calm and make effective decisions during emergency situations. Good command of English; Arabic is highly desirable. Strong computer skills and ability to prepare professional reports and documentation. Key Competencies Leadership and Team Management Security & Risk Management Emergency Response Incident Investigation Decision Making Problem Solving Attention to Detail Communication Skills Conflict Management Confidentiality and Integrity Planning and Organization Guest Service Orientation Working Conditions The position requires flexibility to work shifts, weekends, public holidays, and during emergencies. The Security Manager must be available to respond to critical incidents and security emergencies when required. The role involves regular movement throughout the resort and may require extended periods of standing or walking.

Position Summary:

Sales consultants find potential customers for their company's products. They typically meet with clients at their own company's office or travel to the client's location and may be assigned a specific region in which to travel. Sales consultants explain the features of various products and the benefits of using them. In some instances, they also provide training in how to use the product. As a sales consultant, you can work everywhere from car dealerships to software companies. After several years in the field, consultants can progress to managerial roles.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

Recommend and select products for customers based on their individual needs.

Describe products and explain their benefits and uses to potential customers.

Communicate with customers in person, by phone and by email to understand their needs.

Maintain a working knowledge of the company's various products and services.

Establish and nurture relationships with past customers and potential customers to facilitate sales.

Find potential customers through networking, cold calling, and industry research to increase sales.

Use data to help customers understand how products can help them achieve their goals.

Complete administrative tasks, such as processing and recording sales, as needed.

Conduct presentations to demonstrate to potential clients the benefits of our products.

Establish and maintain healthy, long-term relationship with clients to generate repeat business and referrals.

Research sales statistics and establish sales potential with new businesses in our target area.

Determine new ways to make products appealing by observing the environment and current trends.

Respond to new and current client base regarding complaints and service enquiries.

Makes sales appointments with clients.

Follows up with any clients to make sure that they are satisfied.

Works with the marketing department to develop new sales strategies.

Discovers target markets and advantages of other companies.

Demonstrates advanced sales knowledge

Always looks for new ways to make products attractive to customers.

Work with marketing team to ensure collaboration.

Skills:

Outstanding Negotiation skills.

Excellent organizational skills

Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills

Experience setting sales goals.

Excellent business sense and industry expertise.

Willingness to adapt and implement new marketing strategies and sales methods.

Demonstrated and proven sales results.

Work to strict deadlines

Trust-worthy, Honest and Loyal at extreme levels

Accurate, Timely and Self-driven

Excellent Documentation & MS office skills

Excellent Time management and prioritization skills to meet deadlines and close sales in a timely manner.

Willingness to adapt and implement new marketing strategies and sales methods.

Experience and Qualifications:

Bachelor degree in Business Administration or Marketing.

Minimum 2 years of experience in a relevant area of sales.

Experience in developing leads and researching potential clients.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Document Controller - Saudi National to join our team! In this role you will get to support the effective management, control, distribution, tracking, and archiving of project documentation across a major project environment. You will work closely with multidisciplinary project teams to ensure documents are accurate, traceable, properly controlled, and processed in accordance with Parsons, client, and project document control requirements.  


## What You'll Be Doing

* Manage the receipt, registration, distribution, tracking, retrieval, and archiving of project documents and correspondence.
* Maintain accurate document registers, logs, trackers, and electronic filing systems throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure all project documents are correctly identified, numbered, coded, classified, version-controlled, and filed in accordance with approved procedures.
* Process incoming and outgoing correspondence, technical submittals, drawings, reports, RFIs, transmittals, specifications, and other project documentation.
* Review document submissions for completeness and compliance with established document control requirements prior to processing.
* Distribute documents to appropriate project team members, reviewers, contractors, consultants, and client representatives in a timely manner.
* Monitor document workflows and follow up on overdue reviews, approvals, comments, responses, and outstanding actions.
* Maintain effective revision control and ensure superseded or obsolete documents are clearly identified, withdrawn where required, and appropriately archived.
* Prepare, process, and issue document transmittals and formal document packages.
* Upload, retrieve, update, and manage documentation within the project **Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) / Common Data Environment (CDE)**.
* Maintain accurate metadata and document attributes within the EDMS/CDE to support effective search, retrieval, reporting, and traceability.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Design, Construction, Commercial, Planning, Project Controls, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and other project teams regarding documentation requirements.
* Ensure documentation complies with approved Parsons procedures, client requirements, project protocols, and established document workflows.
* Identify missing, incomplete, duplicated, incorrectly coded, or incorrectly submitted documents and coordinate corrective action with responsible parties.
* Support document control requirements associated with design reviews, technical approvals, construction activities, inspections, and project meetings.
* Maintain complete and auditable records of document submissions, reviews, approvals, revisions, and distributions.
* Support preparation of document control reports, dashboards, status summaries, overdue reports, and document registers.
* Assist project teams in retrieving records and documentation required for internal and external audits.
* Support project handover and closeout activities by ensuring required documentation is complete, correctly indexed, and properly archived.
* Assist in compiling final project records, as-built documentation, handover packages, and closeout documentation.
* Maintain confidentiality, security, and integrity of sensitive project and client information.
* Support implementation and continuous improvement of project document control processes and procedures.
* Provide guidance to project personnel regarding document numbering, workflows, revision control, and EDMS/CDE requirements.
* Perform other document control responsibilities as assigned by the Document Control Lead or Project Management.

## What Required Skills You'll Bring

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in **Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering, Records Management**, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Minimum **2+ years of relevant document control experience**, preferably within engineering, construction, infrastructure, transportation, airport, or other major project environments.
* Experience working with **Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS)** and/or **Common Data Environment (CDE)** platforms.
* Good understanding of document control principles, procedures, and project information management practices.
* Experience managing:
* Document numbering and coding
* Revision and version control
* Document registers and logs
* Transmittals
* Technical submittals
* Drawings and specifications
* RFIs and correspondence
* Review and approval workflows
* Project records and archives
* Ability to maintain accurate and traceable project documentation throughout the document lifecycle.
* Experience monitoring document workflows and following up on outstanding reviews, approvals, and responses.
* Good understanding of engineering and construction documentation and multidisciplinary project workflows.
* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Office**, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and records management skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when processing large volumes of project documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines within a fast-paced project environment.
* Strong communication, coordination, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Good command of written and spoken English.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately manage sensitive project information.  
    

## What Desired Skills You'll Bring

* Experience working on **major infrastructure, airport, transportation, buildings, or large-scale construction projects**.
* Previous experience within a **PMC, Delivery Partner, engineering consultancy, contractor, or client-side project environment**.
* Hands-on experience with document management and collaboration platforms such as: **Oracle Aconex**, **Asite**, **Procore**, **Microsoft SharePoint**, **Autodesk Construction, Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360** and Other comparable EDMS/CDE platforms
* Familiarity with client and consultant document control procedures and approval workflows.
* Experience controlling engineering drawings, technical submittals, RFIs, specifications, correspondence, reports, and construction records.
* Familiarity with document control requirements associated with design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and handover activities.
* Experience supporting document audits, project closeout, as-built documentation, and final handover packages.
* Familiarity with **ISO 19650 information management principles** is advantageous.
* Experience preparing document control KPIs, dashboards, reports, and overdue-document trackers.
* Ability to identify opportunities to improve document workflows, filing structures, and information traceability.
* Strong teamwork and customer-service mindset when supporting multidisciplinary project teams.
* Arabic language capability is an advantage for KSA-based assignments.

**Job Description:**

Parsons are looking for an exceptionally talented **Senior Highways Design SME** to join their team!

The Senior Highways Design Subject Matter Expert (SME) will act as a technical authority and trusted advisor across multiple highway and road infrastructure projects and design stages.

The primary objective is to provide independent, senior-level highway engineering expertise to ensure that all highway designs are:

Technically robust and compliant with applicable standards  
Safe, constructible, and well-coordinated with other disciplines  
Delivered efficiently to support approvals, construction, and overall program objectives

**What You'll Be Doing;**

* Act as the Client’s Highways Design Subject Matter Expert and technical authority on highway and road design.
* Provide expert advice on highway design principles, standards, and international best practice.
* Support the development, interpretation, and application of:
* Highway design criteria
* Typical sections and standard details
* Basis of Design and technical guidance documents
* Review and advise on design departures, exceptions, and non-standard solutions, ensuring risks are clearly identified and managed.
* Undertake detailed technical review of highway design deliverables at all project stages, including:
* Feasibility studies and Traffic Impact Studies
* Concept, preliminary, detailed, and Issued for Construction (IFC) designs
* Review and provide guidance on: Horizontal and vertical alignments, road hierarchy and cross-sections, Junctions, interchanges, and roundabouts,Traffic signs and road markings, Pavement design (flexible and rigid), Road drainage, Road safety and roadside features
* Ensure compliance with applicable standards, including: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia standards (e.g. CFP, SHC, MOT, MoMRA, SBC)
* Approved international standards (e.g. AASHTO, DMRB, where applicable)
* Support Safety in Design processes and road safety reviews, contributing to risk assessments and mitigation strategies.
* Provide technical input to resolve interfaces between highway design and Traffic and transport planning, Utilities and drainage, Structures and bridges, Public realm and landscape, Construction staging and temporary traffic management
* Identify design risks related to safety, constructability, cost, and program, and recommend practical mitigation measures.
* Facilitate coordinated, integrated design solutions across disciplines.
* Support the Client in technical engagement with:
* Government authorities and approval agencies
* Plot developers and delivery partners
* Design consultants and contractors
* Attend technical meetings, workshops, and coordination sessions as required.
* Assist in preparing and responding to authority comments and design submission queries.
* Provide technical oversight and challenge to highway design consultants and contractors where required.
* Attend site as necessary to support construction-related design queries and verify design intent.
* Support the Client with: Technical inputs to RFPs and scopes of work, Technical evaluation of tenders, where requested, Resolution of design-related RFIs and construction queries
* Support value engineering and design optimization initiatives to improve safety, performance, cost, and program.
* Share international best practice, lessons learned, and innovative design solutions with the Client’s teams.
* Provide mentoring, coaching, and technical guidance to Client staff involved in highways and infrastructure projects.
* Support continuous improvement of highway design standards, procedures, and design review processes.

**What You'll Bring;**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering; Master’s degree preferred.
* At least 15 years of professional experience in highway and road design.
* Minimum 5 years’ experience on projects in the Middle East (KSA experience strongly preferred).
* Proven experience on major infrastructure and master-planned developments.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in:
* Highway geometric design
* Pavement engineering
* Road drainage design
* Junction and interchange design
* Value engineering and design optimization
* Road safety and roadside design
* Experience working with approving authorities and regulatory bodies in KSA or the wider Middle East.
* Proficient working knowledge of highways design and associated software tools, such as:
* AutoCAD
* Civil 3D
* BIM platforms
* AutoTURN or equivalent swept path analysis tools

**Desired Skills;**

* Chartered Engineer or equivalent professional engineering registration.
* More than 10 years’ experience in Middle East/KSA highway projects.
* Direct experience in supporting construction and delivery phases, including site-based coordination and resolution of construction-related design issues.
* Experience in client-facing advisory roles or secondments is an advantage.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Commissioning Engineer (MEP/ICT)** to join our team!

The Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for coordinating and executing testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing, and handover activities for MEP and ICT systems across the project. The role will ensure that systems are installed, tested, commissioned, integrated, and demonstrated in accordance with approved designs, specifications, commissioning requirements, client standards, and operational requirements.

The position will coordinate closely with Engineering, Construction, Quality, HSE, ICT, MEP, vendors, specialist subcontractors, airport operations, and project management teams to ensure successful commissioning and operational readiness of all assigned systems.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Support the development and implementation of the overall Project Commissioning Plan and commissioning strategy.
* Coordinate commissioning activities for MEP and ICT systems in accordance with approved project requirements.
* Review commissioning specifications, drawings, sequences of operation, design documents, and system requirements.
* Develop and review Commissioning Procedures, Testing Scripts, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, and test records.
* Coordinate with MEP and ICT contractors, specialist subcontractors, vendors, and suppliers to ensure commissioning activities are properly planned and executed.
* Review system installation readiness prior to testing and commissioning.
* Conduct pre-commissioning inspections and readiness assessments.
* Verify that construction works are complete and that systems are ready for functional testing.
* Coordinate testing and commissioning of mechanical systems including HVAC, chilled water, ventilation, plumbing, drainage, pumps, BMS interfaces, and other MEP systems as applicable.
* Coordinate testing and commissioning of electrical interfaces associated with MEP systems where required.
* Support commissioning of ICT systems including structured cabling, network infrastructure, telecommunications, ELV systems, data networks, security systems, and ICT interfaces, as applicable.
* Coordinate functional testing and performance verification of equipment and systems against approved design criteria.
* Witness and document equipment testing, functional testing, performance testing, and integrated systems testing.
* Verify system sequences, controls, alarms, interlocks, and interfaces.
* Coordinate Building Management System (BMS) integration and functional testing for applicable MEP systems.
* Coordinate interfaces between MEP, ICT, BMS, Fire & Life Safety, Security, and other specialist systems.
* Support Integrated Systems Testing (IST) and end-to-end testing of interconnected systems.
* Coordinate testing of system interfaces and cause-and-effect sequences.
* Review and verify commissioning test results and ensure compliance with specified acceptance criteria.
* Identify commissioning issues, system deficiencies, and performance deviations and coordinate corrective actions.
* Maintain and track commissioning punch lists, defects, outstanding works, and test failures.
* Coordinate retesting and verification following corrective actions.
* Participate in troubleshooting and root cause analysis of commissioning failures.
* Coordinate with Quality teams to ensure required inspections, approvals, and quality records are completed.
* Ensure commissioning activities comply with approved Method Statements, Risk Assessments, ITPs, and HSE requirements.
* Coordinate commissioning activities with HSE teams and ensure safe testing and energization practices.
* Participate in commissioning meetings and provide regular progress updates.
* Monitor commissioning progress against the approved commissioning schedule.
* Coordinate with Planning and Project Controls teams regarding commissioning milestones and progress.
* Identify commissioning risks, constraints, interfaces, and dependencies and recommend mitigation measures.
* Review vendor commissioning procedures and ensure compliance with project requirements.
* Coordinate vendor attendance for specialist equipment testing, commissioning, and performance verification.
* Ensure calibration certificates are available and valid for all test and measurement equipment used during commissioning.
* Review testing and commissioning documentation submitted by contractors and specialist vendors.
* Maintain accurate commissioning records, test certificates, checklists, reports, and system completion documentation.
* Support the preparation and review of System Completion Certificates, Commissioning Certificates, and handover dossiers.
* Verify that all commissioning documentation is complete prior to system handover.
* Support demonstration and training of operational and maintenance personnel.
