• Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or a related field .

• Relevant experience as a Safety Officer, preferably within construction, MEP, or engineering projects .

• Good knowledge of HSE procedures, risk assessment, and workplace safety practices.

• Relevant HSE certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA, or equivalent are an advantage.

• Strong communication, observation, and reporting skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a site/project environment.

• Bilingual in Arabic and English

* Support audits and inspections conducted by the Client, Consultant, and relevant authorities.

* Ensure compliance with project HSE requirements during material inspection, testing, handling, and storage activities.
    
* Participate in technical meetings, material coordination meetings, and quality review meetings.
    
* Prepare material status reports and provide input to project quality and progress reporting.
    

## Airport / Infrastructure Specific Responsibilities

* Review materials associated with airfield works, including pavement materials, aggregates, concrete, asphalt, geosynthetics, drainage materials, utilities, roadworks, and associated infrastructure systems.
    
* Ensure materials used for runway, taxiway, apron, roads, utilities, and external works comply with project and aviation requirements.
    
* Coordinate testing and acceptance of aggregates, asphalt, concrete, soil, sub-base, base-course, and other civil construction materials.
    
* Review material requirements for airfield pavement systems and associated infrastructure works.
    
* Coordinate with specialist testing laboratories for field and laboratory testing activities.
    
* Support verification of material compliance with applicable ASTM, AASHTO, BS/EN, FAA, ICAO, and project-specific requirements, as applicable.

* Strong knowledge of construction materials, laboratory testing, material specifications, and quality control procedures.
    
* Experience with Material Submittals, MARs, ITPs, MIRs, NCRs, RFIs, and technical documentation.
    
* Familiarity with ASTM, AASHTO, BS/EN and other relevant international standards.
    
* Experience coordinating with material suppliers, manufacturers, testing laboratories, contractors, consultants, and Clients.
    
* Strong understanding of material approval, inspection, testing, storage, handling, and traceability processes.
    
* Previous experience on airport or airfield projects will be highly advantageous.

* Material Submittal & Approval
    
* Specification Compliance

* Material Inspection

Job Description

We take laundry seriously. So, we’re searching for a Laundry Attendant with an exceptional eye for detail and a passion for perfection to make sure every single linen and guest item is washed, dried, and folded to meet our exceptional standards.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:

● Sorting laundry by colour, material, and level of soiling

● Inspecting all laundry and linen for damage or stains – keeping a record of any items that don’t make the grade

● Operating washers and dryers to their recommended capacity and manufacturer guidelines

● Adding the correct chemicals in the right quantities for each wash cycle

● Folding and storing clean linen – operating the linen feeder, sheet folder, towel folder and table linen ironing machines

What We need from you:

● It’s a physical role and you’ll be on your feet most of the day, so fitness is important

● Carrying or lifting items weighing up to 75 pounds and pushing and/or pulling approximately 400 pounds

● You may need to bend, stoop, and kneel to complete some activities

● Frequently working in areas of high temperatures around heavy equipment

● Reading and writing abilities and basic math skills are utilized when determining amounts of chemicals to treat laundry and stains and logging appropriate poundage.

● Outstanding organizational and time management skills

This individual will oversee the entire design lifecycle, from conceptualization to execution, ensuring that all aspects of the project meet the client’s vision and luxury standards.

* Provide leadership and mentorship to design teams, ensuring high-quality outcomes and consistency across all design elements.

* Collaborate with international consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure that all design aspects (architecture, interiors, MEP, and landscaping) are harmoniously integrated into the project.

* Regularly review design deliverables, providing feedback and ensuring that all project milestones are met on time and within budget.
    
* Ensure that all design elements comply with local and international building codes, sustainability requirements, and PMC quality protocols.

* Serve as the primary liaison with the client, ensuring that their vision for the project is fully understood and realized through design solutions.
    
* Prepare and present design proposals, concepts, and updates to the client, incorporating their feedback while maintaining the integrity of the luxury design vision.
    
* Manage client expectations throughout the project lifecycle, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring satisfaction with the final design.
    

**Budget & Schedule Management:**

* Work closely with the PMC project management team to ensure that design solutions align with project budgets and timelines without compromising on luxury standards.
    
* Review cost estimates for design elements, ensuring that material selections and construction details are financially viable while meeting the luxury project’s requirements.

* Integrate sustainable design practices and technologies into the project, enhancing both environmental performance and guest experience without sacrificing luxury.

* Proven experience working in a PMC environment, with a deep understanding of PMC processes and client-focused project delivery.

* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively articulate design concepts to clients and stakeholders.
    
* A keen eye for detail and an innate understanding of luxury aesthetics and client expectations.
    
* Professional certification in Architecture or Interior Design.
    
* Experience working with globally recognized hospitality brands or luxury hotel chains.
    
* A deep understanding of international luxury hospitality standards and brand identity requirements.

### Job Summary

The Community Inspector is responsible for conducting routine inspections across residential and mixed-use communities to ensure compliance with community rules, municipal regulations, health and safety standards, and property management requirements. The role focuses on maintaining community appearance, resident satisfaction, and operational excellence by identifying, reporting, and following up on violations and maintenance issues.

### Key Responsibilities

### Community Inspections

* Conduct regular inspections of residential, commercial, and common areas within the community.
* Identify violations related to community rules, property standards, landscaping, parking, waste management, and public safety.
* Monitor community facilities, amenities, and infrastructure to ensure they are maintained to required standards.
* Report defects, damages, and maintenance requirements to relevant departments.

### Compliance Monitoring

* Ensure compliance with community management policies, municipal regulations, and environmental standards.
* Inspect contractor activities to verify adherence to approved standards and safety requirements.
* Document violations and initiate corrective action procedures.
* Follow up on outstanding violations and ensure timely resolution.

### Resident & Stakeholder Engagement

* Respond to resident complaints and service requests related to community conditions.
* Provide guidance to residents and tenants regarding community regulations and standards.
* Coordinate with property management teams, maintenance contractors, and external authorities when required.

### Reporting & Documentation

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inspection reports.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, findings, violations, and corrective actions.
* Use inspection software, mobile applications, or property management systems to record observations and track resolutions.
* Generate photographic evidence and detailed reports for management review.

### Health, Safety & Environmental Monitoring

* Identify potential health and safety hazards within the community.
* Ensure public areas are clean, safe, and accessible.
* Monitor waste disposal practices and environmental compliance.
* Report emergency situations and support incident investigations when necessary.

### Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Property Management, Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, or a related field.
* Professional certifications in Property Management, Facilities Management, or Health & Safety are an advantage.

### Experience

* 5-7 years of experience in community management, facilities management, property inspection, municipal inspection, or related fields.
* Experience within residential communities, mixed-use developments, hospitality destinations, or real estate projects preferred.

The role provides city-wide coordination and assurance across Estate Management, City Operations, Asset

Management, Finance, districts, operators and delivery teams to ensure operational costs, common area services and shared infrastructure are appropriately understood, allocated and recoverable where applicable.The role acts as the owner and custodian of the city-wide service charge model, providing governance, oversight and assurance over cost allocation methodologies, cost recovery structures and service charge assumptions. The position also leads the identification and evaluation of revenue opportunities across city assets, facilities, infrastructure and common areas, ensuring opportunities are assessed from operational, commercial and asset-management perspectives before recommendations are escalated to senior management. The role directs the Service Charges & Revenue Senior Manager and works closely with Lifecycle Planning, Finance, Asset Management, City Operations and district stakeholders to support long-term operational sustainability, financial resilience and value optimization across the city operating model.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Service Charge Framework and Governance**

• Establish and maintain the city-wide service charge framework, governance structure, policies, methodologies and

operating principles across applicable assets, facilities, services and districts.

• Develop and maintain service charge allocation principles, recharge methodologies, cost categorization structures and

governance requirements.

• Ensure service charge arrangements are transparent, equitable, auditable and aligned with approved operational and

commercial objectives.

• Own annual service charge review processes, governance controls, methodology updates and assurance requirements.

• Develop policy recommendations relating to service charge methodologies and governance arrangements for leadership

review and approval.

• Ensure service charge approaches remain aligned with operating models, asset ownership structures, operational

responsibilities and district requirements.

• Promote consistency in charging practices and cost recovery principles across the wider city operating model.

• Provide leadership reporting on service charge governance effectiveness, risks, issues and improvement opportunities.

**2\. City-Wide Service Charge Model Ownership**

• Own and maintain the city-wide service charge model and supporting governance arrangements.

• Coordinate inputs from Asset Management, City Operations, Finance, districts, operators and external advisors to ensure

model integrity and consistency.

• Review and challenge charging assumptions, allocation methodologies, cost drivers and model outputs to ensure robust

decision making.

• Ensure common area services, shared infrastructure, public realm assets and city-wide services are appropriately

reflected within service charge calculations.

• Maintain transparent assumptions, supporting evidence and governance records for all significant model decisions.

• Monitor model effectiveness and ensure assumptions evolve in line with city growth, asset commissioning and operational

maturity.

• Develop management information, dashboards and reporting outputs to support leadership review and decision making.

• Support periodic reviews of service charge affordability, allocation fairness and cost recovery effectiveness.

**3\. Revenue Strategy and Commercial Opportunity Assessment**

• Lead the identification and evaluation of revenue-generating opportunities associated with city assets, infrastructure,

facilities, services and common areas.

• Assess emerging opportunities that support operational sustainability and maximize value from city-owned or city-

managed assets.

• Coordinate commercial evaluations of potential revenue streams, recovery mechanisms and value-generation initiatives.

• Develop business case inputs, financial assessments and strategic recommendations for leadership consideration.

• Ensure revenue opportunities are evaluated against operational requirements, customer experience expectations and

long-term city objectives.

• Maintain visibility of revenue-generating initiatives across districts, operators and asset portfolios.

• Monitor market developments and emerging trends that may create future revenue opportunities for the city.

• Provide evidence-based recommendations regarding potential revenue generation, value optimization and cost recovery

enhancement.

**4\. OPEX and Lifecycle Cost Integration**

• Ensure service charge assumptions appropriately reflect approved service levels, operational requirements and operating

delivery models.

• Work closely with the Asset Lifecycle Planning & Integration Director to incorporate lifecycle forecasts, renewal obligations

and long-term asset funding requirements into service charge considerations.

• Ensure lifecycle cost impacts and renewal pressures are visible during service charge reviews and cost recovery

assessments.

• Coordinate discussions regarding maintenance obligations, service standards, lifecycle exposure and cost allocation

assumptions.

• Challenge cost assumptions where opportunities exist to improve efficiency, affordability or value for money.

• Support integrated planning through clear visibility of operational expenditure, lifecycle obligations and recovery

opportunities.

• Promote alignment between operational sustainability objectives and cost recovery strategies.

**5\. Financial Assurance and Cost Recovery Performance**

• Maintain a consolidated city-wide view of operational costs, service charge assumptions, recovery methodologies and

cost allocation structures.

• Review cost recovery performance and identify variances, risks, affordability issues, recovery gaps and potential revenue

leakage.

• Coordinate assurance activities relating to service charge calculations, allocation methodologies and recovery

assumptions.

• Provide recommendations to improve transparency, accountability and effectiveness of cost recovery arrangements.

• Support leadership reporting on cost recovery performance, service charge outcomes and operational affordability

pressures.

• Monitor trends, exceptions and performance indicators to identify emerging risks and improvement opportunities.

• Ensure service charge arrangements remain sustainable and support long-term operational and financial objectives.

• Develop governance reporting and performance dashboards covering cost recovery effectiveness and financial resilience.

**6\. District, Operator and Stakeholder Interface**

• Build strong working relationships with districts, operators, City Operations, Asset Management, Finance and governance

stakeholders.

• Coordinate stakeholder engagement activities associated with service charges, revenue generation and cost recovery

initiatives.

recovery mechanisms.

governance arrangements.

• Support resolution of service charge and cost allocation issues through structured engagement, analysis and

recommendations.

• Promote transparency and understanding of charging methodologies and governance requirements across stakeholders.

• Support senior leadership engagement on financially significant recovery, charging and revenue matters.

• Facilitate cross-functional reviews of emerging operational, commercial and cost recovery challenges.

**7\. Consultant and Commercial Management**

and revenue initiatives.

• Manage consultant activities, outputs, recommendations and reporting requirements.

• Review benchmarking studies, financial assessments, charge methodologies, governance recommendations and

commercial evaluations.

• Ensure consultant outputs are evidence-based, practical and aligned with Estate Management objectives.

• Ensure consultant recommendations are translated into practical governance improvements and decision-support

### 1\. Strategy, Governance and Function Leadership

·   Develop, maintain and implement the Programme Event Mobility Strategy, governance framework, operating model, standards, policies and planning calendar.

·   Create a scalable mobility capability covering business-as-usual destination operations, recurring events, overlapping event programmes and major-event overlays.

·   Lead the development, assurance and approval of integrated Event Mobility Plans for the full event lifecycle, from concept and feasibility through readiness, live delivery and post-event review.

·   Convert event attendance profiles, venue capacities, session schedules and origin-destination assumptions into transport demand forecasts, mode-share targets and time-phased arrival and departure plans.

·   Plan distinct mobility journeys for general admission guests, hospitality customers, VIPs, athletes, performers, officials, workforce, volunteers, media, people of determination and emergency responders.

·   Coordinate mobility plans across simultaneous events to manage cumulative demand, shared infrastructure, operational conflicts and network resilience.

·   Maintain an integrated mobility planning schedule with defined submissions, reviews, approvals, exercises and operational handover gates.

### 3\. Traffic, Access and Parking Planning

·   Oversee Traffic Management Plans, road network assessments, access-control strategies, temporary traffic management, diversions, closures, pick-up and drop-off areas and emergency access routes.

·   Develop event parking strategies covering pre-booked parking, park-and-ride, VIP and hospitality allocation, workforce parking, accessible parking, overflow arrangements and parking technology.

·   Ensure vehicle access, accreditation and permit arrangements align with security zoning, venue ingress and egress, logistics windows and public-realm requirements.

·   Use modelling, scenario testing and live operational data to validate assumptions and optimise road, kerbside and parking capacity.

### 4\. Public Transport, Shuttle and Active Mobility Integration

·   Design integrated bus, shuttle, public transport, taxi and ride-hailing service plans with clear capacities, frequencies, staging, layover, dispatch, queuing and passenger information requirements.

·   Coordinate park-and-ride and remote transport hub operations, including fleet sizing, boarding processes, accessibility, contingency vehicles and demand management.

·   Integrate walking, micromobility and last-mile routes with venue, public-realm, wayfinding, crowd management and accessibility plans.

·   Agree service levels, operational interfaces and recovery arrangements with mobility operators and delivery partners.

### 5\. VIP, Hospitality and Specialist Movements

·   Develop secure, discreet and service-led mobility plans for Royal, government, VIP, sponsor, hospitality and protocol movements.

·   Coordinate premium ground transport, coach, chauffeur, charter and aviation interfaces where required, in partnership with security, protocol and specialist providers.

·   Establish holding, dispatch, route, access, parking and contingency arrangements that protect both guest experience and network performance.

### 6\. Logistics and Operational Interface

·   Integrate freight, servicing, waste, catering, retail, broadcast and contractor movements with the guest mobility plan to minimise conflicts and maintain operational continuity.

·   Coordinate delivery routes, vehicle staging, holding areas, time windows, access permits and back-of-house interfaces with the City Logistics function and venue operators.

·   Ensure emergency service routes and incident response access are protected throughout build, event and breakdown phases.

### 7\. Operational Readiness and Live Event Delivery

·   Lead mobility readiness reviews, tabletop exercises, simulations, test events, route proving and operational rehearsals.

·   Define mobility command, control, communications, reporting and escalation arrangements, including integration with the City Command and Control Unit and relevant event control rooms.

·   Provide senior mobility leadership during live operations, ensuring timely decisions, coordinated issue resolution and deployment of contingency measures.

·   Lead structured post-event reviews, capture lessons learned and ensure corrective actions are incorporated into future plans and standards.

### 8\. Stakeholder, Commercial and Supplier Management

·   Build effective working relationships with transport authorities, traffic police, emergency services, public transport operators, districts, venues, hotels, event organisers, service providers and relevant government entities.

·   Lead multi-agency mobility workshops, design reviews, readiness forums and executive reporting.

·   Develop scopes, procurement strategies and performance requirements for mobility planning, modelling, technology and event delivery services.

·   Ensure suppliers are appropriately qualified, locally compliant and capable of mobilising suitable Saudi-based resources and workforce development plans.

·   Own assigned budgets, forecasts, commercial evaluations, contract performance and value-for-money initiatives.

·   Bachelor's degree in Transport Planning, Civil or Transportation Engineering, Urban Planning, Logistics, Operations Management or a related discipline.

·   Master's degree in a relevant discipline is preferred.

·   Professional membership or certification in transport planning, traffic engineering, project management, event management or a related field is desirable.

### Experience

·   Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in transport planning, mobility operations, traffic engineering, major event transport (FIFA World Cup or Olympics), city operations or major infrastructure, including at least 8 years in senior leadership roles.

·   Demonstrable accountability for mobility planning and operational delivery for major sporting, entertainment, cultural or destination events.

Lead and manage worker welfare across Qiddiya's operational environment, ensuring safe, healthy, dignified and compliant living and working conditions for employees, contractors and service providers operating within Qiddiya-controlled assets, venues, precincts, events and public realm environments.

Own the development, implementation and assurance of city-wide worker welfare standards, management systems and improvement programmes covering accommodation, transport, catering and food services, hygiene, recreation, wellbeing and workforce support services. Provide operational oversight of welfare performance across multiple assets and service providers, ensuring compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, client and Qiddiya requirements.

Partner closely with Operations, Operational Readiness, Facilities Management, HSE, HR, Security, Transport, Procurement and contractor organizations to identify welfare risks, drive corrective actions, support mobilisation and readiness activities, investigate concerns and continuously improve workforce wellbeing outcomes across the city portfolio.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Worker Welfare Governance**

**•** Develop, implement, maintain and continuously improve the Qiddiya City Operations Worker Welfare Framework, standards, procedures, management plans and assurance programs.

**•** Own and maintain the Worker Welfare Management Plan for operational assets and city-wide operations, ensuring consistent implementation across all locations, shifts, service providers and contractors.

**•** Ensure worker welfare requirements are integrated into operational policies, contractor management processes, mobilisation activities and operational risk management programs.

**•** Provide subject matter expertise on worker welfare, labor standards and workforce wellbeing matters across City Operations.

**Operational Assurance & Compliance**

**•** Lead a risk-based programme of inspections, audits and assurance activities covering accommodation, welfare facilities, transport, sanitation, water quality, pest control, housekeeping, recreational facilities, wellbeing services and workforce support arrangements.

**•** Lead assurance of contractor and service provider compliance with Qiddiya Worker Welfare Standards through inspections, audits, performance reviews and evidence-based verification activities.

**•** Monitor corrective actions arising from audits, inspections, complaints and investigations and ensure timely, evidenced closure.

**•** Maintain readiness for internal, client and regulatory inspections through effective governance, reporting and record management.

**Contractor & Service Provider Management**

**•** Manage welfare-related contractors and service providers, including accommodation operators, Facilities Management providers, transport contractors, catering providers, cleaning services, security providers and other workforce support functions.

**•** Define welfare requirements, service expectations, SLAs, KPIs and performance standards within contracts and service agreements.

**•** Lead contractor and vendor performance reviews relating to worker welfare and workforce wellbeing, and drive corrective and preventive actions.

**•** Support Procurement and Contractor Management teams during contractor onboarding, mobilisation and ongoing assurance activities.

**Operational Readiness & Asset Handover**

**•** Support operational readiness, mobilisation and asset handover programmes by ensuring worker welfare requirements are incorporated into design reviews, commissioning, mobilisation and go-live activities.

**•** Review workforce accommodation, transport, welfare facilities and support arrangements for new operational assets and services before commencement.

**•** Participate in readiness reviews, stage-gate approvals and operational assurance activities to verify worker welfare controls are in place before assets or services become operational.

**•** Ensure welfare considerations are included within contingency planning and emergency preparedness arrangements.

**Events & Temporary Workforce Welfare**

**•** Provide worker welfare oversight and assurance for temporary, seasonal and event-related workforces operating across Qiddiya-controlled assets, venues, events and public realm environments.

**•** Ensure appropriate welfare arrangements are established for major events, peak operational periods and contractor mobilisation activities.

**•** Monitor and address welfare risks associated with extended working hours, heat stress, transport, accommodation, temporary facilities and workforce support arrangements.

**Grievance Management & Workforce Engagement**

**•** Operate and oversee worker welfare grievance, escalation and reporting mechanisms, including accessible and confidential reporting channels.

**•** Ensure concerns are triaged, investigated and closed promptly, fairly and consistently, with appropriate corrective actions and records.

**•** Analyse trends, identify systemic issues and implement preventative measures to improve workforce wellbeing outcomes.

**•** Promote worker engagement, awareness and wellbeing initiatives across operational environments and contractor workforces.

**Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

**•** Develop and maintain city-wide worker welfare dashboards, KPIs and performance reports covering audit results, accommodation compliance, grievance trends, heat stress controls, contractor compliance, workforce engagement, service quality, non-conformances and corrective action closure.

**•** Provide regular performance, risk and assurance reports to Operations leadership and relevant governance forums, including client updates where required.

**•** Chair or participate in management reviews with Operations, Facilities Management and service providers.

**•** Use performance data, benchmarking, worker feedback and assurance findings to drive continuous improvement across City Operations.

**Leadership & People Management**

**•** Lead and develop the worker welfare team across multiple operational locations and assets, setting clear roles, accountabilities and escalation arrangements.

**•** Establish competency, training and development programmes for welfare personnel and ensure effective coverage across the city portfolio.

**•** Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, contractors, regulators and external service providers to improve worker welfare outcomes.

**•** Bachelor's degree in Social Sciences, Public Health, Occupational Health & Safety, Facilities Management, Hospitality Management or a related discipline.

**• 7**\+ years of experience in worker welfare, accommodation or camp operations, social compliance, facilities or property operations, or workforce services within large, multi-site operational environments.

**•** Experience supporting operational readiness, mobilisation, asset handover, major events or peak operational periods is preferred.

**•** Proactive, self-directed and able to work independently across a dispersed portfolio, using initiative to identify issues early, drive improvements and follow through to closure.

job_title: Senior Manager - Supply Chain & Workforce Competency - Entertainment Operations
description:
The Senior Manager - Entertainment Operations Maintenance (Supply Chain & workforce competency) establishes and governs the frameworks at corporate level, applicable portfolio wise:

▪ Technical Supply Chain Governance - sets portfolio requirements for critical spares part, tools, inventory, central warehousing and lifecycle support; across SEVEN stakeholders

▪  Technical Training & Competency Management - defines competency standards, training pathways, assessment evidence and portfolio tracking

▪ Technical Document Control - governs technical files, asset information, records and document-management structures; management of changes.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES/ ACCOUNTABILITIES**

▪  Establish, maintain and periodically review the corporate frameworks, policies and minimum controls for the assigned disciplines

▪ Define clear governance boundaries: set the framework, monitors implementation and reports systemic issues

▪ Develop and maintain the technical supply chain framework for attraction maintenance, covering critical spares, consumables, special tools, test equipment, inventory criticality, obsolescence and lifecycle support.  
▪ Define minimum requirements of assets listed under the Master asset list system; simultaneously defining spare parts, and consumables classification, specifications, master data, traceability, storage and preservation, stock-control principles and EAM/ERP/CMMS linkage.  
▪ Establish standard templates and controls for technical requisitions, OEM/vendor information, long-lead visibility, warranty support and supplier-performance reporting, and support portfolio vendor strategies with the corporate stakeholders (Finance, Payroll, Procurement, Logistics, and IT).  
▪ Manage Central Warehouse receiving operations, including physical and documentary verification of incoming items, quantity and condition checks, discrepancy recording and escalation, system receipt and Goods Receipt Note (GRN) processing, and appropriate storage, preservation, traceability and stock visibility.  
▪ Review complex implementation and portfolio data through periodic functional governance assessments, report systemic risks affecting availability, maintainability or cost, and initiate corrective actions based on his own audits, department’s observations, and internal, external, or authority audits findings.

▪ Establish and maintain the corporate framework for role-, asset- and task-based competency requirements, training pathways, assessment evidence, authorisation levels and renewal criteria.  
▪ Own the corporate competency framework, tracker methodology and consolidated portfolio competency view. Maintain a clear distinction between training attendance, assessed competence.  
▪ Define minimum templates and records for training, assessment, refresher activities, mentoring and OEM knowledge transfer in coordination with Learning & Development and approved providers.  
▪ Monitor framework implementation and competency-data quality, using governance reviews, performance trends, incidents, internal or external audit findings, OEM recommendations and other stakeholder inputs to identify gaps, expiries and capability risks.  
▪ Define and initiate actions, such as new or revised training materials, toolbox talks, refresher or remedial training, competency reassessment or updated requirements, and track implementation and effectiveness through the responsible Complex Technical Managers.

▪ Develop and maintain the corporate technical document-control framework, covering ownership, review, approval, revision, access, distribution, retention, supersession and handover.  
▪ Define standard technical-file requirements, registers, naming conventions, attributes, metadata, taxonomies and EDMS or shared-drive structures for attraction technical information and records.  
▪ Define, in coordination with Asset Management and EAM/CMMS/IT system owners, asset-information requirements, including classification, master data, tagging and links between assets, maintenance plans, documents, spare parts, tools and competency requirements within EAM/CMMS/ERP systems.  
▪ Review complex-level implementation, completeness, currentness and accessibility through periodic functional governance assessments; report gaps and follow up closure.

**Requirements**

▪ Bachelor's degree in supply chain, logistics, business administration, operations, asset management, engineering or another relevant discipline.  
▪ A postgraduate qualification in management, operations, logistics or a related discipline is desirable.  
▪ Professional qualification in supply chain, logistics or transport is desirable.  
▪ Relevant ERP/EAM/CMMS, document management, or technical training and competency certification is advantageous.

## Position Overview

Reporting to the Project Director, the Project Manager will be responsible for the overall planning, coordination, execution, and control of construction projects, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and in accordance with the required quality and safety standards.

Acting as the Owner's Representative, the Project Manager will safeguard Aviagen's interests throughout all phases of the project, ensuring that business objectives, contractual commitments, and strategic priorities are achieved.

The role serves as the primary coordination point between the Project Director, site supervisors, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders, providing leadership throughout construction, commissioning, and final handover.

## Key Responsibilities

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and completion of projects, ensuring alignment with approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
    
* Report regularly to the Project Director and Senior Project Management Team on project performance, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
    
* Coordinate and manage relationships with consultants, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient project delivery.
    
* Act as the key interface between engineering disciplines and site teams, ensuring the accurate implementation of designs and technical specifications.
    
* Provide direction and oversight to site supervisors and ensure consistency in decision-making and project execution.
    
* Monitor project progress against established schedules and proactively implement corrective actions where required.
    
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, change orders, and cost control measures.
    
* Review and approve progress certificates, contractor claims, variation orders, and payment applications.
    
* Lead, coordinate, and support the site supervision team across multiple project locations.
    
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, project specifications, quality standards, HSE requirements, and local regulatory requirements.
    
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while effectively managing project changes.
    
* Chair project meetings and ensure timely follow-up and closure of action items.
    
* Prepare and deliver regular project status reports, highlighting progress, key achievements, risks, and critical decisions.
    

## Qualifications & Experience

## *Required*

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
    
* Minimum 10 years of experience in project management, construction management, or major capital projects.
    
* Proven experience managing large-scale industrial, agricultural, infrastructure, or manufacturing construction projects.
    
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, contract administration, project controls, budgeting, scheduling, and risk management.
    
* Demonstrated leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and consultants.
    
* Strong commercial awareness and experience managing project costs and contractual matters.
    
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, analytical, and organizational skills.
    
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management software, scheduling tools, and reporting systems.
    
* Fluent in English.
    

## *Preferred*

* Experience within poultry, agribusiness, food production, or industrial facility construction projects.
    
* Previous experience working in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC region.
    
* Familiarity with KSA construction regulations, permitting processes, and local business practices.
    
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar project management tools.
    
* English is a must & Arabic language skills would be an advantage.
    

## What We Offer

This is a unique opportunity to play a leading role in one of Aviagen's most significant strategic investments in the region. The successful candidate will work alongside international experts and contribute to the successful delivery of a world-class poultry production operation in Saudi Arabia.

  

We play a leading role in feeding the world's future generations.  
  
We bring smart, passionate people together and watch amazing things happen!

  

Working at Aviagen presents career opportunities that impact an industry. We encourage people to bring their experience and knowledge and help work on complex issues that will shape the future of the poultry industry. In an environment that promotes innovation and progressive approaches to problem solving, Aviagen is working today to be ready for what tomorrow may bring. Are you ready for the adventure?

### About the Role

We are looking for an **API Developer (Integration Engineer)** to design, build, and maintain the integration layer connecting a digital Residents and Tenants Portal with various third-party and enterprise systems.

You will be responsible for developing secure and reliable APIs and middleware that enable key platform capabilities including authentication, e-signature, payments, access control, CRM integrations, and notifications.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in backend development and API integrations, with a solid understanding of API security, authentication protocols, webhooks, and event-driven architectures.

### Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and integrations with third-party and enterprise systems.
* Integrate with identity and authentication providers to support SSO, 2FA, password reset, and session management.
* Develop integrations with e-signature platforms such as DocuSign or similar solutions to support contracts, addendums, and termination workflows.
* Integrate with CRM and leasing systems to synchronize unit listings, inquiries, leads, offers, and other relevant data.
* Develop integrations with access-control systems for access cards, visitor codes, and vehicle registration.
* Support payment and invoicing integrations, including invoice generation triggers, proof-of-payment workflows, and payment-status synchronization.

* Build middleware and orchestration logic to keep data and application states synchronized across multiple systems.
* Define and maintain API contracts using **OpenAPI/Swagger**.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms using **OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT**.
* Design robust error-handling, retry, and recovery strategies for integrations.
* Implement webhook and event-driven handlers for asynchronous workflows such as e-signature completion, payment confirmation, and access-control approvals.
* Coordinate with internal teams, client IT teams, and third-party vendors to manage integration environments, credentials, and API access.
* Support the promotion of integrations from sandbox/testing environments to production.
* Develop integration, API, and contract tests and support QA and UAT activities.
* Monitor API performance, logs, and error rates and troubleshoot integration issues during production and hypercare periods.
* Maintain technical documentation, integration architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks to support knowledge transfer and handover.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, product teams, and external vendors to ensure successful delivery of integration-dependent features.

**Requirements**

* **4+ years of experience** in API development, backend development, or integration engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience building and consuming **REST/JSON APIs** in production environments.
* Solid understanding of **OAuth2, OIDC, JWT**, and webhook-based architectures.
* Experience integrating with at least one e-signature platform such as **DocuSign, Adobe Sign**, or a similar solution.
* Hands-on experience with **SSO and identity providers** such as Azure AD, Okta, Auth0, or similar.
* Strong proficiency in at least one backend technology such as **Node.js, .NET, or Java**.
* Experience working with **API gateways, middleware, message queues, or iPaaS solutions**.
* Experience with API testing tools such as **Postman/Newman**.
* Strong understanding of **API security best practices**, including rate limiting, input validation, authentication/authorization, and secrets management.
* Experience designing integrations and translating business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into technical solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of integration testing and production support practices.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

### Nice to Have

* Experience working with access-control or physical-security system APIs, such as **Genetec, Lenel**, or similar.
* Experience integrating with real-estate or leasing CRM platforms such as **Yardi, MRI, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics**.
* Experience with **Azure API Management, MuleSoft**, or similar API management/integration platforms.
* Experience working with event-driven architectures and message brokers.
* Experience working in enterprise integration or digital transformation projects.

### What Success Looks Like

* All required third-party and enterprise integrations are delivered, tested, and successfully pass UAT.
* APIs and integrations are secure, reliable, and scalable.
* Integration-related issues are identified and resolved within agreed SLAs.
* API and integration documentation is complete and clear enough to support the client's internal teams after handover.
* Smooth collaboration with client IT teams, vendors, developers, QA, and other stakeholders throughout implementation and production support.

job_title: Staff Product Manager - Shipping and Fulfillment
description:
About the Role

Over 100,000 merchants run their businesses on Salla, and every order they win ends the same way: something physical has to reach a customer. Shipping is where the platform stops being software.

This role owns the shipping stack end to end and the economics underneath it: courier integrations, routing, cash-on-delivery reconciliation, exceptions, and partner performance, plus how far past last-mile delivery we go into inventory placement, warehousing, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, and returns. You lead a dedicated engineering squad as its one accountable product owner, and you own what a shipment costs and what the platform keeps on it. Few product roles let you own a merchant experience and its unit economics at the same time. This one does.

You will drive impact across four major domains:

* **Shipping Products** (routing, label issuance, cash on delivery, tracking, driver-facing tools)
* **Partner Integrations** (provider onboarding, interface quality, status mapping, reconciliation, platform stability)
* **Fulfillment Beyond Last Mile** (inventory placement, warehousing and third-party orchestration, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, returns)
* **Shipping Economics** (carrier mix, rate card design, cost per successful delivery, what the platform charges and what it keeps)

### Responsibilities:

* Own the strategy and roadmap for shipping and fulfillment, prioritized on merchant retention and contribution per shipment, not feature count.
* Decide how each order is routed and priced: which provider carries it, at what service level, at what cost, and what the merchant pays.
* Raise delivery reliability where it is measurable: first-attempt success, service-level accuracy, exception rate, return to origin, and cash-on-delivery reconciliation.
* Build the integration layer that makes onboarding a new provider fast and keeps it stable once live: status mapping, retries, fallbacks, monitoring.
* Extend the product past last-mile delivery, choosing capabilities on merchant retention impact rather than on integration ease.
* Decide which shipping capability is free and which is paid, and defend where the line sits.
* Own the metrics with the data team, and move volume between providers when the performance data says to.

**Requirements**

* Proven ownership of a shipping, fulfillment, or order-management product on a platform serving many businesses at once, with the numbers you moved: delivery success rate, service-level accuracy, exception rate, cash-on-delivery accuracy, or cost per shipment.
* Commercial fluency in shipment economics: you have built, priced, or renegotiated a rate card, and can explain how zone, weight, service level, cash on delivery, surcharges, and failed deliveries move cost per parcel.
* Depth past last-mile delivery in at least two of: inventory placement, warehousing or third-party fulfillment orchestration, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, reverse logistics, cross-border.
* Technical grounding in integrations: interfaces, webhooks, status mapping, retries, reconciliation. You can explain how a courier integration actually breaks and what made yours stable long term.
* Experience as the single product owner for a dedicated engineering squad, working across operations, commercial, and support rather than around them.
* Strongly preferred: you have built product on top of a partner network, where the company sold partner capacity and built its own capability alongside it.
* Seven or more years in product management. Full professional fluency in Arabic and English is required, and GCC logistics context is preferred over theoretical knowledge. Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia.

The Safety Specialist will support the Safety Lead in implementing and maintaining occupational health and safety programs across **KAUST facilities, operations, maintenance activities, construction works, and projects**. The role will focus on field inspections, audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, safety documentation, contractor engagement, training, corrective action tracking, and compliance with **ISO 45001, HSE policies, and applicable regulatory requirements**.

The position requires a strong field-oriented HSE professional who can identify hazards, evaluate risks, provide practical safety guidance, investigate incidents, and work effectively with facility owners, project teams, contractors, and service providers.

### Key Responsibilities

* HSE Program Implementation: Support the Safety Lead in implementing and continuously improving risk-based safety programs across facilities, operations, maintenance, construction, and projects.
* Safety Inspections & Audits: Conduct risk-based site inspections, safety audits, compliance evaluations, and field verifications to ensure HSE requirements are being followed.
* Risk Assessment: Perform hazard identification and risk assessments and verify that appropriate control measures are implemented and effective.
* Safety Documentation Review: Review HSE documents including risk assessments, method statements, safety plans, permits-to-work, lifting plans, excavation plans, confined-space controls, electrical work procedures, and MOC documentation.
* Incident Investigation: Investigate or support investigations of accidents, injuries, incidents, and near misses, identify root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Corrective Action Tracking: Monitor corrective and preventive actions arising from inspections, audits, investigations, and observations, ensuring timely closure and escalation of overdue actions.
* HSE Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver safety training, toolbox talks, workshops, permit-to-work training, and awareness programs to improve employee and contractor competency.
* Stakeholder & Contractor Support: Provide practical HSE guidance to facility owners, project teams, contractors, service providers, and other stakeholders to support safe execution of activities.
* HSE Reporting & Data Analysis: Collect and analyze HSE data, KPIs, inspection findings, audit results, incident trends, and corrective action status, providing reports and recommendations to management.
* Safety Culture & Compliance: Promote a strong safety culture, intervene in unsafe activities, communicate lessons learned, maintain accurate HSE records, and support compliance with ISO 45001, regulations, policies, procedures, and industry best practices.

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or a related safety discipline is required.
* Professional Certification: ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification is required.
* Incident Investigation: Certification or formal training in Incident Root Cause Analysis is required.
* HSE Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in occupational safety, facilities safety, construction safety, contractor management, projects, auditing, compliance, or related HSE functions.
* Risk Management: Strong experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, risk control, and implementation of risk-based safety programs.
* High-Risk Activities: Practical knowledge of safety controls for work at height, lifting operations, excavation, confined spaces, hot work, electrical work, and permit-to-work systems.
* ISO & Audit Knowledge: Working knowledge of ISO 45001, safety management systems, auditing, inspections, incident investigation, and corrective action management. Knowledge of ISO 19011 and ISO 31000 is an advantage.
* Safety Certifications: Additional recognized HSE qualifications such as CSP, CHST, NEBOSH Certificate/Diploma, IOSH, or equivalent are preferred. Train-the-Trainer certification is also an advantage.
* Communication & Reporting: Excellent English communication skills with the ability to prepare professional HSE reports, inspection records, investigation reports, presentations, and safety documentation.

6.  Prepare and monitor annual budgets, forecasts, and expenditure controls for KAUST Health.
7.  Prepare monthly financial, variance, revenue, and RCM performance reports for management.
8.  Track key financial and RCM KPIs and identify risks, discrepancies, and revenue optimization opportunities.
9.  Coordinate with KAUST Finance, Health leadership, healthcare operators, and insurers to resolve financial and claims issues.

* Hands-on experience managing and monitoring **healthcare budgets and expenditures**.
* Experience working with **healthcare operators/providers and insurance companies**.

Octopus by RTG is the tech hiring and outsourcing arm of **Robusta Technology Group**, dedicated to connecting exceptional tech talent with top-tier organizations across the **MENA, GCC, Europe, the US, and Canada**. **Key Responsibilities**  
• Configure and customize Dynamics 365 entities, forms, views, and business process flows to support the leasing journey: inquiry (RIF/TIF) capture, unit listing sync, offer/negotiation status, indicative terms, and lease sign-off.  
• Build and maintain the integration layer (in coordination with the API Developer) that pushes/pulls data between the Portal and Dynamics — e.g., unit availability, agent assignment, inquiry routing, booking confirmations, and lease-status transitions (Prospect → Offer → Signed→ Active → Renewal/Termination).  
• Develop plugins, workflows, Power Automate flows, and custom APIs within Dynamics to automate leasing-team notifications and approval steps (e.g., move-in request approvals,addendum requests, operational date changes).  
• Model and maintain the account hierarchy needed for sub-accounts (MHR-03, MUT-16/17) and company profiles (MUT-31) within Dynamics.  
• Support renewal and termination workflows by ensuring Dynamics reflects and triggers portal-side renewal notifications (SRR/SRT) and termination/settlement records (FCR/FCT).  
• Build reporting/dashboards in Dynamics (or Power BI) for the leasing and community-management teams to track inquiries, conversions, and portal-driven activity.  
• Manage security roles, field-level permissions, and data-privacy configuration within Dynamics for portal-originated records.  
• Participate in data-mapping and (if scoped as a change request) data-migration exercises between legacy systems and Dynamics.  
• Support UAT for all CRM-dependent features and provide production support during hypercare.

**Requirements**

Required Skills & Experience  
• 4+ years hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / Customer Engagement) development and configuration experience.  
• Strong command of the Dynamics customization toolkit: plugins (C#), custom workflows, Power Automate, Dataverse, and the Dynamics Web API / Common Data Service.  
• Experience integrating Dynamics with external web/portal applications via REST APIs or Azure integration services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management).  
• Solid understanding of the real-estate/leasing domain (or comparable long-sales-cycle CRM use case: inquiry → offer → contract → renewal/termination) is a strong plus.  
• Experience with Power BI or Dynamics native reporting for operational dashboards.  
• Familiarity with Dynamics security model (business units, roles, field security) and data-privacy considerations for resident/tenant personal data.  
• Working knowledge of e-signature and document-generation integrations within Dynamics (e.g., DocuSign for Dynamics) is a plus.  
• Microsoft certification (e.g., MB-210, MB-220, or PL-400) is preferred but not required.  
Success Criteria for This Engagement  
• CRM-dependent leasing features (JCR-06, JCT-06/10–13, and lease-status transitions across both portals) are correctly synced and demonstrable end-to-end.  
• Leasing and community-management teams can operate their day-to-day workflow from Dynamics with no manual re-entry of portal-originated data.  
• Reporting/dashboards give the Client visibility into portal-driven leasing activity.

description:
### Job Summary

The Parking Engineer is responsible for the planning, design, operation, and management of parking facilities and associated traffic systems. The role focuses on maximizing parking efficiency, improving user experience, ensuring compliance with transportation regulations, and supporting the integration of smart mobility solutions. The Parking Engineer works closely with urban planners, traffic engineers, architects, facility managers, and project stakeholders.

### Key Responsibilities

### Parking Planning & Design

* Develop parking strategies and solutions for residential, commercial, mixed-use, hospitality, and public developments.
* Design parking layouts, circulation routes, access points, and wayfinding systems.
* Conduct parking demand assessments and capacity analysis.
* Review architectural and engineering drawings to ensure compliance with parking standards and regulations.
* Evaluate accessibility requirements, including provisions for persons with disabilities.

### Traffic & Mobility Management

* Analyze vehicle flow and circulation within parking facilities.
* Develop traffic management plans to minimize congestion and improve safety.
* Coordinate parking operations with transportation and mobility initiatives.
* Support implementation of sustainable mobility solutions, including EV charging infrastructure, shared mobility, and public transport integration.

### Operations & Performance Monitoring

* Assess parking utilization rates and operational performance.
* Recommend improvements to maximize space efficiency and customer experience.
* Monitor parking occupancy trends and prepare forecasting models.
* Develop parking policies, pricing strategies, and operational procedures where applicable.

### Compliance & Safety

* Ensure compliance with local regulations, municipal requirements, and engineering standards.
* Conduct inspections of parking facilities and identify operational or safety concerns.
* Review signage, markings, lighting, and safety systems for compliance and effectiveness.
* Support health, safety, and risk management initiatives.

### Technology & Smart Parking Systems

* Support the implementation and maintenance of parking guidance systems, access control systems, and automated parking technologies.
* Analyze parking data and generate performance reports.
* Coordinate with vendors and technology providers for smart parking solutions.
* Utilize traffic simulation and parking analysis software for planning and optimization.

### Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate with government authorities, consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Support project development from concept stage through construction and operation.
* Prepare technical reports, presentations, and recommendations for management.
* Participate in project meetings and provide technical expertise related to parking infrastructure.

### Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Traffic Engineering, Urban Planning, or a related discipline.
* Professional Engineering registration or certification is an advantage.
* Specialized training in parking management, transportation planning, or mobility solutions is preferred.

### Experience

* 3-7 years of experience in parking engineering, transportation planning, traffic engineering, or mobility management.
* Experience working on large-scale developments, mixed-use projects, airports, hospitality destinations, or master-planned communities is preferred.
* Experience with parking studies, traffic impact assessments, and mobility planning.

description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.

  

**Reimagine What’s Possible** 

  
  

**Purpose**

The Senior Process Engineer – HYCO provides senior-level technical leadership for ongoing plant operations and projects—from concept development through commissioning and start-up—and leads asset management and productivity initiatives across all BHIG operating facilities in the Region. The role coordinates technical activities between site-based engineers and operations teams, mentors junior process engineers, and ensures safe, reliable, efficient and cost-effective production of hydrogen, syngas, CO and CO₂.

**Nature & Scope**

Reporting to the BHIG Engineering Manager, the Senior Process Engineer – HYCO provides day-to-day operational and technical support to Regional Sites through systematic monitoring of plant performance to ensure that production, energy efficiency, and reliability targets are consistently achieved in a safe manner. As a senior technical authority, the incumbent acts as a subject-matter expert (SME) on HYCO process technology and mentors site-based process engineers.

The role identifies productivity opportunities, develops engineering solutions, and supports the project execution teams across multiple technologies: Air Separation Units (ASU), Hydrogen / Syngas (HYCO – SMR based), and CO₂ production. The incumbent may also support Air Products plant support teams in providing similar services to JV partners, equipment sales customers and new prospects.

This position interfaces with Air Products global, regional and local process / production engineers, Regional Operations team members, project and design engineering teams, process safety specialists, and other technical support personnel. The role helps implement the systems and measures required to meet BHIG's Middle East operational requirements, technical standards, quality processes and plant & equipment integrity programs.

The incumbent will coordinate and effectively utilize global operating and technical resources to support existing operations, new installations and modifications led by BHIG Project Engineering or by the Air Products Global Engineering & Manufacturing Organization. The position will help drive consistency in operations across the Middle East Region and contribute to the continuous improvement of productivity, reliability, quality, process safety, and cost-effectiveness of the plants—using BHIG and Air Products systems, tools, statistical techniques and Continuous Improvement methodologies. Developing and tracking plant performance and reliability KPIs is an integral part of the role.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Safety**

* Provide and maintain a safe work environment for self and others; demonstrate visible safety leadership.
* Participate in meetings with government departments responsible for safety, environmental, fire protection and public security oversight, and ensure timely implementation of applicable requirements within BHIG.
* Participate in major turnarounds and project activities, ensuring safety throughout execution.
* Coordinate employee safety committee meetings and programs and actively encourage employee participation and accountability in safety management programs.

**Technical**

* Act as senior technical authority and subject-matter expert for HYCO process engineering across the Region; mentor and coach junior and site-based process engineers, and provide peer review on key engineering deliverables.
* Lead and provide technical support to regional teams for new installations, existing plant modifications, on-going operations, and continuous improvement and maintenance activities for BHIG, equipment sales and potential new customers. Support is delivered through site visits, remote phone / video support, or via the Process Intelligence Center (PIC). Ensure all activities comply with legal requirements, BHIG safety and technical standards.
* Provide technical support and safety leadership for Management of Change (MOC), Operational/Process Hazard Reviews (OPHR), PHA / HAZOP, LOPA and other process safety related initiatives in order to drive PSM compliance. Consult BHIG and Air Products process safety specialists as required.
* Provide process engineering leadership to drive asset performance, reduce operating costs and increase plant throughput by supporting: troubleshooting, plant efficiency studies, process safety, equipment reliability, advanced process control (APC), asset management, and productivity project identification, development and execution.
* Apply process statistics and data analytics (control charts, regression, capability analysis, multivariate analysis) to detect performance drift, quantify variability, prioritize improvement opportunities and validate the impact of implemented changes.
* Develop, maintain and validate steady-state and dynamic process simulation models in Aspen Plus (and associated Aspen suite tools) to support troubleshooting, performance benchmarking, debottlenecking, what-if studies, energy optimization, and revamp / new project evaluations.
* Provide expert technical support on heterogeneous catalyst systems used in HYCO / Hydrogen plants—including Hydrodesulfurization (HDS), ZnO sulfur absorbers, Pre-Reforming, Steam Methane Reforming (SMR), High-Temperature Shift (HTS), Low-Temperature Shift (LTS) and Methanation—covering activity / deactivation assessment, kinetic and equilibrium evaluation, poison management, life-cycle prediction, change-out strategy, vendor selection and performance auditing.
* Facilitate operational excellence through continuous improvement in plant productivity, reliability, quality and cost; lead improvements and ensure that best practices are deployed.
* Provide technical leadership in investigations and Root Cause Analyses (RCA) in order to identify and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Provide technical support for Advanced Process Control (APC) and real-time optimization (RTO) initiatives.
* Monitor plant production daily, driving asset performance and ensuring daily targets are met to maximize profitability and customer satisfaction.

**Operations**

* Provide process engineering support to operations in order to safely and reliably operate, SMR-based HYCO and CO₂ facilities in the Region, meeting customer expectations on safety, reliability, product quality and supply flexibility while remaining compliant with contractual requirements.
* Ensure that BHIG standards and Air Products global best practices for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality and customer service are met.
* Provide technical guidance to commissioning teams, supporting commissioning, start-up and troubleshooting activities.
* Participate in the training of the Operations team up to plant commissioning, including catalyst loading, reduction / activation and start-up of SMR, Shift and Methanation reactors.
* Participate in developing the month-end close model and ensure alignment with commercial obligations for the BHIG Middle East Commercial Area.
* Maintain close working relationships with engineering and maintenance personnel to continuously monitor and evaluate plant systems and equipment through a Plant Process Advisory model.
* Support Process Intelligence Center (PIC) initiatives such as plant monitoring, troubleshooting, plant simulation training sessions, plant modelling and plant efficiency monitoring.
* Maintain alignment with Plant Managers, Site Leadership and the Business Area on asset management opportunities and commercial priorities.
* Provide technical support for turnarounds, including catalyst inspection, sampling, change-out planning and post-turnaround performance validation.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering (Master's degree is a plus).
* Minimum 12+ years of experience in Engineering and/or Operations in a senior technical role within the industrial gases, refining, petrochemical (Methanol and ammonia) or hydrogen production industry.
* Demonstrated experience and knowledge of the technology, design and operation of Steam Methane Reformers (HYCO) and CO₂ production systems is preferred. Single-technology expertise will be considered; multi-technology background is strongly preferred at this senior level.
* Proven track record of start-up, commissioning and plant operating experience.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring junior engineers and leading multi-disciplinary technical teams.

**Technical Skills**

* **Process Simulation –** Strong proficiency in Aspen Plus) for steady-state and dynamic modelling of HYCO, ASU and CO₂ processes; capable of building, calibrating and using rigorous models for plant performance evaluation, troubleshooting and optimization.
* **Process Statistics & Data Analytics –** Working knowledge of statistical methods applied to process engineering: SPC / control charts, regression and correlation analysis, capability studies (Cp / Cpk), and multivariate / time-series analysis. Familiarity with tools such as Minitab, PI Datalink.
* **Heterogeneous Catalysis –** Solid technical understanding of heterogeneous catalysts used in hydrogen / syngas production, including Hydrodesulfurization (HDS / CoMo, NiMo), ZnO sulfur guards, Pre-reforming, Steam Methane Reforming (SMR), High-Temperature Shift (HTS – Fe/Cr), Low-Temperature Shift (LTS – Cu/Zn/Al) and Methanation (Ni based). This includes reaction kinetics and thermodynamics, activation / reduction procedures, deactivation and poisoning mechanisms, performance monitoring, life prediction and change-out strategy.
* **Process Safety –** Knowledgeable in Process Safety Management (PSM), PHA / HAZOP, LOPA, MOC, OPHR, and applicable local EHS regulations.
* **Advanced Process Control & Optimization –** Familiarity with APC, RTO and energy optimization concepts for hydrogen and ASU plants.
* **Engineering Tools –** Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), data historians (e.g., OSIsoft PI / AVEVA PI), and standard process engineering calculation tools.

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong commitment to employee involvement, team building, diversity and inclusion.
* Proven ability to mentor and coach less experienced engineers and to act as a recognized technical reference within the organization.
* Able to communicate effectively across management, operations, maintenance and customer interfaces within and across regions.
* Proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required; Arabic language skills are a plus.
* Demonstrated leadership, organizational, computer and interpersonal skills.
* Personal commitment to continuous self-development and flexibility to work outside normal hours to meet operational and project commitments.
* Excellent influencing skills, ability to build trust and confidence with frontline workers, supervisors and management.
* Strong critical thinking, problem-solving and analytical skills are prerequisites.
* Confident, assertive, self-motivated and results oriented.
* Personal commitment to corporate values and to a culture of continuous improvement.
* Formal training and experience with Six Sigma (Green / Black Belt) and Continuous Improvement tools is a plus.
