### About the Company

Nokhbat Segadty Trading Company operates an e-commerce store, retail branches, seasonal exhibitions, and an external manufacturing line for custom seating products.

Our operations are managed through an integrated ecosystem that includes:

* **Zid** for e-commerce orders.
* **Amazon, Trendyol, and other marketplaces.**
* **WMS** for inventory and warehouse transactions.
* **ClickUp** for task management, documentation, and operational follow-up.
* External fulfillment, logistics, courier, and manufacturing partners.

We also have a unified and approved **182-page Operations Manual** covering procedures, responsibilities, required evidence, common errors, and escalation paths. You will not be starting from scratch; you will inherit an established operating system and be responsible for managing, enforcing, and improving it.

### Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Operations & Logistics Manager** to lead the complete order and fulfillment cycle—from the moment an order is received through Zid or a marketplace, through picking, packing, fulfillment, shipping, and final delivery to the customer.

The role includes managing warehouse and inventory activities through the WMS, overseeing fulfillment and courier partners, managing marketplace operations, coordinating stock replenishment for branches and seasonal exhibitions, supervising external manufacturing, and ensuring that all teams comply with the approved service level agreements.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires strong operational ownership, attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to identify root causes rather than only resolving individual incidents.

### Key Responsibilities

### E-Commerce and Order Fulfillment

* Manage and monitor daily orders through the Zid Dashboard.
* Oversee the complete order lifecycle from order receipt to picking, packing, shipping, delivery, cancellation, return, or final closure.
* Ensure that no order remains in any operational status beyond the approved processing time.
* Review and process incoming orders and confirm that they are ready for fulfillment.
* Coordinate picking, packing, and order fulfillment with warehouse and fulfillment teams.
* Monitor pending, delayed, cancelled, and exception orders and take immediate corrective action.
* Resolve operational issues involving missing products, incorrect quantities, duplicate orders, cancellations, exchanges, and returns.
* Ensure all order statuses are accurate and updated across Zid, the WMS, fulfillment systems, and courier systems.
* Investigate recurring order issues, identify their root causes, and implement preventive actions.

### Marketplace Operations

* Manage daily operations across Amazon, Trendyol, and other marketplaces.
* Process and monitor marketplace orders according to each platform’s operational requirements and service level agreements.
* Monitor cancellations, returns, delayed orders, failed fulfillment, and marketplace penalties.
* Ensure order and shipment statuses are updated accurately across all platforms.
* Coordinate product availability and inventory synchronization between the e-commerce store and marketplaces.
* Resolve issues related to stock keeping units, barcodes, product mapping, bundles, and inventory synchronization.
* Ensure marketplace orders are deducted from the correct inventory location.
* Coordinate with the technical team to maintain and improve marketplace integrations and automation.
* Identify operational issues that may negatively affect marketplace ratings, account health, or customer experience.

### Warehouse and Inventory Management

* Manage inventory movements and warehouse transactions through the WMS.
* Ensure that all receipts, issues, returns, transfers, damaged items, and stock adjustments are supported by approved documents.
* Monitor stock accuracy and reconcile physical inventory with system inventory.
* Investigate inventory discrepancies and resolve them before they become financial losses.
* Ensure accurate stock keeping unit and barcode mapping across all sales channels.
* Monitor low-stock and out-of-stock products and initiate replenishment when required.
* Supervise bundle assembly and disassembly and ensure all related movements are documented correctly.
* Control internal stock transfers and ensure the receiving and issuing locations record each movement accurately.
* Prevent unauthorized manual inventory adjustments and maintain a complete audit trail for every stock movement.
* Conduct periodic inventory reconciliation with fulfillment partners.

### Branch and Seasonal Exhibition Coordination

* Manage stock replenishment and transfers between the main warehouse, retail branches, and seasonal exhibitions.
* Ensure all transfers are processed through the approved official workflow.
* Confirm that each transfer includes the required system files, warehouse documents, and signed issue vouchers.
* Monitor branch stock availability and coordinate replenishment based on actual sales and forecasted demand.
* Support the operational setup and stock preparation of new branches and seasonal exhibitions.
* Ensure transfers do not create unexplained inventory differences between locations.

### Shipping and Logistics Operations

* Manage daily coordination with courier, logistics, and fulfillment partners.
* Ensure each order is assigned to the appropriate shipping provider based on location, cost, service quality, and delivery requirements.
* Monitor airway bill creation, shipment pickup, dispatch, delivery status, failed delivery, and returns.
* Reconcile shipment statuses between the company’s systems and courier platforms.
* Follow up on shipments that remain in “Ready,” “Pending,” or other delayed statuses beyond the approved service level.
* Resolve delivery issues in coordination with couriers, warehouse teams, fulfillment partners, and customer service.
* Analyze courier performance, delivery times, failure rates, return rates, and recurring complaints.
* Escalate repeated failures and recommend changing the courier or fulfillment provider when necessary.
* Review shipping costs and ensure that invoices and surcharges comply with approved commercial agreements.
* Support and monitor shipments to Gulf Cooperation Council countries.

### External Manufacturing Operations

* Supervise external manufacturing of custom seating and related products.
* Monitor production schedules, delivery commitments, quality standards, and pending orders.
* Coordinate with workshops and suppliers to resolve delays and quality issues.
* Track customer complaints related to manufacturing quality and ensure corrective action is completed.
* Apply approved delay deductions, quality compensation, and financial settlements.
* Coordinate with finance to ensure accurate settlement of manufacturing charges, deductions, and compensation.
* Identify recurring production defects and escalate them to senior management with corrective recommendations.

### Team Leadership and Daily Operations

* Lead warehouse, logistics, fulfillment, and order-processing teams.
* Set daily operational priorities and assign responsibilities clearly.
* Monitor employee productivity, order accuracy, and compliance with approved procedures.
* Ensure every outgoing shipment is scanned and documented through the approved tracking sheet.
* Hold team members accountable for delays, errors, missing documentation, and unclosed tasks.
* Train new employees using the approved Operations Manual and confirm their understanding of each procedure.
* Ensure tasks and operational evidence are documented through ClickUp.
* Maintain clear ownership of every pending issue until it is fully resolved and closed.

### Operations Control, Reporting, and Improvement

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Track order fulfillment, delays, cancellations, returns, inventory discrepancies, delivery failures, and operational errors.
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using raw data from different systems.
* Monitor performance against approved key performance indicators and service level agreements.
* Identify recurring issues and conduct root-cause analysis.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions and measure whether they successfully resolved the problem.
* Recommend automation opportunities that reduce manual work and operational errors.
* Update the Operations Manual and workflows whenever a process, system, responsibility, or policy changes.
* Ensure that every process has a clearly assigned owner, completion deadline, required evidence, and escalation path.
* Coordinate continuously between E-Commerce, Marketplaces, Warehouse, Branches, Customer Service, Finance, Technical, Fulfillment, Logistics, and External Manufacturing teams.

**Requirements**

### Requirements

* Minimum of **six years of experience** in operations, logistics, e-commerce fulfillment, retail operations, or a similar field.
* Proven leadership experience managing warehouse, fulfillment, logistics, or e-commerce operations teams.
* Hands-on experience with a **Warehouse Management System**.
* Experience using **ClickUp** or a similar task-management and documentation platform.
* Strong experience in order processing, inventory management, fulfillment, shipping, and operational reconciliation.
* Ability to create, document, implement, and measure operational procedures—not only execute them.
* Experience managing external parties such as couriers, fulfillment providers, warehouses, suppliers, or manufacturing workshops.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, including shipping-cost calculations, inventory variance analysis, and operational performance measurement.
* Strong proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets.
* Ability to create reports and dashboards from raw operational data.
* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to manage a high volume of orders and coordinate across several teams.
* Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership.
* Professional working proficiency in Arabic and English.

### Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is an advantage but is not mandatory:

* Experience with Zid or a similar e-commerce platform.
* Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Trendyol, or other marketplaces.
* Experience with marketplace integrations and inventory synchronization.
* Experience opening and replenishing retail branches or seasonal exhibitions.
* Experience shipping orders to Gulf Cooperation Council countries.
* Experience supervising external manufacturing operations.
* Experience building automated operational dashboards.
* Experience using artificial intelligence tools for reporting, analysis, dashboards, automation, or process improvement.

### Key Performance Indicators

Performance in this role will be measured through:

* On-Time Fulfillment Rate.
* Order Processing Time.
* Order Accuracy Rate.
* Marketplace Service Level Agreement Compliance.
* Number and Age of Pending and Delayed Orders.
* Order Cancellation Rate.
* Inventory Accuracy.
* Stock Availability.
* Inventory Reconciliation Differences.
* Return and Failed Delivery Rate.
* Courier and Fulfillment Partner Performance.
* Issue Resolution Time.
* Branch Replenishment Accuracy.
* External Manufacturing Lead Time and Quality.
* Compliance with Approved Procedures.
* Overall Operational Efficiency.

**Benefits**

### What We Offer

* A documented operational system with a **182-page Operations Manual**, approved policies, clear responsibilities, and defined authority.
* An established operating structure that you will manage and improve.
* Genuine decision-making authority, including courier selection, stock-transfer approval, operational escalation, and partner-performance decisions.
* Direct communication with the General Manager without unnecessary management layers.

description:
Job Description

Overview:
Weatherford is seeking a skilled and results-driven Field Engineer IV – MPD to join our team. This pivotal role is responsible for providing technical and engineering support for Managed Pressure Drilling operations, optimizing MPD performance, enhancing drilling efficiency, and driving operational excellence. The ideal candidate will work closely with country and regional teams, customers, and rig personnel to ensure accurate engineering analysis, operational execution, and compliance with company and client requirements. Additionally, this role plays a key part in planning, executing, and optimizing MPD operations safely and with minimal interruption to drilling activities. The position requires strong engineering expertise in hydraulic modeling, pressure management, well control principles, and MPD technologies while ensuring full compliance with Weatherford's quality and performance standards.
Responsibilities:
• Provide engineering support for Managed Pressure Drilling operations, including hydraulic calculations, pressure analysis, simulations, and operational planning.
• Responsible for the technical execution and optimization of MPD operations at the rig site and remote support locations.
• Directly responsible for providing engineering guidance to ensure the safe and efficient delivery of all MPD-related services onsite.
• Remain on call 24 hours while on site and provide technical support as required.
• Prepare and review daily operational reports, hydraulic models, simulations, lessons learned, and end-of-well reports.
• Support pre-job planning activities, including risk assessments, technical reviews, and operational readiness evaluations.
• Review drilling programs and provide recommendations related to MPD applications, operating procedures, and contingency plans.
• Support rig-up, commissioning, operation, troubleshooting, and demobilization of MPD equipment at the job site.
• Monitor real-time drilling parameters and MPD system performance to ensure operational objectives are achieved safely and efficiently.
• Analyze operational data and recommend improvements to optimize drilling performance and reduce non-productive time (NPT).
• Perform technical verification of MPD equipment functionality and ensure operational readiness prior to deployment.
• Troubleshoot mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical issues related to MPD systems and provide engineering solutions.
• Complete all required reports and documentation related to Managed Pressure Drilling operations and engineering support activities.
• Keep updated on inspection requirements, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements related to Managed Pressure Drilling.
• Demonstrate and apply advanced knowledge of Managed Pressure Drilling systems, drilling hydraulics, pressure management, and well control principles.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Field Specialists and junior engineers as required.
• Support client meetings, operational reviews, technical presentations, and performance improvement initiatives.
• Know and understand Weatherford Quality Policy and comply with all requirements of the Quality Systems Manual, Operating and Technical Procedures, and Workplace Instructions.
• Comply with Weatherford and client Quality, Health, Safety, Security and Environment (QHSSE) procedures and documentation on site.
• Document all jobs and incidents in the Weatherford Performance Tracking System (WPTS).
• Participate in the Permit to Work process.
• Actively participate in Toolbox Talks and operational risk assessments.
• Must understand and comply with all safety rules and company policies of Weatherford.
• Required to complete the competency and training requirements identified by Global and Regional Management.
• Complete training in order to meet the minimum HSE certification and technical requirements required to perform the job.
• Perform all duties regarding Managed Pressure Drilling Services and Weatherford activities assigned by management or supervisors within the physical demands of the job description.
Skills
• Advanced knowledge of Managed Pressure Drilling systems and applications.
• Strong understanding of drilling hydraulics, pressure management, and well control principles.
• Ability to perform hydraulic calculations, simulations, and engineering analysis.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint computer skills.
• Self-motivator and self-starter.
• Strong oral and written communication skills.
• Ability to prepare technical reports and present engineering recommendations.
• Ability to lead operational teams and mentor junior personnel.
• Customer-focused with strong stakeholder management skills.
• General understanding of drilling, completion, and well construction processes.
• Individual must be adaptive to change and possess strong multitasking abilities.
• Ability to work in a team environment and collaborate across multiple functions.
• Ability to work in high and cold temperature environments.
• Ability to work closely with all levels of personnel, customers, and outside contractors.
• Ability to make sound technical decisions in high-pressure operating environments.
Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in petroleum engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related Engineering discipline.
• Minimum 7 years of Oil & Gas industry experience.
• Minimum 5 years of direct Managed Pressure Drilling (MPD) operational and engineering experience.
• Strong MPD knowledge including drilling hydraulics, pressure management, and well control principles.
• Experience performing hydraulic simulations, pressure modeling, and engineering analysis.
• Experience supporting onshore and offshore drilling operations.
• Demonstrated leadership and mentoring capabilities.
• Strong customer-facing and technical communication skills.
• IWCF or IADC Well Control certification preferred.
• Knowledge of API, ISO, and industry regulatory standards preferred.

job_title: Senior Director - Land & Public Realm Optimisation - Land Use (Q - CO)
description:
Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments.

We are seeking a Senior Director, Land & Public Realm Optimisation - Land Use to join JASARA PMC. The Senior Director, Land & Public Realm Optimisation is accountable for supporting City Operations in reviewing proposed city land and public realm before it is accepted or vested into the City Operations portfolio. The role assesses parks, landscaped areas, plazas, civic spaces, pedestrian areas, green corridors, recreational open spaces and other proposed public land to determine whether each area is genuinely public, operationally necessary, appropriately sized, cost-efficient and financially sustainable throughout its lifecycle.

The position acts as City Operations’ independent challenge and assurance function. It provides evidence-based recommendations to the Executive Director, City Operations, and relevant governance forums on whether proposed land should be accepted, conditionally accepted, redesigned, reduced, retained by the benefiting developer or asset owner, placed under an alternative management arrangement, or not vested to City Operations.

### Key Responsibilities

### 1\. Land and Public Realm Governance

·   Develop and maintain the City Operations Land and Public Realm Vesting Framework, including review criteria, evidence requirements, stage gates, approval routes and decision records.

·   Establish consistent standards for determining public purpose, operational need, affordability, maintainability and ownership responsibility.

·   Ensure proposed land is not assumed to be a City Operations liability solely because it is externally accessible or shown as public realm in a masterplan.

·   Provide formal recommendations and executive decision papers on acceptance, conditional acceptance, redesign, alternative ownership or rejection.

### 2\. Public Purpose and Beneficiary Assessment

·   Assess whether proposed land is genuinely public in purpose, access, use and benefit.

·   Determine whether the primary beneficiaries are the wider city and community or an adjacent private development, hotel, resort, residential community, venue, attraction or commercial asset.

·   Challenge public designations that do not align with the intended user base, access arrangements or operational reality.

·   Recommend that land primarily benefiting private assets remains owned, funded or maintained by the benefiting party while protecting any agreed public-access obligations.

### 3\. Land Area and Functional Need Review

·   Review the scale, location, configuration, boundaries and intended use of parks and other proposed public realm.

·   Assess whether land area is proportionate to forecast demand, public value and demonstrated operational need.

·   Challenge oversized, duplicated, fragmented, inaccessible, residual or low-utilisation public spaces.

·   Identify opportunities to consolidate public realm into fewer, better-performing spaces that provide stronger public value at lower lifecycle cost.

·   Ensure proposed spaces have a clear function, target user, operating concept and measurable benefit.

### 4\. Parks, Open Space and Public Realm Review

·   Lead City Operations reviews of public parks, neighbourhood and destination parks, landscaped open areas, urban plazas, civic spaces, pedestrian areas, public squares, green corridors, recreational open spaces and publicly accessible landscaped land.

·   Assess intended use, forecast demand, opening hours, accessibility, safety, security, thermal comfort, amenities, seasonal use, event potential and long-term renewal needs.

·   Review landscape intensity, irrigation demand, water use, cleaning, waste, pest control, security patrol, staffing, supervision and maintenance access implications.

·   Challenge over-designed or maintenance-intensive solutions where simpler alternatives can maintain quality, accessibility and guest experience.

### 5\. Whole-Life Cost and Affordability

·   Establish a consistent methodology for assessing the whole-life cost of proposed land and public realm.

·   Prepare or assure annual and long-term cost forecasts covering landscape maintenance, irrigation, water, cleaning, waste, security, pest control, amenities, furniture, play equipment, lighting within public spaces, staffing, technology and periodic renewal.

·   Compare forecast public value and utilisation with the operating and renewal liability proposed for City Operations.

·   Identify avoidable cost drivers and recommend redesign, scope reduction, funding contributions or alternative management arrangements where costs are disproportionate.

·   Maintain clear cost assumptions to support City Operations budget, workforce and service planning.

### 6\. Operational Suitability and Maintainability

·   Assess whether proposed parks and public spaces can be safely, practically and efficiently operated.

·   Review access for cleaning, waste collection, landscape maintenance, security patrols, servicing and emergency response.

·   Identify isolated, concealed, inaccessible or difficult-to-supervise areas and unclear public/private boundaries.

·   Assess whether landscaping, amenities and materials are suitable for the climate, anticipated use and available maintenance regime.

·   Recommend design changes that improve usability and reduce cost without undermining public benefit, inclusion or quality.

### 7\. Vesting Recommendations and Conditions

·   Issue clear recommendations to accept, accept subject to conditions, defer pending evidence, redesign or reduce, retain under developer or asset-owner control, adopt a shared model, or reject from the City Operations portfolio.

·   Define conditions relating to boundary clarification, design amendments, cost reduction, maintenance funding, service charges, endowments, developer maintenance periods, performance guarantees, public access, handover standards and defect rectification.

·   Confirm that agreed conditions and required evidence are closed before final acceptance or handover.

·   Maintain an auditable record of recommendations, decisions, conditions, owners and close-out status.

### 8\. Ownership, Funding and Management Options

·   Evaluate alternatives to direct vesting, including private ownership with public access, developer-managed public realm, district management, shared maintenance, service-charge recovery, sponsorship, commercial activation, concession or destination-management arrangements.

·   Ensure alternative models protect public access, service quality, affordability and clear accountability.

·   Prevent City Operations from assuming costs that should reasonably remain with the principal beneficiary.

·   Support commercial and legal teams in defining practical ownership, funding and management obligations.

### 9\. Land and Public Realm Portfolio Register

·   Establish and maintain a citywide register of proposed and accepted public land, recording area, use, beneficiaries, ownership, vesting status, annual operating cost, renewal exposure, risks, funding, conditions and responsible party.

·   Use the register to identify cumulative cost and workforce exposure across districts and development phases.

·   Provide executive dashboards on land under review, contested proposals, avoided liabilities, conditional acceptances and future budget exposure.

·   Support long-term city land optimisation by identifying opportunities to consolidate, reclassify or change management arrangements for underperforming public realm.

### 10\. Stakeholder Coordination and Team Leadership

·   Lead structured reviews with masterplanning, development, design, landscape architecture, district teams, asset owners, Finance, Commercial, Legal, Governance and City Operations service functions.

·   Provide early operational input before land boundaries and designs become fixed or commercial commitments are made.

·   Resolve disagreements concerning public purpose, ownership boundaries, cost and operating responsibility, escalating unresolved issues with evidence and options.

·   Build and lead a specialist team, supported where required by landscape, cost, land, commercial and operational advisors.

·  Develop internal guidance and capability so affordability and maintainability are embedded across the development lifecycle.

**Requirements**

### Education

·   Bachelor's degree in Urban Planning, Landscape Architecture, Real Estate, Land Economics, Asset Management, Facilities Management, Environmental Design or a related discipline.

·   Master's degree in a relevant discipline is preferred.

·   Professional membership in planning, landscape architecture, real estate, asset management or facilities management is desirable.

### Experience

·   Minimum 20 years of progressive experience in land-use planning, public realm, parks and open-space planning, landscape planning, real estate, asset management or city operations, including at least 8 years in senior leadership or advisory roles.

·   Demonstrable experience reviewing parks, public spaces, landscaped areas or major-destination public realm.

·   Strong experience assessing operating costs, maintenance implications and whole-life liabilities and translating findings into business cases and executive recommendations.

·   Proven ability to challenge land, design, ownership or funding proposals based on public purpose, operational need, affordability and maintainability.

·   Experience in Saudi Arabia, the GCC, major destination developments or giga-project environments is strongly preferred.

### Preferred Background

·   Experience within a development authority, city or municipal organisation, major destination, integrated resort, public-realm consultancy, real-estate developer or asset-management organisation.

·   Practical exposure to land vesting, public/private boundary definition, parks operations, landscape maintenance, service-charge models and developer handover.

·   Experience working across planning, design, operations, finance, commercial, legal and governance disciplines.

job_title: Cybersecurity Incident Response & Digital Forensics (DFIR) Specialist
description:
**Location:** On-site – Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Contract/engagement:** Project-based managed cybersecurity services (13-month)

**Minimum experience:** 7+ years

### Role Purpose

Lead and execute cybersecurity incident response and digital forensic investigations while preserving evidence and meeting regulatory reporting requirements.

### Key Responsibilities

·      Investigate cybersecurity incidents and determine attack scope, impact, entry vectors, and affected assets.

·      Perform containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident review activities.

·      Collect, preserve, and analyze digital evidence in accordance with approved chain-of-custody procedures.

·      Conduct disk, memory, network, endpoint, and malware analysis using appropriate forensic tools.

·      Develop and maintain incident-response and DFIR procedures, playbooks, investigation methods, and evidence-handling guides.

·      Prepare technical and executive incident reports, forensic findings, and RCA reports.

·      Coordinate with internal teams and stakeholders and ensure incident classification and reporting comply with NCA requirements.

**Requirements**

### Technical and Professional Requirements

·      Saudi nationality is a must.

·      Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, Computer Science, or a related field.

·      At least 7 years of experience in cyber incident response and digital forensic investigations.

·      Strong knowledge of attacker behavior, incident investigation methods, NIST incident response, and MITRE ATT&CK.

·      Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, EnCase, FTK, Volatility, Autopsy, or equivalent forensic and security tools.

·      Strong understanding of digital evidence handling and chain of custody.

### Personal Requirements

·      Calm and decisive during high-pressure incidents.

·      Strong investigative thinking, attention to detail, and professional judgment.

·      Clear technical writing and the ability to communicate findings to both executives and technical teams.

·      High integrity and strict respect for confidentiality.

### Professional Certifications

Preferred: CISSP, GCIA, GSEC, GCIH, CISM, or equivalent.

description:
The **Senior IT Security Operations Engineer** safeguards corporate IT infrastructure, networks, enterprise data, and cloud environments against operational security risks and threats. * **3.** Strong expertise in **Identity & Access Management (Active Directory, Entra ID, PAM solutions)**, multi-factor authentication, and network access controls.
* **4.** Proven track record in **threat detection, incident response, log analysis, and system hardening** across Windows/Linux servers and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS).
* **5.** Hold at least one active industry certification such as **CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, CCSP, or ITIL4**.

job_title: Associate Director - Cybersecurity Risk and Compliance
description:
* **Roles and Responsibilities**:

* Conduct periodic and ad hoc cybersecurity risk assessments across IT and OT environments
* Perform OT-specific risk assessments on assets such as PLCs, HMIs, RTUs, and engineering systems
* Identify and document OT-relevant risk scenarios (e.g., control system disruption, unauthorized access, safety manipulation)
* Coordinate risk reviews as part of major IT/OT changes, such as system upgrades or new deployments
* Reassess risk posture following major changes, incidents, or regulatory updates
* Review and validate existing controls to calculate residual risk and prioritize treatment actions
* Provide standardized tools and guidance to support self-assessments by IT, OT, and business teams
* Support integration of assessment outcomes into control design, zoning, segmentation, and system deployment
* Track risk treatment progress and escalate overdue or high-priority items as needed
* Coordinate with performance management to define and monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) to proactively track changes in cybersecurity risk exposure
* Maintain the cybersecurity risk register, including OT-specific entries, capturing identified risks, likelihood and impact ratings, treatment plans, ownership, and status
* Coordinate and execute internal cybersecurity compliance assessments across all relevant domains and functions
* Serve as the lead interface for external audits and regulatory inspections, including preparation, execution, and response
* Conduct periodic compliance assessments of OT environments, including SCADA, DCS, PLCs, and associated network infrastructure
* Maintain an inventory of compliance-relevant OT assets and map them to applicable control requirements and standards
* Monitor adherence to cybersecurity policies, escalate non-compliance, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams
* Track and manage remediation plans for compliance gaps, non-conformities, and audit findings through closure
* Validate the effectiveness of implemented controls or mitigation plans before closing compliance gaps
* Review and validate configuration baselines for OT systems (e.g., firewall rules, firmware versions) to ensure alignment with compliance standards
* Coordinate evidence collection, documentation, and remediation planning for compliance-related findings
* Report OT and IT cybersecurity compliance status and risks to leadership and cybersecurity governance
* Support compliance awareness and training for teams with control responsibilities in both IT and OT
* Maintain a centralized compliance register, covering both IT and OT, that maps regulatory requirements to policies, controls, responsible teams, and evidence sources
* Govern third-party cybersecurity risk by maintaining standardized assessment processes, due diligence criteria, and remediation tracking
* Coordinate and conduct third-party cybersecurity assessments across IT and OT suppliers to ensure alignment with internal policies and regulatory requirements
* Review vendor-supplied OT systems and supporting documentation to ensure inclusion of security controls and compliance with applicable standards (e.g., NCA OTCC, IEC 62443)
* Ensure third-party risk findings are documented, risk-rated, and tracked through resolution, including acceptance or application of compensating controls
* Maintain a register of assessed vendors, associated risks, control gaps, and remediation status for ongoing oversight and reporting
* Collaborate with procurement, legal, and compliance to embed cybersecurity requirements into third-party agreements, including OT-specific clauses where applicable
* Contribute to the development and review of third-party security policy and minimum control requirements for use in procurement and onboarding
* Support internal and external audit requests related to third-party cybersecurity risk management

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.
* 10–12+ years of cybersecurity experience.
* Strong experience in cybersecurity risk management, compliance, assessments, and assurance.

**Job Purpose**

The role works closely with sales, delivery, product, architecture, finance, partners and customers to understand business needs, define suitable solution approaches, design robust technical architectures, prepare high-quality technical proposals, estimate implementation efforts and present proposed solutions to executive, business and technical stakeholders.

The position requires strong technical architecture capabilities, telecom industry knowledge, proposal development experience, commercial awareness, stakeholder management and customer presentation skills.

* Identify missing information, dependencies, risks, assumptions and clarification questions.
* Develop presales response plans, technical workstreams, responsibilities and submission timelines.

**3\. Digital Solution Architecture**

* Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, observable and cost-effective.
* Design solutions for cloud, on-premises, hybrid and sovereign deployment environments.
* Define availability, performance, scalability, backup and disaster-recovery requirements.
* Ensure technical designs comply with customer architecture standards, security policies and operational requirements.
* Define reusable components and shared technical services.

**4\. Microservices and Integration Architecture**

* Design microservices-based architectures using domain-driven design, API-first principles and event-driven patterns.
* Define service boundaries, APIs, integration contracts, data ownership and communication mechanisms.
* Design synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST APIs, API gateways, message brokers, event streaming and enterprise integration platforms.
* Recommend suitable containerization and orchestration approaches using Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent technologies.
* Define requirements for service discovery, centralized configuration, secrets management, monitoring, logging, tracing and fault tolerance.
* Address scalability, availability, performance, security and disaster-recovery requirements.

* Recommend suitable CI/CD, DevSecOps and automated testing approaches.

Job Description

WSP in the Middle East are seeking a Principal / Associate Electrical - Airport Project Experience to lead the design and delivery of complex aviation and industrial buildings—including aircraft maintenance hangars, engine/APU workshops, and large-scale flight catering environments.
You will act as the electrical technical authority, overseeing power distribution, ELV systems, airfield/ground systems interfaces, and hazardous-area electrical design—delivering concept-to-IFC solutions aligned with stringent safety, operational, and regulatory requirements.

Lead electrical design from feasibility and Basis of Design (BoD) through detailed design, tender and construction support for aviation facilities.
Own the electrical power strategy for large-scale facilities (e.g., hangar bays): MV/LV distribution, redundancy, load management, earthing, and control philosophies—balancing reliability, safety, and energy performance (IEC/NFPA context).
Engineer electrical systems for hazardous operations: paint booths/rooms, fuel-cell maintenance areas, welding zones—ensuring compliance with ATEX/IECEx and coordination with mechanical ventilation and controls.
Design and specify power systems for aviation facilities: transformers, generators, UPS, distribution boards, and backup systems for mission-critical operations.
Integrate electrical utilities across MRO and workshop environments—ground power units (GPU), PCA interfaces, process equipment loads, and coordination with mechanical, fire/life safety, and control systems.
Shape electrical systems for catering facilities: resilient power distribution for kitchens, cold-chain systems, and hygienic areas aligned with HACCP/ISO 22000 requirements.
Deliver BIM-led coordination (Revit/Navisworks) across architecture, structures, MEP, and specialist systems; lead clash resolution and model QA.
Perform calculations and studies: load estimation, cable sizing, protection coordination, short-circuit analysis, and lighting design.
Author technical documents: BoD, load schedules, single-line diagrams (SLDs), specifications, and commissioning plans.
Mentor and review engineers/designers; lead design reviews, HAZOPs, and constructability/operability workshops.
Engage stakeholders—airlines, MROs, airport operators, and authorities—to secure approvals and ensure smooth delivery.
Lead retrofit, refurbishment, and brownfield upgrades in operational airport environments—assessing existing systems, planning phased upgrades, and integrating new systems with minimal disruption while improving capacity, compliance, and energy performance.
Key systems & domains you’ll cover

Hangars & workshops: MV/LV distribution, ground power units (GPU), PCA electrical interfaces, high-bay lighting, emergency power, earthing and bonding for aircraft safety, and hangar door electrics.
Paint/corrosion control: hazardous-area electrical systems, explosion-proof equipment, interlocks, LEL monitoring interfaces, and ATEX/IECEx compliance coordinated with ventilation and controls.
Welding & fabrication: power distribution for welding equipment, equipment earthing, task lighting, and integration with extraction/LEV systems aligned with OSHA/ACGIH guidance.
Power systems: transformers, generators, UPS, LV panels, and distribution networks designed for redundancy, resilience, and mission-critical operations.
Catering facilities: resilient power supply for kitchens, cold rooms/freezers, food processing areas, and hygienic zoning aligned with HACCP/ISO 22000 requirements.
ELV & controls: fire alarm systems (NFPA 72), ICT, security (CCTV/access control), structured cabling, and BMS/SCADA integration for operational monitoring and control.

Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering; Master's degree preferred.
Professionally registered (CEng, PE, or equivalent).
15+ years' experience in electrical building services design, including aviation and complex infrastructure projects.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and delivering major projects.

Technical Expertise
Strong knowledge of international electrical design codes, standards, and aviation requirements.
Expertise in MV/LV power distribution, load assessments, protection systems, and earthing design.
Proficiency in BIM and industry-standard design software, including Revit, Navisworks, ETAP, and Dialux.
Experience in airport facilities, terminal buildings, and aviation-related infrastructure is highly desirable.

• Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to explore AI-driven use cases that improve customer value.

We are looking for the right person, not the exact list of requirements. If you believe your life experience has prepared you for similar challenges, we’d like to hear from you.

• 5 - 10 years of enterprise-level, technology-related support or account management experience

• Exceptional customer focus and bias for action

• Experience supporting nascent products/services into new markets is strongly desired

• Adept at establishing and developing relationships across customer organizations

• Strong technical problem solving skills with a demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly

• Knowledge and expertise with Ookla’s product offerings, including our licensing, data, and awards, or experience with similar technology-based product offerings

• Ability to travel regularly to meet and connect with existing clients, and to attend Ookla corporate and team functions

• Strategic thinker with the ability to see/understand the big picture

• Global business experience a plus, with special focus on supporting the needs of an international customer base

• Technical Program or Project Management experience a plus

• B.A./B.S. degree or equivalent, Master’s degree or international business education a plus

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. · Monitor AM requirements linked to Operator Strategy, Operational Readiness Plans, budgets, delivery plans, asset requirements and handover readiness.

· Prepare concise assurance summaries showing review status, open risks, conditions, evidence gaps and recommended AM decision position.

### Education

· Professional certification in asset management, project controls, assurance, governance or project management is desirable.

### Experience

· Experience in asset management, governance, assurance, design review coordination, handover readiness, project controls or infrastructure delivery.

· Strong understanding of Stage Gate processes, action tracking, evidence management, risk escalation and decision support.

· Experience working with City Operations, O&M teams, delivery teams, consultants and asset management stakeholders is preferred.

### Preferred Background

· Background in AM governance, operational readiness, handover, assurance, PMO or design review environments.

· Exposure to ISO 55001-aligned asset management principles, including lifecycle, value, risk and continual improvement.

### Technical & Functional Expectations

· Stage Gate assurance, design review coordination and governance reporting.

· Evidence management, comment tracking, action closure and decision logs.

· Operational readiness, handover requirements, maintainability and lifecycle considerations.

· AM platform use, dashboards, exception reporting and escalation management.

Housekeeping Public Area Supervisor, include and guiding the housekeeping line staff to ensure that guest rooms, public spaces, and back of house areas are cleaned and maintained according to luxury service standard of Faena Red Sea. Guest-focused mindset with professional service attitude

### **Job Description**

## Overview

The Electrician is responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing electrical systems, equipment, and wiring in residential, commercial, or industrial settings. They ensure electrical systems operate safely and efficiently while complying with applicable electrical codes, safety standards, and regulations.

## Your role

* The Electrician is responsible for reactive and PPM activities for LV/MV systems, Low current systems, and control panels; providing first response; interacting with the reporting supervisor daily; and ensuring compliance with BEC and Client Contractual FMA & FMR.
* Install, maintain, repair, and troubleshoot electrical systems, including wiring, lighting, power distribution, and control systems in commercial and industrial facilities.
* Conduct regular inspections and preventive maintenance tasks to identify potential issues and ensure the optimal performance of electrical systems.
* Diagnose and repair electrical malfunctions in systems and equipment, such as FACP Panels, BMS System, UPS System, PAVA System, Fan motors, Pumps, Control panels, Lighting Panels,
* Distribution Panels, Circuit breakers and lighting fixtures.
* Perform routine cleaning and servicing of electrical components to ensure cleanliness and efficiency.
* Collaborate with other team members to coordinate and prioritize maintenance tasks, ensuring timely completion of work orders.
* Document all maintenance and repair activities, including equipment status, work performed, and parts used, in maintenance logs and reports.
* Perform other assigned tasks as requested.
* Under general supervision, diagnose and repair system malfunctions requiring specific technical knowledge and relevant qualifications, understanding time and material requirements.
* Seek clarification and technical support when needed and escalate issues as appropriate.
* Stay updated on the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices related to electrical systems.
* Comply with all safety protocols, regulations, and company policies while performing maintenance tasks.
* Be familiar with electrical codes, standards, and regulations.
* Provide guidance and support to junior technicians as needed.
* Possess knowledge of building automation systems and controls.
* Follow up with the supervisor to close activities/events on time.
* Respond promptly to service requests and emergency callouts, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption to facility operations.
* Assist in the installation and commissioning of new electrical systems and equipment as required.
* Ensure all work is performed in compliance with relevant codes, standards, and safety regulations.

## About you

* High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or ITI/Diploma in Electrical preferred.
* 5+ experience as an electrician in residential, commercial, or industrial environments.
* Strong knowledge of electrical systems, circuits, wiring, and safety procedures.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, blueprints, and schematics.
* Skilled in diagnosing and repairing electrical faults and equipment failures.
* Familiarity with local electrical codes, regulations, and industry standards.
* Ability to use electrical testing and diagnostic equipment.
* Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Physical fitness to work in various environments, including heights and confined spaces.
* Strong communication, teamwork, and time management skills.
* Valid electrician license/certification (if required by local regulations).

job_title: Housekeeping Manager Golf Villas & Resort, Four Seasons Red Sea
description:
**About Four Seasons:**

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.           
  
At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**

Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs.

## The Role of the Housekeeping Manager

As the Housekeeping Manager at Four Seasons Resort Red Sea, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire housekeeping operation across the resort and private villas, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, presentation, and luxury service are consistently delivered.

In this leadership role, you will manage and inspire the housekeeping team to maintain the exceptional standards synonymous with Four Seasons. Your focus will be on ensuring that guest rooms, villas, public areas, and back-of-house spaces are maintained to the highest levels of cleanliness and comfort, creating a flawless and welcoming environment for our guests.

You will develop and manage daily operational plans, ensuring the efficient scheduling of team members and proper allocation of resources across the resort and villa areas. This includes assigning responsibilities based on operational needs, team strengths, and guest preferences, while ensuring seamless coordination between housekeeping, front office, engineering, and other departments.

A key responsibility of the role is conducting regular inspections of guest rooms, villas, public spaces, and facilities to ensure all areas meet Four Seasons standards. Your attention to detail and commitment to excellence will play a vital role in maintaining the resort’s reputation for outstanding quality and service.

You will also oversee training, coaching, and performance development for the housekeeping team, ensuring all team members understand and deliver the Four Seasons service culture. By fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, you will empower your team to perform at their best and exceed guest expectations.

Effective communication and strong leadership will be essential in managing daily operations, resolving challenges, and ensuring service excellence across the resort and villas.

## Four Seasons Resort Red Sea

Set along the pristine coastline of the Red Sea, Four Seasons Resort Red Sea offers an unparalleled luxury resort experience surrounded by natural beauty and world-class hospitality. The resort features luxury guest rooms, suites, and private villas, designed to provide guests with exceptional comfort, privacy, and breathtaking sea views.

The resort offers an array of distinctive dining venues, wellness experiences, recreational facilities, and curated guest activities, creating a truly unique destination for leisure travelers from around the world.

## Area of Responsibility

Housekeeping operations across the Resort and Villas, including guest rooms, suites, villas, public areas, and back-of-house spaces.

## Knowledge and Skills

• College degree in Hospitality Management or related field  
• Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in a managerial or supervisory housekeeping role within a luxury hotel or resort environment  
• Previous experience managing villa or resort housekeeping operations is highly preferred  
• Proven leadership, team management, and organizational skills  
• Strong knowledge of housekeeping operations, quality standards, and luxury service delivery  
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced resort environment  
• Proficiency in operating hotel systems and computer applications  
• Ability to communicate effectively in English  
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to service excellence.

## What to Expect

Competitive Net Salary in a Tax-Free Environment  
Housing provided  
Transportation provided  
30 Days Annual Vacation  
10 Public Holidays per year  
Paid Home Leave Tickets  
Medical Insurance  
Life Insurance  
Employee Assistance Program  
Worldwide Complimentary Room Nights with Four Seasons  
Laundry/Dry Cleaning for Provided Work Attire  
Growth & Development Opportunities

  

Dedicated to perfecting the travel experience through continual innovation and the highest standards of hospitality, Four Seasons can offer what many hospitality professionals dream of -the opportunity to build a life-long career with global potential and a real sense of pride in work well done.

**About the location:**

AMAALA is situated along Saudi Arabia’s northwest coast and is home to some of the most diverse natural environments. Marking a new chapter for comprehensive wellness tourism, Four Seasons Resort and Residences AMAALA at Triple Bay will feature 220 keys comprising of rooms and suites, as well as villas with their own private pools, and 26 branded residential villas, all thoughtfully designed to offer breathtaking bay and sea views. The resort will include a luxury spa nestled within its garden of tranquility and inspiration featuring a sculptured waterfall. The Organic Spa Garden will be a focal point and treatment experience set to stimulate the senses, offering extensive therapeutic remedies including halotherapy, cryotherapy, and advanced skin therapies. For fitness enthusiasts, the property will offer a bespoke collaboration with fitness trainer Harley Pasternak to seamlessly merge high-performance training with the limitless potential of Triple Bay’s 300 hectares (741 acres) of untouched hills, wadis, and beaches. The pristine terrain includes trails perfect for canyoning and exploring the rugged cliffs and valleys. Guests and residents can also take part in an array of guided hikes, mountain biking, and equestrian bridle trails, or work on their game at the spectacular 27-hole oceanfront golf course.

**About the Role**  
Join our pre-opening team as Guest Services Agent at Four Seasons Resort and Residences AMAALA at Triple Bay. Reporting to the Guest Services Supervisor, you will play an essential role in welcoming guests, managing their luggage and transportation needs, and ensuring smooth and personalized arrivals and departures throughout the pre-opening phase and daily operations.

**What You Will Do**

* Assist with pre-opening tasks including systems setup, service standard creation, and training related to guest arrivals and departures.
    
* Greet guests upon arrival and departure, assist with luggage handling, escorting, and offering helpful resort and destination information.
    
* Coordinate closely with the Front Desk, Concierge, and Valet teams to ensure seamless guest movement and satisfaction.
    
* Assist VIP guests and respond to special requests with care and attention.
    
* Maintain guest areas at the entrance and lobby, ensuring a welcoming and organized environment.
    
* Deliver items to guest rooms when required and support room moves as needed.
    
* Monitor guest feedback and support service recovery when necessary.
    
* Maintain a professional appearance and embody the Four Seasons service culture.
    

**What You Bring**

* Previous experience in guest services, bell desk, or valet roles within luxury hospitality preferred.
    
* Pre-opening experience is an advantage.
    
* Energetic and service-oriented personality with excellent communication skills.
    
* Physically fit and able to handle luggage and assist with guest movement as needed.
    
* Saudi Driver License, Ability to drive.
    
* Suitable candidates must be eligible to work in Saudi Arabia. Fluency and English is essential.
    

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary in a tax-free environment.
    
* Housing and transportation.
    
* 30 days of vacation plus public holidays.
    
* Paid home leave tickets.
    
* Complimentary meals and uniform cleaning.

Full-time role.

* Ensure that all maintenance activities are properly documented and completed within the required timeframe.
* Participate in **equipment performance reviews, reliability improvement programs, and energy-efficiency initiatives**.

description:
## Company Description

*SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries, supported by a team of 99,500 dedicated professionals. With over 145 years of service excellence, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards of quality, compliance, and sustainability.*

We are looking for BMS / SCADA Specialist who will be responsible for the design review, configuration, integration, testing, commissioning, and handover of Building Management System (BMS) and SCADA systems for data center and mission‑critical projects in KSA.The role requires strong hands-on expertise in control systems, system integration, data visualization, and close coordination with MEP, commissioning, IT, and operations teams to ensure reliable and fully functional monitoring and control systems.

## Job Description

* Lead and execute BMS and SCADA activities across the full project lifecycle, including design review, configuration, installation support, testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), and final handover.
* Review and validate BMS / SCADA architecture, points lists, network topology, control schematics, sequences of operation, and graphics to ensure alignment with project requirements and data center best practices.
* Configure, program, test, and troubleshoot BMS and SCADA systems, including controllers, servers, field devices, HMIs, databases, and alarm management systems.
* Integrate BMS and SCADA with data center critical systems, including electrical (UPS, generators, switchgear, power meters), mechanical (HVAC, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units), fire alarm systems, BMS subsystems, DCIM, and third‑party systems using standard protocols (BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, OPC).
* Support and participate in Integrated Systems Testing (IST) to validate control logic, alarms, interlocks, failover scenarios, redundancy, and operational sequences.
* Coordinate closely with commissioning managers, MEP engineers, system vendors, OEMs, IT/network teams, contractors, and client representatives.
* Witness and support FAT, SAT, and site testing, ensuring all observations are recorded and resolved.
* Develop, review, and maintain BMS / SCADA documentation, including system configuration records, test results, alarm matrices, trend logs, backups, and sign‑off documents.
* Ensure BMS and SCADA systems comply with project specifications, international standards, cybersecurity practices (where applicable), and local KSA regulations.
* Monitor and enforce HSE requirements during all testing and commissioning activities.
* Support preparation of O&M manuals, operator training, system demonstrations, and final handover to facility operations teams.
* Assist with post‑handover support, fine‑tuning, and optimization during initial operations if required.

## Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Control Systems, or related discipline.
* 7–10 years of experience in BMS / SCADA systems
* 3–5+ years of experience on data center or mission‑critical projects preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience with BMS and SCADA platforms (e.g., Siemens, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, ABB, Rockwell)
* Proficiency in industrial communication protocols (BACnet IP/MSTP, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC, SNMP)
* Good understanding of data center operations, redundancy concepts (N, N+1, 2N), and alarm management
* Ability to read and interpret control drawings, network diagrams, and sequences of operation

An ideal candidate will have a track record as a significant individual contributor as well as a strong team player.

**Position Summary:**

Position requires a skilled MH-60/H-60 Avionics Technician AT with the ability to perform Planned Maintenance Interval Inspections (PMI), Organizational, Intermediate, and Depot level maintenance on **H-60** helicopters, which also includes troubleshooting, testing, inspections, repairs of aircraft radio’s, radar, navigation equipment, and other rapid communication devices. Extensive knowledge in wire, and connector repair is required. Position is in Jubail Saudi Arabia.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Current or previous experience performing H-60 helicopter Avionics work to include but not limited to:
    
* Perform maintenance and repair of major assemblies, subassemblies, and wire and connector replacements on the MH-60R aircraft and related systems.
    
* Have a knowledge of electronic theory.
    
* Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate corrective actions on electrical and utilities systems.
    
* Operate and maintain all applicable ground support equipment. Identify, use and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair.
    
* Responsible for all maintenance documentations, applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP.
    
* Provide On-the-Job-Training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and other personnel to include maintaining appropriate training records to document training.
    

**Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required:**

* 8 years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter electrical work to include but not limited to: installation, tests, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, alignments, modification, performing final test calibrations, and solving maintenance problems in highly complex navigation identification, radar electronic devices, navigational radar, electronic countermeasure systems, global positioning system (GPS), and armament systems.
    
* Must be able to solve complicated problems encountered by pilots while in flight. Often these problems cannot be duplicated on the ground.
    
* Have a thorough understanding of flight characteristics and their effects on electronic systems. Systems includes search/ navigational radar, communication, navigation, electronic countermeasures, data computing, recording equipment, weapons computer, and inertial measurement systems.
    
* Be able to use test equipment such as voltmeters, signal generators, sweep/ pulse generators, dual trace oscilloscopes, deviation meters, sweep carts, precision power, and frequency measuring devices. Also, must use various test sets that detect discrepancies that often do not appear during bench rework in work centers.
    
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, schematic diagrams, and technical directives
    
* Work with miniaturized solid-state circuits and devices. Able to use a full range of hand tools common to the trade. Must have a thorough knowledge of digital/ analog computers, algebra, and trigonometry.
    
* Must be able to pass a background check, and drug test.
    

**Preferences**:

* **Navy Aviation Avionics - AE MH-60R HSM HSC**
    
* **Airborne Low-Frequency Sonar (ALFS):** AN/AQS-22
    
* **Sonobuoy Processing System**
    
* **Multi-Mode Radar:** AN/APS-153(V)
    
* **Open-Architecture Mission Computer**
    

**Clearance Requirement:**

* **Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoW Secret Clearance.** Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform post offer, pre-employment substance abuse testing. **US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance.**
    

**Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:**

The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
    
* Must be able to walk, and stand on level, inclined surfaces for certain periods throughout the day. Also be able to climb stairs, ramps, ladders, and work stands.
    
* Must be able to lift 50 pounds.
    
* Distinguish color and judge three-dimensional depth.

# Job Description

## Operations Risk & Governance Manager

## Job Purpose

The Operations Risk & Governance Manager ensures that operational processes, controls, and product launches are well governed, compliant, and managed within HALA’s risk appetite.

The role works closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Information Security, and Internal Audit to identify risks, strengthen controls, manage incidents, and support safe product launches.

## Key Responsibilities

### Operational Risk and Controls

* Maintain the Operations risk register and track mitigation actions.
    
* Conduct risk and control assessments across operational processes.
    
* Review the design and effectiveness of key operational controls.
    
* Identify control gaps and ensure corrective actions are completed.
    
* Monitor operational risk indicators, incidents, losses, and recurring issues.
    
* Escalate material risks and control failures to management.
    

### Product Launch Governance

* Manage the governance process for new product and service launches.
    
* Ensure all launches complete the required risk, compliance, operational, technology, security, and customer-impact assessments.
    
* Coordinate launch-readiness reviews with Product, Technology, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Finance, and Customer Experience.
    
* Confirm that operating procedures, controls, training, customer support, reporting, and incident processes are ready before launch.
    
* Maintain launch checklists, approvals, decisions, risks, dependencies, and action logs.
    
* Escalate unresolved critical risks before go-live.
    
* Monitor post-launch performance, incidents, customer issues, and control effectiveness.
    
* Lead post-launch reviews and ensure lessons learned are implemented.
    

### Governance and Policies

* Maintain Operations policies, procedures, control documents, and approval matrices.
    
* Coordinate Operations governance meetings and track decisions and actions.
    
* Ensure policies and procedures are reviewed and approved on time.
    
* Maintain clear ownership and accountability for operational risks and controls.
    

### Incident and Issue Management

* Coordinate the investigation of operational incidents and service failures.
    
* Lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action tracking.
    
* Identify recurring incidents and recommend process improvements.
    
* Ensure material incidents are escalated to the appropriate stakeholders.
    

### Reporting and Assurance

* Prepare operational risk and governance reports for senior management.
    
* Monitor key risk indicators, control performance, incidents, and overdue actions.
    
* Coordinate Operations responses to Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, External Audit, and regulatory reviews.
    
* Track audit and regulatory findings until closure.
    

### Third-Party and Operational Resilience

* Support risk assessments for critical vendors and outsourced services.
    
* Monitor vendor performance, incidents, and control weaknesses.
    
* Support business continuity planning and operational resilience testing.
    
* Ensure critical processes have recovery plans and operational workarounds.
    

## Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Finance, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.
    
* 5–7 years of experience in operational risk, governance, controls, audit, compliance, or operations.
    
* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated industry is preferred.
    
* Experience supporting product launches, risk assessments, control testing, and incident management.
    
* Strong understanding of operational risk, governance, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.
    

## Core Competencies

* Strong risk judgement and attention to detail.
    
* Ability to challenge and influence stakeholders.
    
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
    
* Clear communication and reporting skills.
    
* Strong planning and action-tracking capabilities.
    
* Ability to work effectively across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Compliance.
    
* High integrity, accountability, and ownership.
    

**What We Offer You**  
**We believe you will love working at HALA!**

* We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in remote, in-office, and hybrid work setups.
* We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including the potential for shares.
* We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment.
* Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 7 countries and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
* We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
* You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best.

We’re looking for a Customer Experience Manager to take ownership of the end-to-end customer experience for a fast-growing B2B spend-management platform serving finance teams across Saudi Arabia.

You’ll be responsible for making sure every customer interaction, from support tickets and calls to escalations and self-serve resources, is smooth, efficient, and consistently high-quality. You’ll own the key CX metrics, improve SLAs, and turn customer feedback and recurring issues into meaningful improvements.

This is an operator role, not a pure people-management role. You’ll be hands-on with dashboards, processes, reporting, and root-cause analysis, while working closely with Product and Engineering to improve the customer journey and build smarter, more scalable support operations.

If you enjoy building processes, solving problems, using data to drive decisions, and making customer experience better at scale, this role is for you.

### Responsibilties

* Own day-to-day support operations across ticketing, phone, and in-app channels; manage queue health, routing, and coverage.
* Lead, coach, and schedule the support team; run QA on ticket and call quality with a documented scorecard.
* Own the Support SLA & Escalation Matrix: First response, resolution, and escalation paths across L1/L2/L3 and third-party processors.
* Track and drive the core CX metrics: First-response and resolution SLA attainment, call abandonment, callback compliance, awaiting-customer rate, reopened-ticket rate, CSAT.
* Build and maintain reporting in Zoho Desk/Zoho Analytics; publish a weekly operations review with findings and actions, not just numbers.
* Own the knowledge base, customer-facing and internal, including release-triggered updates and the content feeding the AI call agent.
* Identify recurring ticket drivers and convert them into product fixes, automations, or self-serve content; work with Engineering and Product to close them.
* Ensure complaint handling meets SAMA requirements, including complaint logging, response timelines, and escalation/disclosure obligations.
* Manage escalations end-to-end, including card, transaction, and processor-side issues requiring third-party coordination.
* Drive automation of manual support workflows (macros, auto-assignment, classification, n8n-style integrations).

**Requirements**

* 5+ years in customer support/experience, with at least 2 years managing a team.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or SaaS; exposure to a regulated environment strongly preferred.
* Hands-on with a modern helpdesk platform (Zoho Desk, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom) including SLA configuration, workflows, and reporting.
* Comfortable working with data, able to build dashboards, interrogate numbers, and defend a recommendation. SQL is a plus.
* Strong process-writing ability: SOPs, escalation matrices, and policy documents.
* Fluent Arabic and English, written and spoken.
* Saudi nationality.
* Onsite position

### Nice to have

* Familiarity with card issuing/processing concepts (authorisations, declines, chargebacks, 3DS).
* Experience with SAMA consumer-protection or complaint-handling requirements.
* Experience deploying AI/automation in a support function.

Job Summary

The Senior Program Controls Specialist is responsible for leading and governing program controls across a portfolio of large, complex projects. The role provides strategic oversight of cost management, scheduling, forecasting, risk management, performance reporting, change control, and portfolio analytics to support successful project delivery and strong financial performance.

The position serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, project directors, finance, commercial, procurement, and delivery teams. Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of program controls frameworks, methodologies, policies, and governance processes across multiple projects and programs.

Provide strategic oversight of project budgets, forecasts, schedules, cash flow, earned value performance, and key project performance indicators.

Establish, approve, and maintain program and project baselines, ensuring effective measurement of scope, schedule, cost, progress, and performance.

Lead monthly business reviews and executive reporting, including variance analysis, trend assessment, scenario evaluation, and actionable recommendations.

Partner with Project Directors, Program Managers, Commercial, Finance, Procurement, and Delivery teams to optimize project outcomes and financial performance.

Provide executive-level dashboards and strategic insights using Power BI, SAP, Primavera P6, Microsoft Excel, and other enterprise project controls systems.

Oversee project controls personnel and provide direction, coaching, mentoring, performance management, and capability development.

Ensure project controls processes comply with corporate governance requirements, client obligations, audit expectations, and industry best practices.

Direct portfolio-level risk management, mitigation planning, contingency management, and escalation of material exposures.

Support business planning, resource forecasting, capital planning, and long-range portfolio performance analysis.

Establish standards and best practices that improve forecasting accuracy, reporting quality, data integrity, and operational efficiency.

Lead audits, compliance reviews, lessons learned, assurance activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Act as the primary program controls focal point for executive leadership, customers, auditors, and other key stakeholders.

At least 10 years of progressive experience in project controls, program controls, cost management, planning, scheduling, project management, or PMO leadership.

Demonstrated experience leading project controls across large-scale capital projects, infrastructure, data centers, energy, engineering, construction, or technology programs.

Advanced expertise in cost management, forecasting and budgeting, schedule management, Earned Value Management, risk management, performance measurement, portfolio reporting, and change control.

Extensive working knowledge of Primavera P6, SAP, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and enterprise project controls systems.

Strong understanding of project finance, accounting principles, cash flow management, accruals, and cost-to-complete methodologies.

Master's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Shift Supervision & Post Control**

• Conduct regular checks on Security colleagues and posts to confirm vigilance, adherence to standards, and effective handover.

**Access, Patrols & Guest Safety**

• Manage access points to ensure all colleagues, casual labour, vendors, contractors, suppliers, visitors, and vehicles enter through authorized channels.

• Maintain vigilance at pass counters and support the Visitor Management System, contractor controls, vehicle checks, and delivery access procedures.

• Perform roving safety and security patrols within and around the resort, including guest areas, heart-of-house, accommodation / service areas where applicable, and external resort surroundings.

• Identify fire hazards, unsafe acts, suspicious behaviour, breaches of procedure, or maintenance risks and take immediate corrective or escalation action.

**Control Room, CCTV & Systems**

• Be in charge of the Hotel Security Control Room during the shift and ensure all official documents are handled accurately according to SOP.

• Monitor CCTV coverage, alarms, access control, duress systems, fire-life-safety alerts, and security equipment, highlighting faults or unusual observations immediately.

• Support preliminary CCTV review for investigation and training purposes in accordance with privacy and evidence-handling standards.

• Coordinate with Engineering, IT, or relevant departments to report system faults, door lock issues, safe box concerns, and security equipment defects.

**Emergency Response & Incident Reporting**

• Respond to security, medical, fire, duress, lost child, crowd control, guest concern, suspicious activity, and other emergencies as quickly as possible.

• Perform First Aid / CPR / AED where trained and required, and coordinate with internal and external emergency responders.

• Gather facts, document incidents, prepare end-of-shift reports, complete accident / incident forms, and maintain accurate logbook entries.

• Handle lost and found reports, key and pass inventory, safe box issues, door lock concerns, lift control, VIP movement support, crowd control, and ushering duties as assigned.

At SLS The Red Sea, excellence starts at the source. As a **Butcher**, you will play an important role in supporting our culinary operations by preparing premium meat products to the highest standards of quality, precision, freshness, and presentation.

Working closely with the Sous Chef and wider culinary team, you will be responsible for cutting, trimming, deboning, portioning, and preparing a variety of meat products according to established specifications and operational requirements. * Receive and inspect meat deliveries, ensuring product quality, freshness, temperature, and specification compliance.

* Maintain daily mise en place and ensure all required products are prepared and ready for service.

* Monitor product quality and report any food safety concerns, equipment issues, or product discrepancies to the appropriate supervisor.
* Monitor stock levels and communicate product requirements or shortages to the culinary team in a timely manner.
* Minimize food waste through efficient cutting, portioning, trimming, storage, and responsible use of ingredients.
* Support other culinary areas when required, contributing to smooth and efficient kitchen operations.
* Use butchery equipment safely and responsibly, following established operating procedures and training guidelines.
* Participate in training and development opportunities to enhance butchery techniques, product knowledge, and culinary skills.
